Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

Le groupe d’Opérabilité Moteur est responsable des différents aspects de l’opérabilité des moteurs tels que le démarrage, l’accélération et décélération (comportement dynamique), la simulation transitoire, les interfaces avec l’avion/l’hélicoptère, ainsi que les spécifications d’opérabilité pour les systèmes de contrôle électronique (FADEC) et hydromécanique.

Selon des instructions précises, elle peut être appelée à effectuer des tâches sur des réseaux.

jobs.title: IT - ERP Developer
jobs.description:
CCM Hockey is present worldwide, we have offices in Canada, the United States, Sweden, Finland, Germany and Taiwan. Our headquarters are located in Montreal, where we create and develop our equipment. Our mission is to inspire dreams and empower every player to fulfill their passion while enjoying their game. Our team's vision is to be the leading brand on and off the ice, by delivering innovative products and outstanding experience to our athletes and partners everywhere, all while putting our employees and communities at the forefront. We aim to unlock the full potential of every CCM athlete from pond to forum by delivering innovation to maximize performance and ignite in them the self-confidence to chase their dream. We’re looking for passionate players who share our core values and will help us become THE industry leader!
  
  
**At CCM Hockey, we live our values everyday:**  
**Authenticity:** Standing up for who you are, doing what you mean and what you believe in.
  
  
**Empowerment:** Through their unique contributions, each person is different, each person is important, and each person has the opportunity to make a difference.
  
  
**Teamwork:** A team that works together always beats a team of highly skilled individual players.
  
  
**Respect:** Valuing differences and allowing others to express themselves when working together, to achieve common goals, to grow and succeed as a company.
  
  
The Application Developer ERP builds and supports the customizations and integrations of our Epicor Kinetic ERP, used by our operations in North America and Europe. The role brings key development skills in-house to reduce our dependence on 3rd party support.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities:**  

* Develop and maintain Epicor customizations (BPMs, Functions, BAQs, dashboards, reports).
* Build and support integrations between Epicor and other systems.
* Deploy changes from Test to Production and document them. · Provide level 2 and 3 support on applications and integrations.
* Contribute to ERP projects and upgrades.

**Key Position Characteristics:**  

* Delivers and supports the customizations and integrations that daily operations rely on, in North America and Europe.
* Works daily with business analysts and users to turn requirements into solutions.
* Exchanges information with consultants, Epicor support and integration partners.
* Identify and fix complex issues at their root cause.
* Propose simple, standard solutions before custom code.
* Individual contributor.
* Works with business analysts, developers and business leads on projects and issue resolution.
* Shares knowledge and documents their work.

Technical / Professional Skills, Expertise and Qualifications
  

* University degree in computer science or equivalent experience.
* At least 5 years’ experience in application development, ideally on an ERP.
* Good communication, analysis and problem-solving skills.
* Bilingual (English & French).
* Based in Montréal, with global responsibilities (North America and Europe).

Required Competencies
  

* Technical expertise (required)
* ERP development experience (Epicor preferred).
* C# / .NET and SQL Server.
* Integrations using REST APIs, JSON or XML.
* General knowledge of sales, purchasing, inventory, distribution and accounting processes.

Assets
  

* Epicor Kinetic: BPM, Epicor Functions, Application Studio, SSRS.
* Middleware or EDI (Mulesoft, X12, EDIFACT).
* Git, Jira or similar tools.
* Good communicator - Listens well and communicates clearly, in person and remotely.
* Team player - Works well in project teams.
* Problem solving - Finds the real cause and practical solutions.
* Documentation - Documents work so others can support it.

WHY JOIN THE CCM TEAM?
  

* Competitive salaries, including a performance-based bonus program.
* Full range of group insurance benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, etc.) from Day 1.
* Group retirement pension plan with employer matching (up to 5% of base salary).
* 3 weeks of vacation per year prorated as of your start date.
* Discounted prices on CCM products.
* Free gym at the head office.
* Fun social events throughout the year.

At CCM Hockey, we celebrate the difference for the benefit of our employees, our products and our collaborators. We work to create an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, age or other motives, can give the best of themselves.
  
Please note that only retained candidates will be contacted. We respectfully ask agencies to not contact us or send unsolicited applications. We thank all applicants for their interest.
  

* Please note that the benefits may vary depending on the location and the position. All unionized employees are governed by the collective agreement.

jobs.title: System Administrator
Sr. Manager, System Administrator
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Gildan is a leading manufacturer of everyday basic apparel, with a strong portfolio of brands, including Gildan®, Hanes®, Comfort Colors®, American Apparel®, ALLPRO™, GOLDTOE®, Peds®, Bali®, Playtex®, Maidenform®, Bonds®, as well as Champion® which is under an exclusive licensing agreement for the printwear channel in the U.S. and Canada.

Gildan owns and operates vertically integrated, large-scale manufacturing facilities which are primarily located in Central America, the Caribbean, North America, and Asia. Gildan operates with a strong commitment to industry-leading labour, environmental and governance practices throughout its supply chain in accordance with its comprehensive ESG program embedded in Gildan's long-term business strategy. Together with our global team of dedicated employees, Gildan is united in its vision of Making Apparel Better®. Discover the full scale of Gildan and prepare to be surprised at gildancorp.com.

  
The opportunity:

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Sr. Manager, System Administration to oversee the strategy, deployment, maintenance, and security of our Windows Server and Intel-based physical and virtual infrastructure. In this role, you will lead a global team of systems engineers, manage vendor relationships, and ensure maximum uptime, scalability, and security for our enterprise-level Wintel environment. This is a dynamic opportunity to drive technical excellence and shape the future of our infrastructure landscape.

* Department: IT Infrastructure
* Reporting Into: Director of Infrastructure

The role

* Manages the global engineering team responsible for backups, virtualization, Wintel, and storage design, implementation, and 24/7 operational support.
* Ensures continuous, secure operations by owning ITIL procedures, patching cycles, performance metrics, root cause analysis, disaster recovery plans/tests, and security controls for both in-house and cloud-based services.
* Owns the annual Wintel infrastructure budget by forecasting and maintaining capital and operational expenditures (CAPEX/OPEX), tracking monthly adherence, and identifying cost-saving opportunities across hardware lifecycles and software licensing renewals.
* Manages strategic relationships with third-party service providers, suppliers, and consultants, including vendor selection, contract evaluation, and critical incident escalation.
* Collaborates directly with our PMO and cross-functional IT teams to design, build, and implement robust, enterprise-wide capabilities.
* Partners with functional business areas to ensure all infrastructure solutions meet and scale with current and future business requirements.
* Hires, trains, mentors, and evaluates system engineering talent, establishing clear performance expectations and fostering professional growth.

The requirements

* Education & Experience: A University degree in Information Technology; 12-15 + years of experience in IT infrastructure/architecture, with a minimum of 5+ years in a supervisory or management role.
* Core Technical Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with the following enterprise technologies:
  + *Operating Systems & Systems Management:* Windows Server (2016 through 2025), Active Directory, Group Policies, SCCM/MECM and Office 365 hybrid environments (OneDrive, SharePoint, Exchange SE).
  + *Virtualization & Storage:* VMware (6.5 through 9.x), Pure Storage, IBM Metro Mirror, and VM stretch clusters.
  + Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Security: Strong experience in designing and operating enterprise Azure environments. Including Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, identity and Access Management, Workload Management, cloud security and operational governance.
  + *Hardware Ecosystems:* HP, Dell, IBM, Cisco UCS servers, UCS Fabric Interconnects (FI), and Brocade switches.
  + *Availability & Data Protection:* Enterprise backup and disaster recovery planning (DRP) solutions, specifically Commvault.
* Security & Networking (Preferred): Good working knowledge of Cisco ACI, Okta MFA, proxy servers, server hardening, LAPS, CrowdStrike.
* Leadership & Professional Attributes:
  + Thrives as a hands-on manager in a fast-paced, changing environment with the ability to multitask effectively.
  + Demonstrates strong capacity and project planning capabilities to accurately anticipate future infrastructure needs.
  + Operates with complete transparency and collaborates seamlessly across functions to find the best solutions for the organization.
  + Excels at troubleshooting complex systems and possesses a natural curiosity to uncover root causes and drive process improvements.
  + Proven ability to mobilize, motivate, and influence technical teams, proactively bringing the right stakeholders into the conversation.
* Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and French.

  
What's in it for you:

* Join a publicly traded company dual-listed on NYSE and TSX with great potential
* Be part of a workplace where meaningful connections and teamwork are celebrated
* From local to international, be ready to work alongside a diverse group of colleagues
* Benefit from mentorship and continuous development opportunities
* Take advantage of our attractive benefits packages

We want to get to know you better! Please include your transferrable skills and unique experience in your application to help us learn more about you.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

Find your fit with us:

We are committed to ensuring that everyone, across every background and identity, feels respected, supported, and able to thrive. Come as you are and #FindYourFit at Gildan. Tailor the future of your own career.

Industrial Systems Programmer (Robots and CNC)
jobs.description:
**Let's talk about your future mission**

165 TONNES REST ON OUR EXPERTISE…  

Safran Landing Systems is a subsidiary of Safran Landing Systems, a global leader in landing gear and braking systems for aircraft. The Mirabel plant is dedicated to manufacturing major components of landing gear for Airbus A320, A330, and A350 models, as well as the Boeing 787\. It features state\-of\-the\-art equipment for machining, polishing, and special processes, including heat treatment, shot peening, and surface treatments.  

  

In accordance with the standards established by the Programming team manager, perform programming of robotic and CNC cells for new products or major changes to existing programs according to procedures.  

  

1\. Develop, modify, and maintain robot programs  

* Establish and test the program concept, conduct risk analysis, and make feasibility recommendations.
* Create an initial program and preliminary analysis using software while considering:


  

o The work environment, fixtures, production parts, and the robot(s) (cell) and limits.  

o Paths, trajectories, and movements.  

o With the help of automation engineers, display information on the operator interface such as calling recipes and process parameters (HMI).  

o Define process parameters with Methods such as distances, intensities, speeds, etc.\- Complete prerequisites for production.  

  

2\. Develop, modify, and maintain CNC programs  

  

* Identify client needs and provide feedback at each stage
* Establish and test the program concept, conduct risk analysis, and make feasibility recommendations.
* Create an initial program that integrates all process monitoring tools.
* Finalize the program based on client needs and constraints.


  

3\. Documentation and Projects:  

  

* Create and maintain CNC and robotic documentation.
* Support projects for the acquisition or modification of robotic equipment and machines.
* Support the digitalization of robotic systems.


  

4\. Innovation, Evaluation, and participation in continuous improvement:  

* Suggest and develop new programming methods or new technologies:


  

o Stay informed about new technologies and methods on the market  

o Participate in sharing best practices within the Group  

o Analyze and evaluate new technologies proposed, in collaboration with the tooling manager  

o Select those that improve productivity

**Let's talk about you**

Requirements:  

* DEC or AEC in robotics, mechanical engineering, aeronautical engineering, or aerospace construction
* 3 to 5 years of experience


  

Technical skills:  

* Mastery of offline robot programming with DELMIA\-V5 ROBOTIC and 3D EXPERIENCE ROBOT software from DASSAULT
* Mastery of CATIA\-V5 software from DASSAULT
* Mastery of 6\-axis articulated industrial robots from KUKA and MOTOMAN/YASKAWA

Développeur logiciel C\+\+

Contractuel : 1 sera pour une période de 11 mois et l'autre pour 6 mois

Bilinguisme : Ce serait mieux

Position hybride : 1 jour/semaine \+ 2ᵉ jour toutes les 3 semaines. La personne doit être flexible.

Description du poste :

Le rôle de développeur logiciel au sein du groupe d'ingénierie de détection des anomalies magnétiques (MAD) est de développer de nouvelles capacités logicielles et/ou de corriger les déficiences identifiées sur notre senseur MAD\-XR. Le développeur de logiciels travaillera également dans toutes les phases du cycle de développement logiciel, y compris la définition des exigences, l'architecture, le développement, les tests unitaires et la documentation.

En collaboration avec les autres développeurs de logiciels, architectes et spécialistes V\&V, le développeur de logiciels travaillera à proposer et à améliorer des changements afin d'obtenir des livrables logiciels de haute qualité pour nos clients.

Tâches:

* Participer au développement des nouvelles fonctionnalités (design, code, test, documentation) ainsi qu’à la résolution des bugs découvert dans nos produits.
* Collaborer à l’élaboration des requis, de l’architecture et de la validation des exigences logicielles.
* Participer à des activités de revues de code et d’amélioration de nos pratiques de développement logiciel.
* Participer à l’intégration des fonctionnalités et du déploiement des solutions.
* Soutenir les spécialistes du V\&V pour définir des plans de tests formels et l’investigation des bugs trouvés lors de campagnes de validation formelle.
* Participer à la planification des livrables dans un cadre de développement agile.

Compétences techniques:

* Baccalauréat en génie informatique/logiciel/électrique ou expérience équivalente.
* Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en développement C/C\+\+
* Expérience dans le développement logiciel sur Windows et/ou Linux
* Connaissance des outils d’intégration logiciel et de contrôle des sources (Github ou autre).
* Connaissance des structures de programmation en temps réel, notamment les processus, les fils d’exécution, les sémaphores, les mécanismes de synchronisation et la gestion de mémoire.
* Connaissance des protocoles réseaux (TCP/IP, Sockets, UDP, etc..) ainsi que des mécanismes de communication interprocessus (IPC).

Atouts:

* Connaissance du langage UML (Unified Modeling Language)
* Connaissance des patrons de conception (design patterns) en développement.
* Expérience dans le développement de tests unitaires et de tests système.
* Connaissance des systèmes avionique, de véhicule, de détection ou de communication

Habilités:

Bon sens de l’organisation et de la planification.

Bonnes compétences en communication (à l’oral et à l’écrit).

Personne dynamique axée sur les résultats ayant un fort esprit d’équipe et un bon sens de l’initiative.

C\+\+ Software Developer

Contractor: 1 will be for a period of 11 months and the other for 6 months

Bilingualism: Would be better

Hybrid Position: 1 day/week \+ 2nd day every 3 weeks. The person must be flexible.

Job Description:

The role of Software Developer within the Magnetic Anomaly Detection (MAD) Engineering Group is to develop new software capabilities and/or correct deficiencies identified on our MAD\-XR sensor. The software developer will also work in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements definition, architecture, development, unit testing, and documentation.

In collaboration with other software developers, architects and V\&V specialists, the software developer will work to propose and improve changes in order to achieve high\-quality software deliverables for our clients.

Tasks:

Participate in the development of new features (design, code, testing, documentation) as well as in the resolution of bugs discovered in our products.

Collaborate in the development of requirements, architecture and validation of software requirements.

Participate in code review activities and improve our software development practices.

Participate in the integration of functionalities and the deployment of solutions.

Support V\&V specialists in defining formal test plans and investigating bugs found during formal validation campaigns.

Participate in the planning of deliverables within an agile development framework.

Technical Skills:

Bachelor's degree in Computer/Software/Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.

At least 5 years of experience in C/C\+\+

development Experience in software development on Windows and/or Linux

Knowledge of software integration and source control tools (Github or other).

Knowledge of real\-time programming structures, including processes, threads, semaphores, synchronization mechanisms, and memory management.

Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, Sockets, UDP, etc.) as well as interprocess communication mechanisms (IPC).

Assets:

Knowledge of UML (Unified Modeling Language)

Knowledge of design patterns in development.

Experience in developing unit tests and system tests.

Knowledge of avionics, vehicle, sensing or communication

systems Skills:

Good organizational and planning skills.

Good communication skills (oral and written).

Dynamic, results\-oriented individual with a strong team spirit and initiative.

Rémunération : à partir de 60,50$ par heure

Avantages :

* Stationnement sur place

Lieu du poste : En présentiel

As a Senior Engine Programmer at Ubisoft Montréal, you’ll help evolve the technology behind For Honor as part of the Core Tech team.


You’ll develop and optimize core engine systems for a live game, working with the Gameplay, Online, Tools, User Interface, and Graphics teams. Your work will support game performance and stability, as well as the tools the team uses to develop the game.

**What you’ll do:**

* Develop and maintain core engine systems.
* Investigate and resolve complex performance, stability, and memory issues.
* Design and implement technical improvements that support production needs.
* Work across disciplines to deliver technical solutions.
* Review code and contribute to the team’s programming practices.
* Support other programmers as they use and evolve engine systems.
* Contribute to optimization, automation, and technology modernization.
* Keep up with relevant technology and improve development processes.

  

**Qualifications** **Education:**

* Degree in computer science, software engineering or equivalent training.

**Relevant experience:**

* At least 5 years of experience in software programming, ideally in the video game industry or any other relevant experience.

**What you bring to the team:**

* Apply your experience with C\+\+ programming.
* Understand game engine architecture and low\-level systems.
* Apply your experience with performance optimization, multithreading, or memory management.
* Solve technical problems using debugging skills.
* Bring experience with Anvil or Scimitar, or an interest in learning the engine.
* Bring experience with a multiplayer or live\-service game as an asset.

**What to send our way:**

* Your CV highlighting relevant skills and experiences
* Links to relevant programming projects or code repositories

  

**Additional Information** **About FOR HONOR:**  

For Honor is an established multiplayer fighting game that has been live for over 10 years and is supported by a passionate community of more than one million monthly active players. With a talented team of around 140 people, we continue to invest in the evolution of both the game and the technologies that will support its future for years to come. Join us and help shape the technological future of a live game enjoyed by millions of players worldwide.

jobs.title: Programmeur-analyste, spécialiste en intelligence artificielle
jobs.description:
Relevant du gestionnaire, développement et intégration des solutions technologiques, la personne titulaire du poste est responsable de concevoir, de développer et d'intégrer des solutions d'intelligence artificielle (IA) répondant aux besoins d’affaires. Elle agit également à titre d’expert\-conseil auprès des gestionnaires, des équipes de développement et des parties prenantes transversales dans l’ensemble des projets technologiques afin d’assurer une intégration cohérente, sécuritaire et responsable des solutions conçues ou intégrées, notamment celles fondées sur l’IA, conformément aux cadres réglementaires et aux orientations organisationnelles applicables. Le programmeur\-analyste, spécialiste en IA doit notamment:


* Analyser les besoins d’affaires et fonctionnels, évaluer la pertinence du recours à l’IA et concevoir des solutions adaptées, y compris les cas d’utilisation, les données requises, les critères de qualité et les mécanismes de validation humaine.
* Réaliser et piloter des preuves de concept démontrant la faisabilité des solutions proposées, puis soutenir leur évolution vers des solutions en production intégrable et sécuritaire.
* Recommander l'approche la mieux adaptée parmi un éventail de solutions possibles en fonction du contexte, de la nature des données, du niveau de risque et de la complexité du problème à résoudre.
* Assurer le respect de la gouvernance, de la documentation et de la traçabilité des solutions d’IA, y compris les choix de conception, les modèles utilisés, les limites connues ainsi que les risques associés à leur cycle de vie.
* Mettre en place et appliquer les règles nécessaires à l’exploitation sécuritaire, fiable et confidentielle des solutions d’IA, y compris la gestion des accès, la protection des renseignements, la surveillance, la journalisation, la maintenance et le traitement des incidents.
* Favoriser la mise en place de services intégrant l’IA de façon responsable et éthique, y compris les garde\-fous, la supervision humaine et l’accompagnement des équipes dans l’adoption d’usages transparents et conformes.
* Assurer le développement et l'intégration des solutions technologiques.
* Décomposer les besoins en éléments de travail (carnet de sprint), estimer l'effort requis et planifier leur réalisation de façon itérative en collaboration avec l'équipe, en ajustant les priorités selon la valeur livrée et les apprentissages en cours de sprint.
* Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe du secteur Livraison TI tout au long du cycle de vie des projets, de la définition des besoins et des analyses d'affaires jusqu'au développement, au déploiement et à l'implantation des solutions, en s'inscrivant dans une pratique d’amélioration continue.
* Concevoir et exécuter des tests automatisés (unitaires et autres) afin de valider la qualité, la performance, la sécurité et la fiabilité du code et des solutions développés, et participer aux revues de code de ses pairs afin de contribuer à la cohérence et à la qualité du code au sein de l'équipe.
* Rédiger les documents et effectuer les analyses techniques nécessaires à l’identification et à la mise en place de solutions applicatives cohérentes, fonctionnelles, fiables et sécuritaires ainsi que les analyses nécessaires au bon fonctionnement du développement, de l’intégration et du déploiement logiciel et l’acquisition de plateformes/outils technologiques entrant dans les solutions dont son service à la charge.
* Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe du secteur Infrastructure et exploitation, notamment pour les implantations, les transferts de connaissance sur les nouvelles fonctionnalités développées ou intégrées, la résolution de pannes majeures, le soutien applicatif et le contrôle de la qualité.
* Évaluer et suivre la désuétude des solutions technologiques sous sa responsabilité et en assurer la mise à jour en collaboration avec les équipes de Livraison TI et d'Infrastructure et exploitation, notamment sur les plans de la sécurité, de la performance, de la fiabilité, de l'optimisation et de la conformité aux normes et processus TI en vigueur, y compris la réalisation de veilles technologiques nécessaires à l'exercice de cette responsabilité.


**EXIGENCES**


* Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie logiciel ou en génie informatique;
* Certification professionnelle reconnue en IA, en apprentissage automatique ou en développement des solutions en IA (atout);
* Minimum de 3 ans d’expérience en développement de solutions technologiques en IA.
* Connaissance des technologies d’IA générative;
* Connaissance des technologies MVC et Entity Framework;
* Connaissance des outils Git, Azure DevOps et Visual Studio;
* Leadership technique;
* Rigueur, autonomie et sens de l’initiative;
* Orientation résultats

**Full\-Stack Developer (Oracle APEX \& SQL)**
----------------------------------------------

### **About the role**


Insi is building its delivery team for a federal government client (Department of National Defence, TBIPS Supply Arrangement) supporting the sustainment of in\-house Oracle\-based engineering and airworthiness management products. This resource performs full\-stack development across the UI and data layers of these applications.

### **What you'll do**

* Develop, enhance, and maintain backend logic in Oracle databases: complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, packages, and triggers using Oracle PL/SQL.
* Design, enhance, and maintain user interfaces in Oracle Application Express (APEX), translating user stories and business requirements into intuitive UI designs, workflows, and interactive prototypes.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
* Use Azure DevOps and Git for version control, quality assurance, and configuration management.
* Document software designs, system architecture, and codebase for maintainability.

### **Must\-have**

* Hands\-on production experience with Oracle SQL and PL/SQL (stored procedures, functions, packages, triggers).
* Hands\-on production experience with Oracle APEX front\-end development.
* Experience with Azure DevOps / Git\-based workflows and Agile delivery.
* Fluent English, spoken and written, with minimal errors — no interpreter or assistance permitted.
* Must be a Canadian citizen — a requirement for eligibility for the Government of Canada Secret\-level personnel security screening this role needs to start work.
* Able to work on\-site at 455 Boulevard de la Carrière, Gatineau, QC, on a primarily in\-person basis (hybrid only if approved case\-by\-case by the client).

### **Nice\-to\-have**

* Prior delivery experience on a Government of Canada IT services contract (TBIPS, ProServices, or similar).
* Familiarity with Unified Codes APEX Office Print (AOP).

jobs.title: Data Migration Developer (MS Access/VBA → Oracle APEX)
jobs.description:
**Data Migration Developer (MS Access/VBA Oracle APEX)**
--------------------------------------------------------

### **About the role**


This is the most specialized of the three profiles: an experienced developer who migrates legacy MS Access/VBA and MS SQL Server applications and their data into modern Oracle APEX\-based platforms, while keeping the legacy systems running during the transition.

### **What you'll do**

* Analyze, interpret, and translate legacy source datasets — including MS Excel, MS Access, and other file\- or system\-based sources — into structures compatible with Oracle database and Oracle APEX environments.
* Plan and perform end\-to\-end ETL activities: staging, transforming, validating, and loading datasets from legacy sources into Oracle environments using Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, and APEX utilities.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and enhance legacy MS Access–based and/or MS SQL Server–based applications to sustain them during migration, using MS Access, T\-SQL, and Microsoft VBA as needed.
* Document data mappings, transformation logic, business rules, profiling results, and data\-quality findings for transparency and repeatability.
* At the discretion of the Technical Authority, may also support broader software development activities: bug and change request development, peer code reviews, testing and test script development.

### **Must\-have**

* Hands\-on experience with MS Access and Microsoft VBA in a production/legacy\-application context.
* Experience migrating legacy data (Access, Excel, SQL Server) into a modern platform — ETL design and execution.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SQL / PL\-SQL and, ideally, Oracle APEX.
* Fluent English, spoken and written, with minimal errors.
* Must be a Canadian citizen — a requirement for eligibility for the Government of Canada Secret\-level personnel security screening this role needs to start work.
* Able to work on\-site at 455 Boulevard de la Carrière, Gatineau, QC, on a primarily in\-person basis.

### **Nice\-to\-have**

* Already holds an active Government of Canada Secret\-level clearance
* T\-SQL experience specific to MS SQL Server legacy applications.
* Exposure to software testing / test script development.

**Développeur applications d’affaires**
---------------------------------------


### **Principales fonctions**


* Collaborer avec les parties prenantes métier afin de mettre en oeuvre des solutions de codes à barres, incluant la configuration du système, les tests, la formation, le déploiement, le soutien au démarrage et l’adoption par les utilisateurs, en veillant à ce que les solutions soutiennent efficacement les processus d’entrepôt et de production.
* Participer à l’analyse, à la conception, au développement, aux tests, au déploiement et à l’amélioration con nue des solutions à l’aide de Synergy DBL et du cadre applicatif ERP existant développé à l’interne.
* Produire un code propre, robuste et facile à maintenir; effectuer les tests unitaires, le débogage, la revue par les pairs et la correction des anomalies.
* Développer et soutenir les fonctionnalités liées au traitement des commandes clients, aux achats, à la gestion des stocks, aux opérations d’entrepôt, à la planification et à l’exécution de la production, ainsi qu’aux processus financiers et comptables.
* Comprendre et valider les impacts d’affaires, notamment les mouvements de stocks, les unités de mesure, les lots, les codes à barres, la consommation en production, le calcul des coûts, la facturation, les comptes clients, les comptes fournisseurs, le grand livre général et les rapports financiers.
* Concevoir, développer et soutenir les intégrations entre notre ERP existant, développé à l’interne et d’autres plateformes d’entreprise, notamment les solutions EDI et de banque électronique, les plateformes de facturation électronique, les plateformes d’entrepôt de données et de rapports, les services Web, les API et les intergiciels.
* Mettre en place des solutions de validation, de suivi des erreurs (logging), d’alerte (ou notification), de gestion d’échec (retry) ainsi que les mécanismes de rapprochement pour les interfaces et les transactions critiques.
* Réaliser la conception détaillée des systèmes et des données à l’aide de composants réutilisables, des standards Synergy DBL, de fichiers ISAM, de bases de données relationnelles et de modèles d’intégration établis.
* Analyser les causes fondamentales des incidents et des anomalies récurrentes; améliorer la performance, la stabilité, la fiabilité et la facilité de soutien de l’application.
* Fournir du soutien à la production, résoudre les incidents et offrir des conseils techniques aux utilisateurs, aux équipes fonctionnelles et aux autres développeurs dans les environnements et serveurs pris en charge.
* Préparer et maintenir la documentation technique, la documentation du code, les instructions de déploiement, les mappages de données, les procédures de soutien, les preuves de tests et les dossiers de changements tout au long du cycle de vie du développement logiciel.
* Utiliser le contrôle de code source, le suivi des éléments de travail, les pipelines de génération et de mise en production ainsi que les pratiques de gestion des changements afin d’assurer des déploiements contrôlés et traçables.
* Protéger l’intégrité des données et des systèmes en respectant les exigences de sécurité, de contrôle des accès, de séparation des tâches, de confidentialité, d’audit et de gestion des changements.
* Collaborer avec les responsables de processus d’affaires et les experts en la manière afin d’évaluer les impacts, d’identifier les exceptions et de s’assurer que les solutions fonctionnent efficacement dans des scénarios opérationnels réels.

### **Compétences techniques**


Requis


* Baccalauréat en informatique ou en génie logiciel, ou combinaison d’un diplôme et d’une expérience équivalente.
* 10 ans et plus d’expérience avec Synergy DBL (fichiers ISAM) ou un langage de programmation similaire, par exemple COBOL, RPG ou C\+\+.
* Expérience dans le développement ou le soutien d’un ERP ou d’autres applications d’affaires transactionnelles dans un environnement multientreprise.
* Expérience avec SQL et les bases de données relationnelles, y compris les requêtes, les procédures stockées, l’analyse de données et le dépannage.
* Expérience avec le contrôle de code source et les pratiques DevOps, de préférence Azure DevOps, Git, les pipelines et la gestion des mises en production.
* Compréhension des processus de bout en bout, notamment de la commande à l’encaissement, de l’approvisionnement au paiement, de la planification à la production et de l’enregistrement aux rapports, ainsi que des dépendances entre les transactions opérationnelles et financières.

Un atout


* Une expérience en mise en oeuvre de solutions de codes à barres constitue un atout.
* Une expérience avec l’EDI, les intégrations d’entreprise, les codes à barres, l’impression d’étiquettes ou des ou ls de rapports tels que Crystal Reports constitue un atout.
* Expérience avec .NET Framework, ASP.NET, les services Web ou les API.

### **Qualités personnelles**


Requis


* Capacité à tirer parti des outils de développement modernes, y compris les capacités assistées par l’IA, afin de soutenir, maintenir et améliorer les applications d’affaires existantes et les systèmes hérités.
* Capacité à analyser des incidents complexes touchant les couches applicatives, données, intégration et infrastructure, et à communiquer clairement la cause fondamentale et la résolution.
* Capacité à créer des scénarios de tests unitaires, d’intégration, de régression et de process

jobs.title: Service Desk Technician
jobs.description:
Would you like to be part of an IT organization offering greater opportunities and challenge? We have a position for you within our Technical Service Desk! Join the CGI Service Desk and get your career on the fast track. As a leading edge Global IT company, we are seeking talented professionals with all levels of information technology skills and expertise in order to support our clients worldwide. Based on our industry specific focus, we can offer you a work environment where you will be challenged and will grow and develop your career in a meaningful way. We will help you reach your full potential by providing learning materials \& training, mentoring \& coaching, as well as ongoing recognition and feedback… plus opportunities to advance! You will work in an agile environment that adapts quickly to meet client requirements. The Service Desk Technician is responsible for providing Level 1 IT support via phone, email and chat; our team is comprised of dynamic, passionate people with a focus customer service while providing IT support to diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve IT issues on 1st contact. We are dedicated to delivering a remarkable service experience to our customers!

**Your future duties and responsibilities**


SERVICE DESK TECHNICIAN PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES.
  

Provide quality customer support for all incoming contacts (via call, chat, email or web ticket) for IT related issues or requests. Perform diagnostics, troubleshooting and resolution activities for incidents or requests being reported, based on knowledge articles for incident or request processing \& fulfillment. Appropriate use of all tools available for resolution activities (remote take over, knowledge base, ticketing systems, communication). Log \& categorize all contacts within an incident management (ticketing system) tool. Assign contacts that cannot be resolved on the first contact to 2nd/3rd level support teams as per the knowledge base. Collaborate with 2nd/3rd level teams as required. Ticket Follow Up: monitor personal ticket queue daily and take appropriate action. Identify and escalate urgent / priority incidents as required. Develop knowledge and keep up to date on new processes or procedures

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS.
  

At least one year of Service Desk experience.
  

Solid understanding of Windows O/S.
  

Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  

Bilingual (English \& French) both verbal and written.
  

Focus on customer service/client satisfaction.
  

Attention to details / precision.
  

Strong analytical skills.
  

Keyboarding skills.
  

Familiarity with MAC support  

EDUCATION / TRAINING / WORK EXPERIENCE.
  

Post secondary education in technical / pc support or equivalent work experience.
  

A solid focus on Technical support \& Customer Service / Understanding of providing quality client support while propelling the customer experience.
  

Understanding of networks.
  

Knowledge of technical troubleshooting techniques (for PCs \& OS, network, mobile devices).
  

Knowledge of MAC / Apple application support  

PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES.
  

Dynamic team player.
  

Strong Communication skills (verbal \& written).
  

Results oriented / self motivated to succeed \& evolve skills (continuous improvement).
  

Ability to work within a team setting while demonstrating self sufficiency and independence.
  

Availability to work shifts and adhere to schedule (good time management / good organizational skills)  

  

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $40,000–$70,000\. This role is an existing vacancy.

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.  

  

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal\-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

jobs.title: Développeur Front End BI - AWS- Databricks
jobs.description:
Mode de travail : Hybride  

Le titulaire aura comme mandat, en tant qu'analyste développeur BI, de concevoir et développer des flux de données et des outils de consommation performants qui respectent les standards mis en place.

**Fonctions et responsabilités**


RESPONSABILITÉS SPÉCIFIQUES :  

Effectue, à partir d'un mandat, tous les travaux inhérents à l'analyse, au développement aux tests et à l'implantation de nouvelles solutions analytiques ou à la modification des solutions existantes.  

En collaboration avec les analystes fonctionnels, définit et clarifie les besoins des utilisateurs et participe à l'élaboration de solutions.  

Assure la qualité des flux de données, de la documentation, des guides destinés aux utilisateurs et respecte la méthodologie ainsi que les normes et standards de développement en vigueur.  

Développe et supporte les flux d'intégration de données robustes et évolutifs incluant les flux en temps réels (streaming), en temps quasi réel (near real time) et en lot (batch).  

Développe et supporte les outils de consommation performants qui répondent aux besoins de l'entreprise.  

Respecter les règles fonctionnelles et techniques ainsi que les normes de conception et de livraison de solutions  

Effectue du support à la production (suivi de production et support aux utilisateurs) selon un horaire préétabli (jour, soir, nuit et jours fériés).  

Effectue toutes autres tâches connexes.

**Qualités requises pour réussir dans ce rôle**


Baccalauréat en informatique ou dans un domaine pertinent.  

Plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle d'ingénieur de données ou développeur ETL.  

Excellente connaissance de la plateforme AWS et des services comme Glue, Redshift, Aurora.  

Bonne connaissance des outils de visualisation de données comme PowerBI et MicroStrategy.  

Bonne connaissance des différents modèles de données existant (Data Vault, Star Schema, Datamart, etc.) ainsi que leurs forces et limitations.  

Connaissance du domaine de la vente au détail et/ou logistique est un atout.  

Bilinguisme essentiel (oral et écrit).  

Forte maitrise de l'environnement Microsoft Office.  

Le titulaire devra se déplacer occasionnellement entre les différents sites de Metro (Laval, Montréal, Varennes, Ontario).  

Forte expérience de travail avec les plateformes de transformations de données de type ETL comme Informatica, Talend, SSIS, etc.  

Une solide expérience de travail de conception et d'optimisation de pipelines de données sur de grands volumes de données structurées et semi structurées.  

Expérience en matière de développement d'entrepôts de données, de modélisation et/ou d'analyse de données.  

Expérience pertinente avec les plateformes de sciences de données tel que AWS, Python, Databricks, Spark, Hortonworks.  

COMPÉTENCES :  

Flexibilité dans la gestion de son quotidien  

Orientation vers un travail/service de qualité  

Connaissances techniques et professionnelles  

Communication interpersonnelle  

Gestion des priorités  

Autonomie  

Apprentissage rapide et soutenu  

Résolution de problèmes


**Ensemble, en tant que propriétaires, mettons notre savoir\-faire à l’œuvre.**  

  

La vie chez CGI est ancrée dans l’actionnariat, le travail d’équipe, le respect et un sentiment d’appartenance. Chez nous, vous pourrez exploiter votre plein potentiel parce que…
  

  

Nous vous invitons à devenir propriétaire dès le jour 1 alors que nous travaillons ensemble à faire de notre rêve une réalité. C’est pourquoi nous nous désignons comme associés de CGI, plutôt que comme employés. Nous tirons profit des retombées de notre succès collectif et contribuons activement à l’orientation et à la stratégie de notre entreprise.  

  

Votre travail crée de la valeur. Vous élaborerez des solutions novatrices et développerez des relations durables avec vos collègues et clients, tout en ayant accès à des capacités mondiales pour concrétiser vos idées, saisir de nouvelles opportunités, et bénéficier d’une expertise sectorielle et technologique de pointe.
  

  

Vous ferez évoluer votre carrière en vous joignant à une entreprise bâtie pour croître et durer. Vous serez soutenus par des leaders qui ont votre santé et bien\-être à cœur et qui vous permettront de saisir des occasions afin de parfaire vos compétences et élargir les horizons.  

  

Chez CGI, nous valorisons la richesse que la diversité apporte et nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement de travail où chacun s’épanouit. jobs.title: Business Analyst - Fintech (Contractor)
jobs.description:
**WE ARE:**



Adaptive is a financial consulting firm that partners with capital, commodity, and digital market participants. We value differentiation through technology. Our experienced teams design and deliver complex front\-office technology solutions using our proven accelerators to create long\-term competitive advantage.



Our clients include the world's leading investment banks, exchanges, investment managers, fintech and capital market service providers. We have a global reach with offices in London, New York, Barcelona, Manila and Montreal. We have a proven track record of delivering powerful, elegant and intuitive trading technology solutions.



We are now looking for a **Business Analyst** for an exciting project in the Financial Crime Surveillance domain, as part of the Digital Onboarding process of a client.

  


**DESCRIPTION OF THE SERVICES:**


* Help stakeholders in making their vision for the product materialize, especially in the early stages of each delivery phase \- ie requirements solicitation and discovery
* Convey that vision to the Adaptive team and define clear milestones for alignment purposes, and so they can make holistic design decisions that will support the delivery
* Create \& maintain a backlog of deliverable stories for the Adaptive team
* Be the stakeholders' proxy in the team, able to make quick, firm decisions when it comes to scope, requirements and prioritization/triage
* Involve Adaptive team members when their perspective can bring value, including times when it can support scope and priority decisions
* Follow up during the implementation and testing phases to ensure delivery satisfies the requirements
* Drive the backlog review and estimation process and take part in planning activities
* Capture non\-functional requirements and keep supportability in mind
* Define acceptance criteria and tests up front as part of a Business\-Driven Development approach
* Use experience with Agile delivery to take advantage of its strengths and mitigate its potential risks
* Work with distributed teams

  


**THE INDIVIDUAL/S PROVIDING THE SERVICES WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING EXPERIENCE:**


* Front office stakeholder relationship management;
* Delivering in an agile environment,
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
* Some experience with QA/Business Acceptance Testing;
* Some experience working with UX designers;
* Some knowledge of client onboarding, client tiering, KYC
* Understanding various software concepts to discuss problems and orchestrate project strategy (including but not limited to: real\-time programming, high availability, TDD, BDD, UX design, DevOps concerns…)
  


**WHAT DO PEOPLE THINK OF US**



You can check our *Glassdoor* page


**THE PROCESS**



Long interview processes are stressful and boring, and that is not us



We want to make sure that everything runs smoothly.



So here there will be a three stage interview process:



1\- A chat with one of our recruiters  

2\- A zoom chat with an Adaptive BA where they will ask detailed questions to assess experience/expertise  

3\- A Face to Face interview (via Zoom)  

  

After these steps have been completed and all goes well, a casual virtual meet\-and\-greet with the client will be scheduled.


**But don't worry; everything will be explained to you step by step by the Adaptive recruiter.**

  


**DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION**:



Diversity and inclusion are key to a great workplace, and Adaptive is better when it's more representative of the world around us. Our colleagues feel comfortable bringing their whole selves to work without any fear of judgment or negativity. All we ask is that anyone providing services here is respectful and collaborative, and has the required skills.

  


**Background check**: the engagement is subject to an acceptable background check that will be run by Adaptive on any Individual/s providing the services.

jobs.description:
**Location: Montreal, Canada \- Hybrid**

In this position, you’ll be based in our Montreal office for a minimum of three days a week, with the flexibility to work from home for part of your working week.


**We give you a world of potential**

Computershare is renowned for its expertise in data management, high volume transaction processing, payments and communications. Many of the world’s leading organizations use these core competencies to help maximize the value of relationships with their investors, employees, creditors, members and customers.


Our vision is to leverage our global network, specialized technology, local and global financial markets expertise and unsurpassed service levels to keep Computershare at the forefront of the industry. As the perfect partner for organizations seeking consolidated tailored solutions and superior service, we constantly strive to widen the gap in quality between us and our competitors.


**A role you will love**

Computershare Technology Services (CTS) provides global technology and infrastructure/support services for existing Computershare proprietary software together with a full range of development services for new products.


CTS globally has approximately 1,500 employees and is made up of Service Delivery, Development Centre of Excellence, Digital Centre of Excellence and 6 technology groups aligned to our global business lines.


The incumbent is part of a team who, collectively, support the migration of data from third party transfer agent’s computer systems.


**Key responsibilities:**

MIGRATIONS


* Co\-ordinate with the business the requirements for new conversions of new clients onto the Computershare proprietary software – SCRIP.
* Inspect the data received from the TA to ensure consistency and correct format.
* Work with the Developers to ensure correct mapping of data and that the Computershare Migration Software displays all information correctly on SCRIP.
* Once the data has been inspected in system testing and we are convinced everything is being displayed correctly, then we advise the business for them to validate and confirm that everything is correct.
* Liaise with the business to confirm everything is correct and receive their confirmation of sign\-off.

CORPORATE ACTIONS


* Plan for upcoming Corporate Actions of an extraordinary nature or large scale.
* Set up the Job Parameters for these extraordinary Corporate Actions.

**What will you bring to the role**

**Required:**

7\+ years experience in Transfer Agency, Employee Equity Plans, Securities Processing, Financial Services Operations, or related industry.


Demonstrated experience leading complex data migrations, corporate actions, system implementations, or operational change projects.


Experience working collaboratively with technology, development, operations, and client\-facing teams.


Proven ability to manage high\-risk operational events with minimal supervision.


Advanced Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas, data analysis).


SQL and database query skills.


Data mapping and conversion experience.


File layout analysis (fixed\-width, CSV, XML, flat file structures).


Systems integration and data validation experience.


Change management and release processes.


JIRA, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, or equivalent work management tools.


Strong stakeholder management.


Influencing without authority.


Critical thinking and root cause analysis.


Ability to manage multiple concurrent high\-priority projects.


Strong decision\-making under tight operational deadlines.


**Preferred:**

Deep understanding of transfer agency operations.


Corporate actions processing expertise.


Shareholder recordkeeping systems.


Employee equity plans and securities processing.


Regulatory and risk considerations associated with corporate actions and shareholder records.


Executive\-level communication skills.


Knowledge of internal Computershare systems, policies and procedures.


**Rewards designed for you**

**Flexible work** to help you find the best balance between work and lifestyle.


**Health and wellbeing** rewards that can be tailored to support you and your family.


**Invest in our busines** s by setting aside salary to purchase shares in our company, and you’ll receive a company contribution as well.


**Extra reward** s ranging from recognition awards and team get togethers to helping you invest in your future. Visit computershare.com/CanadaBenefits for details.


**And more.** Ours is a welcoming and close\-knit community, with experienced colleagues ready to help you grow. Our handbook will help you find out more about our rewards and life at Computershare, visit Computershare.com/careers\-handbook .

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak\-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

jobs.title: PLM Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Location**
------------


This is a hybrid role in Mirabel, Quebec, Canada (Hybrid \- 3 days onsite per week)
**About the Job You’re Considering**
------------------------------------


Join a high\-impact team transforming product lifecycle management for leading global organizations. As a PLM Functional Analyst, you will play a critical role in evaluating, designing, and optimizing PLM solutions that drive efficiency, innovation, and digital transformation across engineering and manufacturing environments. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and IT professionals to deliver best\-in\-class PLM solutions leveraging platforms such as 3DEXPERIENCE, Teamcenter, and Windchill. If you are passionate about solving complex business challenges, improving processes, and enabling organizations to maximize the value of their PLM investments, this role is for you.


**Your Role**
-------------


* Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate PLM capabilities, system integrations, current processes, and operational challenges while identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and stakeholder meetings to gather business requirements and define future\-state solutions aligned with organizational goals.

jobs.description:
**About AlayaCare**
-------------------



At AlayaCare, we're more than just a fast\-growing SaaS company, we're a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud\-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients.


With 550\+ employees across Canada, the US, Australia, and Brazil, we're united by a shared mission and a strong culture of transparency, growth, and human connection. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career.


**About the Role**
------------------



We are seeking a Junior Fullstack Developer (Python) to join our Admission \& Marketplace team. You'll contribute to meaningful projects while learning modern development practices, tools, and workflows, and be supported by mentors who will help you develop both your technical abilities and professional skills. The Admission \& Marketplace initiative in AlayaCare Cloud streamlines referrals, intake coordination, and care planning while enabling providers to collaborate across agencies. By eliminating manual processes like phone calls and faxes, and by empowering agencies to subcontract efficiently, these tools accelerate scheduling, strengthen partnerships, and improve outcomes for businesses, care workers, and clients.
  

  

On the Client Intake front, help transform how home care referrals are received, processed, and coordinated through completely rebuilt intake workflow built around agentic capabilities. Streamline intake operations, reduce manual work, and help agencies move clients into care faster, improving efficiency for care teams and outcomes for clients.  

  

With the Marketplace offering, extend the future of collaboration between care providers. Work on a new Supplier Portal project that simplifies provider onboarding, profile management, and connections between agencies with care needs and available capacity. Unlock new markets, reduce administrative effort, and strengthen partnerships across the home care ecosystem.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Assist in designing, coding, testing, and debugging software features.
* Use GenAI tools to help plan, generate, and test code.
* Pair\-program with senior developers and participate in code reviews to learn best practices.
* Write and maintain automated tests with guidance from team members.
* Help investigate, reproduce, and resolve bugs under supervision.
* Participate in team rituals such as standups, demos, and retrospectives.
* Learn and apply modern development practices, including implementing with AI, CI/CD, containerization, and monitoring.

**What You Bring to the Team**
------------------------------


* Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer engineering, science, or any related fields.
* 1\-2 years\+ professional software engineering experience.
* Familiarity with at least one programming language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or similar).
* Demonstrated interest in AI tools, with a proactive mindset toward integrating them into day\-to\-day work to drive efficiency and innovation.
* Interest in learning development tools and workflows such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker.
* Curiosity about current industry trends in technology, performance, and software development practices.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and non\-technical teammates.
* Interest in developing yourself as a full stack developer, implementing both Front\-End and Back\-End code.
* Bilingual in French and English is considered an asset.

**Why Join AlayaCare?**
-----------------------

### **Work With Purpose**

At AlayaCare, you'll help build technology that empowers care providers and improves outcomes for patients and families. Every line of code and every customer interaction contributes to making care more connected, accessible, and human.


### **Grow in a High\-Trust Culture**

We believe in transparency, feedback, and assuming positive intent. Here, you'll feel safe to share your ideas and career goals, and be supported to achieve them through mentorship, career mobility, and a promote\-from\-within philosophy.


### **Balance That Works for You**

We value flexibility and well\-being. From "Wellness Fridays" to volunteer time off, to flexible vacation, we make sure you have the space to recharge, contribute to your community, and live your best life.


### **Benefits That Matter**

* Equity in a well\-funded, scaling company.
* Comprehensive health benefits, telemedicine, and lifestyle spending accounts.
* Parental leave top\-up and family support programs.

### **Inclusive by Design**

We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster belonging through our DEIB initiatives. Employee\-led events, summits, and social activities, both in\-person and virtual, create meaningful connections across our global teams.


### **Location and Work Model**



This role is based in Montreal. At AlayaCare, our hybrid model includes 2 set in\-office collaboration days/week, and it is expected that team members are present in the office on those days to foster connection, innovation, and teamwork.


### **Ready to Join Us?**

Apply today and be part of a company that makes a real difference in the future of home and community care. Not the right role for you? Share this posting with someone who might be a great fit.


AlayaCare uses AI tools during our hiring process to support fair, consistent, and objective decision\-making. Some initial screening steps may be automated to help identify qualified candidates. If your application is declined automatically, you may request a human review.


*We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone belongs. If you require accommodation during the application process, please reach out to* *careers@alayacare.com**.*

Software Developer – Python, Computer Vision & .NET Backend
jobs.description:
Software Developer – Python, Computer Vision \& .NET Backend

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Software Developer with strong Python skills, practical experience in computer vision or document processing, and solid C\#/.NET backend development capabilities.

You will work on a platform that analyzes HVAC and engineering drawings, extracts symbols and technical information from PDFs, and transforms complex documents into structured data that users can review and use.

A significant part of this role involves developing and improving the core extraction algorithms. You will work with PDF text and vector geometry, optical character recognition (OCR), image processing, symbol matching, and AI vision services to improve accuracy across different drawing formats and layouts.

You will also contribute to the .NET backend, including APIs, databases, document management, asynchronous processing, and integration with the Python extraction services.

We are looking for someone who is hands\-on, analytical, collaborative, and comfortable investigating difficult technical problems and taking improvements through implementation and validation.

This position follows a hybrid work model, with 2 days per week in our Boucherville office and the flexibility to work remotely for the remainder of the week.

**What You Will Do**

* Develop, maintain, and improve Python algorithms for extracting information from technical drawings and PDFs.
* Improve legend detection, symbol extraction, symbol matching, and association of symbols with descriptions, equipment tags, dimensions, and airflow information.
* Combine native PDF text and vector geometry with OCR, image processing, and AI\-assisted analysis.
* Investigate missed detections, incorrect matches, duplicate results, and ambiguous annotations.
* Develop approaches that work across varied drawings, layouts, scales, rotations, and document quality.
* Build evaluation datasets and regression tests to measure extraction accuracy and prevent regressions.
* Optimize processing speed, memory usage, and external AI service costs.
* Design and maintain backend services and REST APIs using C\# and .NET.
* Work with SQL databases, Entity Framework Core, data modelling, and query optimization.
* Improve background processing workflows, message queues, service integrations, retries, and error handling.
* Write clean, maintainable, testable code and participate in code reviews.
* Collaborate with technical teams and domain specialists to translate engineering needs into practical software solutions.
* Document algorithm behavior, technical decisions, and known limitations.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Core Requirements**

* Typically 3–5 years of relevant software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience delivering substantial software projects.
* Strong professional experience with Python.
* Practical experience with computer vision, image processing, OCR, or document extraction.
* Experience using OpenCV, NumPy, or comparable libraries.
* Working experience developing backend services and REST APIs with C\# and .NET.
* Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server.
* Good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and geometric or spatial reasoning.
* Ability to work with coordinates, bounding boxes, image transformations, matching scores, and confidence thresholds.
* Experience with automated testing, debugging, performance profiling, and Git.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate problems systematically.
* Ability to take a requirement from initial discussion through implementation and validation.
* Clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

We welcome candidates whose strongest experience is in Python and extraction algorithms, provided they can also contribute to the .NET backend.

**AI \& Document Processing Experience**

We are especially interested in developers who have practical experience with one or more of the following:

* Extracting text, tables, symbols, or structured information from PDFs.
* Processing engineering drawings, schematics, or CAD\-generated documents.
* OCR integration and reconciliation of recognized text with native document content.
* Template matching, image segmentation, connected components, or shape comparison.
* Associating detected objects with nearby text and annotations.
* Multimodal AI and vision model integration.
* Structured AI outputs and validation.
* Measuring precision, recall, false positives, and false negatives.
* Combining deterministic algorithms with AI services to improve reliability.

You should be comfortable implementing and evaluating extraction logic as well as integrating external AI services.

**Technical Skills**

**Extraction \& Algorithms**

* Python
* OpenCV and NumPy
* PDF processing libraries such as PyMuPDF
* OCR and document layout analysis
* Image processing and geometric reasoning
* Symbol detection and matching
* Algorithm evaluation and performance optimization

**Backend**

* C\# and .NET
* ASP.NET Core and REST APIs
* Entity Framework Core
* Authentication and authorization
* Background processing and asynchronous workflows
* Service integration and error handling

**Databases \& Infrastructure**

* SQL Server or equivalent relational databases
* Data modelling and query optimization
* Object storage
* Message queues and event\-driven processing
* Docker and containerized services

**Nice to Have**

Experience with any of the following would be considered an asset:

* Azure AI Document Intelligence
* Azure AI Foundry or comparable AI platforms
* Azure Blob Storage and Azure Service Bus
* RabbitMQ / Service Bus
* Clean Architecture and separation of application, domain, and infrastructure concerns
* Processing large or complex technical PDFs
* HVAC, mechanical engineering, or construction terminology
* Angular familiarity for collaboration with the frontend team

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Compu

Drive the end\-to\-end testing strategy, including preparation (scripts and data), execution monitoring, and defect resolution management.
  
  

Collaborate closely with delivery managers and centres of expertise to establish test management best practices.
  
  

Manage the lifecycle of our test management platforms and systems (Tricentis qTest and Tosca).

Support the professional development and career growth of your team members.

You are a team player who knows that nothing is possible without the team!

You are a skilled communicator who takes initiative, asks the right questions, and quickly resolves ambiguity.

Do you have other skills? Tell us what makes you unique and why you would be an excellent addition to the team.

*When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.*

#### **Why join us?**

  

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak\-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

  

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

#### **Bombardier’s Benefits Program**

  

With our employees’ well\-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:

* Insurance plans *(Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)*
* Competitive base salary
* Retirement savings plan
* Employee Assistance Program

### **What are your contributions to the team?**


Reporting to a Functional Business Partner, you will support development and implementation of the IT Business Analysis discipline for your assigned business domain with Bombardier Aerospace.  

Your responsibilities include:

* Act as IT Domain Analyst to understand and develop IT strategies for Sales, Services and Technical Publications, translating needs into functional and technical requirements, ensure completeness of system requirements, end\-to\-end process, in alignment with Bombardier strategy and architecture, securing high quality standard and use of best practices, aligned with market trends.

* Work closely with Project Manager (s) and Business Focal (s) addressing scope, solution, planning, budget and handoff to the solution architects working in your business domain.

* Participate in the evolution of the Aerospace IT Reference Architecture and Service Design Patterns.
* Participate in and presenting to the Architecture Review Boards (ARB, DARB) and any project or business related review boards.Control, evaluate and prioritize the Technical Publications demands in collaboration with IT Core functions and Business partners applying an end\-to\-end view, promoting standardization, integration, and foster innovation.
* Provide technical guidance and expertise in troubleshooting problems reported by end\-user(s).
### **How to thrive in this role?**

* You hold a university Degree in Management or Computer Science or equivalent.
* You have 10 years of relevant experience in IT Services and Technical Publications ecosystems.
* You have 5 years of relevant experience: in the field of Architecture, Applications / Business / IT Consulting / Aerospace.

* You possess good verbal and written communication skills.
* You have the ability to express technical concepts effectively, both verbally and in writing.
**Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!**

  

Please note: You don’t need *all* the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

**Company Description**  

Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help create the unknown!

 **Job Description**  

As an IT Financial Planning Analyst at Ubisoft Montréal, you will support budget planning for the information technology department and coordinate financial tracking with the teams involved. You will share findings with IT teams, internal partners and management during monthly and quarterly reviews.

**What you’ll do**

* Serve as a point of contact for **IT department costs**
* Prepare **budget reviews** to help managers track their budgets
* Present **budgets and financial results** to IT management, teams and internal partners
* Work with the **IT Financial Planning team** on monthly closing, including provisions and the financial impact on profit and loss
* Track **hosting and infrastructure transformation project budgets** with the teams involved to anticipate financial impacts

* Review costs to identify **discrepancies and budget risks**
* Help **automate, standardize and improve financial processes**
* Define **performance indicators** to track department activities and transformation project costs
* Improve **activity reports**

  

**Qualifications** **What you bring to the team**

* Use **Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI** to prepare and present financial information
* Communicate **financial results** clearly, including to management
* Organize your work carefully and take initiative
* Review data and summarize **key findings**
* Show an interest in the **video game industry**
* Communicate fluently in **English**, as stated in the original description
* Bring, as assets, skills in **artificial intelligence, automation, VBA, Java and web programming, data science and business intelligence**
* Bring, as assets, experience in **IT finance** and established proficiency with tools such as **Anaplan, MicroStrategy, HFM and PeopleSoft**

  

**Additional Information** **What to send our way**

Information about the team
