jobs.description:
Ministère ou organismeSûreté du Québec
Nombre d’emplois à pourvoir1
Statut d’emploiRégulier
Description du ministère ou de l’organisme  

La Sûreté du Québec est vouée au maintien de la paix, de l’ordre et de la sécurité publique ainsi qu’à la prévention et à la répression du crime. Ses membres assurent la sécurité des personnes et des biens, sauvegardent les droits et les libertés, sont attentifs aux besoins des victimes et collaborent avec la communauté. En tant que police nationale, la Sûreté du Québec soutient la communauté policière, coordonne des opérations policières d’envergure, contribue à l’intégrité des institutions étatiques et assure la sécurité des réseaux de transport qui relèvent du Québec. De plus, elle gère un service central de renseignements qu’elle met à la disposition des autres corps de police.

  

**Vous souhaitez contribuer à la mission policière ?**
  

  

Travailler à la Sûreté du Québec c'est contribuer à des projets porteurs et significatifs qui jouent un rôle déterminant pour
  

assurer la sécurité de l'ensemble de la société québécoise.

  

Renseignements généraux  

L’emploi est à pourvoir au Bureau du développement et du traitement administratif de la Grande fonction de l'administration.


**Mandat de l’unité**


Le Bureau du développement et du traitement administratifs est la porte d'entrée pour toutes les demandes formulées par les clients: il offre de l'assistance à la clientèle en matière de ressources informatiques et matérielles, il gère les activités de la centrale de réservation provinciale et des centrales de réservations régionales ainsi que les services d'hébergement et de réservations de transport, il octroie des accès informatiques aux répertoires partagés et il fait appel aux unités de la Sûreté pour soutenir le client.


**Votre rôle consistera à**


* Fournir une assistance aux utilisateurs du réseau informatique de la Sûreté du Québec lorsqu'ils éprouvent des problèmes avec le matériel bureautique, le réseau, les logiciels et les applications;
* Résoudre les problématiques de premier niveau ayant pour but le rétablissement de la situation dans les plus brefs délais;
* Offrir un soutien de premier niveau pour la radiocommunication, les ordinateurs véhiculaires, les centres de gestion des appels (CGA) de la Sûreté;
* Effectuer le transfert de licence des logiciels entre les usagers et la gestion des accès au réseau informatique.

**Rémunération**


47 119 $ à 66 112 $\*
  

***\*****La rémunération est déterminée en fonction de la pertinence de votre scolarité et de vos expériences en lien avec l’emploi. Par conséquent, il est important de bien les détailler dans votre formulaire d’inscription qui servira de référence.*

  

  

Les montants associés aux différents échelons peuvent être consultés sur le site Web du Secrétariat du Conseil du trésor.
  

  

**Télétravail / Présentiel**


La personne embauchée pourrait être autorisée à effectuer du télétravail à raison d’un maximum de deux jours par semaine, conformément à la Politique\-cadre en matière de télétravail pour le personnel de la fonction publique du Secrétariat du Conseil du trésor.  

  



**Nos avantages distinctifs**


Consultez l’ensemble des conditions de travail de la fonction publique.

  

Profil recherché et modalités de postulation  

**Exigences de l’emploi**


* Détenir un **diplôme d'études collégiales technique avec spécialisation en informatique** ou toute autre discipline jugée pertinente.  

  

  

  

Le candidat qui ne possède pas la scolarité pertinente exigée aux conditions minimales d'admission à la classe d'emploi ou au grade correspondant à un diplôme d'études collégiales technique ou préuniversitaire peut y suppléer en compensant chaque année de scolarité pertinente manquante par une année de scolarité pertinente de niveau égal ou supérieur.


Le candidat peut également compenser ce diplôme en satisfaisant les conditions suivantes :
   

1\- détenir un diplôme d'études collégiales technique ou préuniversitaire non pertinent;
   

2\- détenir une année postsecondaire pertinente qui ne fait pas partie du diplôme mentionnée au point 1\.
  

Le candidat qui ne possède pas la scolarité pertinente visé au paragraphe précédent peut en outre compenser un tel diplôme par un diplôme d’études collégiales technique ou préuniversitaire non pertinent et six années d’expérience pertinente acquises dans un emploi de niveau immédiatement inférieur, collégial ou professionnel.


La candidature d’une personne qui est en voie de terminer la dernière année de scolarité exigée pour l’obtention du diplôme requis pourrait être considérée.
  

  

Pour être considérée, toute scolarité effectuée hors du Canada doit faire l’objet d’une évaluation comparative (attestation d’équivalence) délivrée par le ministère de l’Immigration, de la Francisation et de l’Intégration.
* Posséder la citoyenneté canadienne ou le statut de résident permanent ou un permis de travail émis par l’autorité fédérale compétente.
  

  

Une personne en attente de la preuve de son statut de résident permanent ou d’un permis de travail peut soumettre sa candidature au présent processus de sélection. Toutefois, elle devra être autorisée à travailler légalement au Canada au moment de sa nomination.
* Avoir une connaissance du français appropriée aux fonctions.
  

**Condition à satisfaire pour occuper l’emploi**


* L’obtention de cet emploi est conditionnelle aux résultats d’une enquête de sécurité visant à démontrer qu’aucun élément préoccupant relatif à vos mœurs n’est incompatible avec les fonctions et attributions de cet emploi
  

**Modalités d'inscription**


**Votre candidature devra être soumise au plus tard le 13 octobre 2026, à 23 h 59\.**


Seules les candidatures reçues par le biais de la plateforme de dotation en ligne de la fonction publique seront considérées. Aucun curriculum vitae n’est accepté.


Les documents à l’appui de la candidature seront demandés ultérieurement

jobs.title: Junior Software Programmer
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**

KWESST (A DEFSEC Technologies company) develops and delivers next generation military and public safety technology for military and first responder customers. The company is proudly Canadian and provides Dismounted/Mounted Domain Expertise in Command\-and\-Control software development, integration, and support services.

**Job Description:**

KWESST is seeking a highly skilled Junior Programmer to become a part of our team. This position will be to support the Canadian Armed Forces as part of the Director Land Command Support Program Management (DLCSPM) of the Department of National Defence’s (DND’s) Software Engineering Facility (DSEF) program in Gatineau, Qc.

The ideal candidate should come with a good background in software programming with several high\-level languages. Core responsibilities will involve supporting the design and implementation of DND’s Command and Control Specialty Applications, with a focus on maintaining the reliability and scalability of these applications. This important role will contribute to our mission of developing state\-of\-the\-art software solutions for the Canadian Armed Forces.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Translate detailed flow charts into coded machine instructions and confer with technical personnel in planning programs.
* Design methods and procedures for small computer systems, and sub\-system of larger systems.
* Select and incorporate available software programs.
* Verify accuracy and completeness of programs by preparing sample data and testing them by means of system acceptance test runs made by operating personnel.
* Correct program errors by revising instructions or altering the sequence of operations.
* Test instructions, and assemble specifications, flow charts, diagrams, layouts, programming and operating instructions to document applications for later modification or reference.
* Create and modify code and software.
* Create and modify screens and reports.
* Produce forms, manuals, programs, data files, and procedures for systems and/or applications.

**Qualifications:**

**Experience:**

Demonstrated experience in the following criteria:

* Using at least 1 of the following high\-level languages (ADA (95, 05 or 2012, Java, C\+\+, or C\#).
* Using CASE tools (e.g. Rational Team Concert, JIRA).
* Using a client mandated Software development process (e.g. Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe))
* Demonstrated experience as a Software Programmer within an Integrated Product Team (IPT) for an onsite client.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* SECRET security clearance (or the ability to obtain one) is a must.

**Education:**

A College Diploma in Engineering or Computer Technology field is a must.

**Skills:**

* Scripting and Automation
* SAFe\-Agile practices
* Security and Compliance
* Monitoring and Logging
* Problem Solving
* Collaboration and Communication

**How to Apply:**

If you have a strong passion for critical software development and are eager to join the dynamic team at KWESST for this position, which is located at the DND facilities in Gatineau, QC, we invite you to submit your resume. Please make sure to emphasize your pertinent experience and any certifications you hold.

Salary range for this new position is $45K \- $54K.

**KWESST (A DEFSEC Technologies company)** is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, disability of any other protected status under applicable law. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating a work environment that is inclusive and welcoming to all, including LQBTQ2S\+ individuals. Our hiring decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. In every step of the interview procedure, KWESST is committed to providing accommodations.

Pay: $45,000\.00\-$54,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Extended health care
* Flexible schedule
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* RRSP match
* Vision care

Application question(s):

* A security clearance is mandatory. Do you have an active SECRET security clearance?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Développeur·euse Mobile Staff/ Staff Mobile Developer (iOS&React Native)
jobs.description:
* English version will follow\*


**Localisation :** Canada et États\-Unis (formule hybride)
  
  

**Ta mission au sein de l’équipe mobile :**  

* Donner vie à la prochaine génération de notre application mobile en concevant et en développant principalement des fonctionnalités en React Native et TypeScript.
* Créer des expériences mobiles évolutives, performantes et faciles à maintenir pour iOS et Android.
* Contribuer à l’intégration progressive de modules React Native dans notre base de code iOS et Android native existante et participer à la définition des meilleures pratiques pour une architecture brownfield réussie.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les développeur·euse·s iOS afin d’assurer une cohabitation harmonieuse et efficace entre les composants React Native et Swift.
* Développer des modules natifs ou contribuer à leur développement lorsque certaines fonctionnalités nécessitent une intégration plus poussée avec iOS ou Android.
* Participer aux décisions d’architecture, notamment en évaluant si une fonctionnalité doit être développée en React Native ou nativement.
* Rester à l’affût des nouveaux frameworks, outils et pratiques de l’écosystème React Native, tout en maintenant une solide compréhension du développement mobile natif.
* Améliorer la performance, la stabilité, l’accessibilité et la testabilité de l’application, ainsi que l’expérience des développeur·euse·s.
* Effectuer des révisions de code approfondies en TypeScript et, lorsque pertinent, en Swift, tout en favorisant le partage des connaissances au sein de l’équipe.
* Collaborer avec les équipes Produit, Design, Assurance qualité, Backend et Développement mobile natif afin de définir, développer, tester et déployer de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
* Contribuer aux pratiques d’ingénierie de l’équipe, notamment les tests automatisés, l’intégration et le déploiement continus, la documentation, la gestion des mises en production et la surveillance des applications.
* Accompagner les autres développeur·euse·s et contribuer à la planification technique, aux discussions d’architecture et aux activités de recrutement, selon le niveau d’expérience.
* Promouvoir l’adoption responsable des outils de développement assistés par l’intelligence artificielle pour la génération et la révision de code, les tests, la documentation, le débogage et la refactorisation.


**Ton profil :**  

* Solide expérience professionnelle en développement et en mise en production d’applications mobiles, incluant une expérience pratique significative avec React Native.
* Maîtrise avancée de TypeScript, JavaScript, React et de l’écosystème React Native.
* Expérience avec des applications destinées au grand public et publiées sur l’App Store d’Apple et Google Play.
* Solide compréhension de l’architecture React Native, notamment du bridge, de JSI, des modules natifs et des principes de la nouvelle architecture.
* Expérience avec des outils comme Metro, Hermes, CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, Gradle ainsi qu’avec les outils courants de débogage et d’optimisation des performances de React Native.
* Expérience dans l’intégration de fonctionnalités React Native à une application native existante ou dans un environnement mobile hybride.
* Expérience dans la création, la modification ou l’intégration de modules natifs en Swift, Objective\-C, Kotlin ou Java.
* Bonne connaissance du développement iOS natif. Une expérience avec Swift, SwiftUI ou UIKit constitue un atout important.
* Compréhension des enjeux de performance mobile, notamment le rendu, la gestion de la mémoire, le temps de démarrage de l’application, la gestion de l’état et la communication entre JavaScript et le code natif.
* Familiarité avec les architectures à flux de données unidirectionnel et les approches modernes de gestion de l’état.
* Capacité à participer à des discussions sur la conception logicielle, l’architecture, les patrons de conception et les compromis techniques dans des environnements natifs et multiplateformes.
* Solide compréhension des principes nécessaires pour produire un code clair, cohérent, testable, performant et facile à maintenir.
* Expérience avec les tests unitaires, les tests d’intégration et les tests automatisés pour les applications mobiles.
* Capacité démontrée à collaborer efficacement avec les équipes Produit, Design, Assurance qualité, Backend et Développement mobile afin de définir et de livrer de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
* Solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et capacité à faire des compromis techniques réfléchis, notamment pour déterminer quand utiliser React Native et quand privilégier une solution native.
* Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à transformer les besoins d’affaires et de produit en exigences techniques concrètes.
* Utilisation active d’outils de développement assistés par l’intelligence artificielle, combinée au jugement critique nécessaire pour évaluer, améliorer ou remettre en question les résultats générés.


**Encore mieux si tu détiens :**  

* Une expérience avec la nouvelle architecture de React Native, notamment Fabric et TurboModules.
* Une connaissance de Swift, SwiftUI ou UIKit.
* Une connaissance de Kotlin ou Jetpack Compose.
* Une expérience dans la modernisation ou la migration d’une application native vers React Native.
* Une expérience avec une application mobile destinée au grand public, à grande échelle ou à fort volume d’utilisation.


**Nos avantages et bénéfices :**  

* Environnement de travail hybride : Horaire flexible combinant télétravail et présence au bureau, avec la possibilité de travailler de n'importe où dans le monde jusqu'à 2 mois par année.
* Bien\-être financier : Bonus annuel de performance, bonus à long terme, contribution équivalente au REER, et assurance vie.
* Avantages complets : Assurance santé et invalidité compétitives, compte de dépenses pour ton style de vie, accès à la télémédecine et politique de congés maladie illimités.
* Avantages pour les déplacements : 50% de réd

jobs.title: Digital Resilience Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Digital Resilience Operations Analyst**  

**Location:** Montreal  

**Employment Type:** Permanent  

**Work Mode:** Hybrid – Regular presence in Montreal required  

**Language Requirement:** Professional bilingualism in French and English

**About the Role**
------------------

**ESI Technologies** is a Quebec\-based IT consulting firm with over 32 years of expertise. We support organizations in their digital transformation initiatives across architecture, cybersecurity, cloud computing, data, and IT service management.


We are currently seeking a **Digital Resilience Operations Analyst** who is looking to thrive in a team where building strong, trusted relationships with clients is a top priority.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


As a **Digital Resilience Operations Analyst**, you will be responsible for:

### **Monitoring \& Operations**

* Proactively monitor backup environments (internal and client environments).
* Analyze alerts, identify anomalies, and respond promptly.
* Validate backup success and ensure compliance with operational standards.
* Perform initial analysis and corrective actions.
* Escalate complex incidents efficiently to Level 2 / Level 3 support teams.
* Track incidents and tickets through to resolution.

### **Support \& Client Experience**

* Serve as the first point of contact for operational requests.
* Process backup and restoration requests.
* Ensure thorough follow\-up of tickets until resolution.
* Maintain clear, professional, and proactive communication with clients.
* Produce operational reports on the health and status of client environments.

### **Continuous Improvement \& Automation**

* Contribute to the optimization of operational processes.
* Participate in the documentation and enhancement of procedures.
* Support the onboarding of new clients.
* Collaborate on the automation of MSP operations.

**Required Profile**
--------------------

* Experience in technical support, IT operations, or managed services.
* Basic knowledge of backup and data protection technologies.
* Understanding of Windows, Linux, and virtualization environments.
* Strong analytical mindset and ability to solve problems quickly.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent client communication skills.
* Strong interest in automation and continuous improvement.
* Excellent English and French communication skills, both written and spoken, to support English\- and French\-speaking clients and vendors.

**Assets**
----------

* Experience with **Veeam** and/or within an MSP (Managed Service Provider) environment.
* Knowledge of cloud object storage platforms.
* Knowledge of **PowerShell** or similar scripting languages.

**General Information**
-----------------------

* Occasional work outside regular business hours may be required based on workload demands (e.g., maintenance windows).
* Maintain all required certifications and training, including those required at the time of hiring (or equivalent certifications should requirements evolve).
* Responsibilities may evolve according to business needs.
* Hybrid work is required, including regular presence at ESI's office (or one of its subsidiaries).

**Why Join ESI?**
-----------------

* Work on critical, high\-impact environments.
* Grow within a team of managed services experts.
* Contribute to the expansion of a growing MSP offering across Canada and the United States.
* Develop expertise in modern, in\-demand technologies.
* Play a meaningful role in data protection and business continuity.

**What We Offer**
-----------------


At ESI, we believe our consultants' success is built on meaningful challenges, a collaborative environment, and continuous growth opportunities.

jobs.description:
#### **Role**


The Technical Support Specialist provides second\-level technical assistance nationally, supporting client, company, and end users at the desktop, laptop, printer, network, operating system, point of sale, and infrastructure level. The role covers hardware, software, and software deployment support, remote troubleshooting, and remote escalated support for Field Service Technicians.


Specialists act as a technical resource for resolving complex issues, and advise, install, train, and assist the end\-user community. This second\-level support role is structured in two levels: Level 1 (base) and Level 2 (Intermediate), with Level 2 taking on independent resolution of complex issues, root cause analysis, and mentoring.

#### **Level 1 – Technical Support Specialist**

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Provide responsive, timely remote support to escalated end\-user questions and support requests from Field Service Technicians nationally.
* Act as point of contact for desktop and laptop support and troubleshooting for clients, company, and end users, performing problem determination and resolution of hardware and software issues.
* Troubleshoot computer systems, including hardware, software, email, operating system, network, and peripheral issues; make repairs and corrections where required.
* Remotely assist onsite technicians with the installation and assembly of hardware where required, and configure computers, monitors, network infrastructure, and peripherals such as printers, scanners, POS, and related hardware.
* Install, configure, and upgrade operating systems and standard business software, including remotely supporting imaging and software deployment following established procedures.
* Remotely direct onsite technicians on cabling and rewiring as required for new installations and office reconfigurations.
* Validate that systems work as expected before handing them back to users.
* Ensure all incidents are properly logged, triaged, routed, escalated, and closed in accordance with pre\-determined service levels and incident management processes.
* Ensure client technology requirements and the set\-up and configuration of desktop hardware, software, and local and network printers are accurately determined, documented, and satisfied.
* Document configurations, technical issues, and resolutions accurately and completely, and maintain accurate asset and configuration records.
* Assist with training staff on standard business and administrative software (word processing, spreadsheets, database management), providing instruction or written documentation where required.
* Escalate outstanding and unresolved issues to the Senior Manager, Technical Services and Senior Director, Professional Services within the time requirements set out in service contracts.
* Follow established security policies, change management processes, and industry best practices.
* Maintain current knowledge of the hardware and software technologies in use by client, company, and end users to provide technically accurate solutions.

#### **Level 2 – Technical Support Specialist (Intermediate)**


In addition to all Level 1 responsibilities, Level 2 requires:

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Independently troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware and operating system issues with minimal supervision.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and recommend permanent corrective actions.
* Remotely support and train Level 1 specialists and Field Service Technicians nationally through technical guidance and knowledge sharing.
* Participate in infrastructure upgrade and migration projects as required.
* Maintain technical documentation, support standards, and operational procedures.

#### **Requirements**

**Level 1**

* College diploma or university degree in Computer Science, Computer Studies, Information Technology, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 2–3 years of related technical support experience.
* Working and advanced knowledge of IT hardware and equipment installation, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and support.
* Strong customer service orientation, interpersonal skills, and verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Detail oriented, with strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team while meeting service level agreements (SLAs).
* CompTIA A\+ is a strong asset; Microsoft Certified credentials are an asset.

**Level 2 (in addition to Level 1\)**

* 4–5\+ years of progressive IT infrastructure or systems administration experience.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, DNS, routing, switching).
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity best practices and endpoint security.
* Microsoft Certified, CompTIA Linux\+, LPIC, Red Hat, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), or equivalent certifications are highly desirable.

#### **Working Conditions**

* This is a hybrid position, working from a BFG office and from home.
* Must be able and willing to work rotating shifts, including nights for extended periods, evenings, weekends, and holidays, to support a 24/7 client service environment.
* Must have a valid driver’s license and access to a vehicle; public transit is not reliable during night shift rotations.

#### **May be required to work onsite at customer locations from time to time.**

### **Job Description**


Ready to build your career? We want to hear from you.
Within the Enterprise Solutions department, the IT Coordinator / Scrum Master supports multidisciplinary delivery teams in the planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of their activities.
  

  

The incumbent acts as a facilitator and operational coordination point between developers, analysts, architects, Product Owners, project managers, and stakeholders to help ensure efficient and predictable delivery of enterprise solutions. They combine a strong understanding of Agile delivery practices with hands\-on experience coordinating work, managing dependencies, facilitating team collaboration, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives.
  

  

Under the guidance of delivery and technology leadership, the IT Coordinator / Scrum Master helps teams maintain visibility into priorities, commitments, risks, and progress while fostering accountability and team effectiveness. The role requires a high degree of autonomy and influence but does not include people management responsibilities, final business prioritization decisions, solution architecture ownership, technical leadership, or full project management accountability.
What you will do
  

  

* Partner with delivery teams and stakeholders to coordinate work, priorities, dependencies, and commitments.
* Support sprint planning, estimation, capacity management, and delivery tracking activities.
* Maintain visibility on delivery progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and key milestones.
* Ensure Jira and other delivery management tools contain accurate and up\-to\-date information.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Promote Agile best practices and support teams in improving delivery effectiveness and ways of working.
* Remove or help resolve delivery obstacles and escalate issues that require leadership intervention.
* Coordinate activities required to support releases and operational delivery objectives.
* Monitor and communicate delivery metrics, status updates, risks, and action items to stakeholders.
* Foster collaboration, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.
* Support onboarding of new team members and contribute to the adoption of consistent delivery practices.

  

  

This role could be for you if you have
  

  

* A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
* A minimum of 3 years of experience in Agile delivery, project coordination, Scrum Master, or a similar role.
* Experience working within multidisciplinary teams delivering digital products, applications, or enterprise solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira or similar tools for backlog, sprint, workflow, and delivery management.
* Experience managing priorities, dependencies, and competing deliverables in a dynamic environment.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with SAFe, Agile certifications, or Project Management certifications (an asset).
* Experience in the construction industry or with enterprise platforms (an asset).

  

You will also stand out if you have
  

  

* The ability to influence and lead without formal authority.
* Strong organizational, facilitation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent judgment, autonomy, and attention to detail.
* A collaborative mindset and passion for continuous improvement.

  

* The ability to simplify complex information and communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences.
Benefits
* RRSP with up to 5% employer matching

  

* Hybrid work model for corporate roles
* Employee stock ownership program
* Career growth through real development opportunities
* Transit pass reimbursement — get to work for free
* Minimum 4 weeks of vacation from day one

Required qualifications  

University degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field.  

Experience in SAP security or SAP authorization management.  

Strong understanding of the SAP roles, profiles, and authorizations model.  

Experience analyzing and managing segregation of duties (SoD).

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer, Emergency Call Handling
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


**Aperçu de l’entreprise**

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez\-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez\-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Emergency Call Handling is the critical interface for the citizen into the command center, public safety workflow. We are the leading solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 call centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. We are part of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise, where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness. This software developer position will be a member of the team working on software applications for Public Safety.
  

  

Présentation du département:
  

La gestion des appels d'urgence est l'interface essentielle du citoyen avec le centre de commandement et le flux de travail de la sécurité publique. Nous sommes le principal fournisseur de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence, le logiciel qui permet aux centres d'appels 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres d'appels de la sécurité publique (CASP) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. Nous faisons partie de la division Logiciels d'entreprise (Software Enterprise) de Motorola Solutions, où sont développées des innovations pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, à la répartition des intervenants et à la connaissance de la situation. Ce poste de développeur de logiciels fait partie de l'équipe travaillant sur des applications logicielles pour la sécurité publique.
**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the team developing the VESTA 9\-1\-1 Call Handling solution. In this role, you will leverage agentic AI to build applications, automate DevOps and Cybersecurity workflows, improving quality and operational efficiency.  



  

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real\-time pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. You’ll help influence architecture, build core product features, and shape how our team uses AI agents to move faster without compromising reliability, security, or product quality. We encourage engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission\-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships.

  

  

What You’ll Do


* Develop components for and integrate services into our Emergency Call Handling Systems
* Develop Agentic AI\-powered automation workflows to improve efficiency of our DevOps and Cybersecurity tasks.
* Help integrate AI techniques to improve evaluation, testing, and observability for our systems.
* Get your hands dirty setting up and configuring hardware and software, including network devices and servers.
* Build strong habits around tests, code review, observability, and security from day one.
* Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.
  

  

You Might Be a Fit If


* You enjoy converting manual, tedious procedures to autonomous AI\-powered workflows then jumping onto the next high\-impact challenge.
* You’re curious about working across backend, infrastructure, AI, and product, even if you haven’t done it all yet.
* You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.
* You care about quality — you write tests, read documentation, and try to understand a system before you change it.
* You take feedback well and act on it.
* You have strong product instincts and care about the humans using what you build.
* You thrive in a team where you’ll have real ownership early — and you’re comfortable asking for help.
  

  

Relevant Experience


We don’t expect you to have shipped production systems. We care most about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity, curiosity, and how you think. Coursework, internships, research, and personal projects all count.


Relevant exposure may include:


* Projects involving AI agents, AI pipelines or RAG systems.
* Real\-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low\-latency audio transport.
* Exposure to DevOps, Automation and CI/CD systems using tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins, Github, Artifactory
* Programming in Python, C\#, C\+\+, Java, or similar languages
* Comfortable scripting in both Linux and Windows and virtualization.
* Telephony and voice infrastructure, including PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.
  

  

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Most successful candidates will have experience in a few and curiosity to learn the rest.

  

  

Target Base Salary Range: $70,000 \- $90,000 CAD

jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.description:
At Web Hosting Canada (WHC), we’re passionate about helping Canadians succeed online with reliable, locally focused web hosting services. Since 2003, we’ve empowered businesses and individuals with top\-notch websites, domains, and email solutions.

  

If you’re looking for a dynamic, caring environment and you’re excited by the idea of building the interfaces thousands of Canadians rely on to manage their websites, domains, and email, we’d love to have you join our team.

 **The Opportunity**


Reporting to a Software Development Lead, you’ll build the interfaces our customers use to manage their websites, domains, and email, working in a squad with back\-end developers and designers. This role has two sides. The first is our modern platform: a React front\-end built in 2026 (React 19, Vite, Tailwind, TanStack Query, React Hook Form) where nearly all new feature work lands. It’s bilingual and accessible by default, built on our own components rather than a library, and developed with AI assistance as a normal part of the job.


The second is everything that came before: a large, working platform still running on jQuery, Bootstrap, and PHP\-rendered pages that isn’t disappearing anytime soon. Our React app mounts inside those older pages, so both worlds are often live on the same screen, and getting that right takes real hands\-on judgment. Pure greenfield React will frustrate you here; if you enjoy making old and new coexist properly, this is an unusually interesting job.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build features on our React platform: responsive, bilingual, accessible, tested.
* Maintain and extend the existing jQuery and PHP\-templated interfaces, including where our React app is embedded inside them.
* Turn designs into working interfaces, and tell us when a design won’t survive contact with real data or a second language.
* Build reusable components, since we maintain our own rather than depending on a library.
* Consume our internal APIs, and push back when a response shape makes the front end harder than it needs to be.
* Test and troubleshoot across browsers, screen sizes, and both of our host applications.
* Use AI tooling as part of your normal workflow, and help us get better at using it well.

**What You Bring**

* Several years building production front ends, with real depth in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS; we care more about range and judgment than an exact number of years.
* Modern component\-framework experience, ideally React. Strong Vue, Angular, or Svelte developers ready to switch are welcome; we’d rather that than someone who’s only followed React tutorials.
* Genuine comfort with the older stack, jQuery, direct DOM work, Bootstrap\-era CSS, server\-rendered templates; not nostalgia, it’s a large share of the work.
* Enough PHP to be useful, or the willingness to get there quickly; you won’t write our back end, but you’ll read PHP templates to find where your interface renders.
* CSS you can actually reason about: specificity, cascade, layout, and what happens when two eras of stylesheet collide.
* Accessibility as a habit, not a checklist; since we build our own components, nobody hands us correct keyboard behaviour and ARIA wiring for free.
* Working knowledge of building for two languages. Our interfaces ship in English and French together; a string that only exists in one is a bug, not a follow\-up ticket.
* Git, and comfort on a Linux command line.
* WordPress or a comparable CMS, ideally with custom plugin or theme work.
* An understanding of how web hosting and domain names work: the one thing we can’t teach quickly, and what separates a good front\-end developer from a good front\-end developer here.
* Deliberate use of AI in your work; we want to hear where it has genuinely made you faster and where it has burned you.
* Autonomy and reliability, with real care about what the end user experiences.
* Fluency in both English and French, written and spoken, to work with our Quebec\-based team, customers, and international partners.
* Must pass a security background check.

**Nice to Have**

* An eye for visual design and comfort working from design files.
* SEO fundamentals.
* Experience with a component or design system.
* Testing experience (we use Vitest and React Testing Library).

**Why Join WHC?**

* A collaborative team culture where your work is visible, your decisions matter, and your impact is meaningful.
* A Canadian, independent company with a clear market identity, a loyal customer base, and a strong focus on helping Canadians succeed online.
* An AI\-forward environment where we’re actively exploring how AI can improve how we build, operate, and support customers.
* Competitive compensation and benefits with a flexible hybrid work model.
* Access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities.
* Frequent gatherings, lively 5à7s, a vibrant social club, and memorable holiday parties.
* A bright, renovated office in Little Italy with a fully stocked kitchen and a game room featuring ping\-pong, foosball, Nintendo, Nerf guns, and a library.
* Certified a Great Place to Work® for five years running, because we believe work should be fun, fulfilling, and rewarding.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**


If you’re a front\-end developer who’s comfortable moving between a modern React platform and the legacy stack that still runs the business, and who genuinely cares about what the end user experiences, we want to hear from you.


Apply today and help us build the interfaces that keep WHC’s platform accessible, reliable, and easy to use for thousands of Canadians.

*WHC is an equal\-opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including those with diverse backgrounds and abilities.*

jobs.title: Développeur(euse) Frontend
jobs.description:
Chez Web Hosting Canada (WHC), nous sommes passionnés par le fait d’aider les Canadiens à réussir en ligne grâce à des services d’hébergement web fiables et axés sur le marché local. Depuis 2003, nous aidons les entreprises et les particuliers à réussir grâce à des solutions de qualité en matière de sites web, de domaines et de courriel.

  

Si vous cherchez un environnement dynamique et humain, et que l’idée de construire les interfaces sur lesquelles des milliers de Canadiens comptent pour gérer leurs sites Web, leurs noms de domaine et leur courriel vous enthousiasme, nous serions ravis de vous compter parmi nous.

 **L’occasion**


Relevant d’un chef d’équipe de développement logiciel, vous construirez les interfaces que nos clients utilisent pour gérer leurs sites Web, leurs noms de domaine et leur courriel, au sein d’une équipe qui réunit des développeurs back\-end et des designers. Ce poste a deux facettes. La première, c’est notre plateforme moderne : une plateforme front\-end en React bâtie en 2026 (React 19, Vite, Tailwind, TanStack Query, React Hook Form) où se fait pratiquement tout le nouveau développement. Elle est bilingue et accessible par défaut, construite sur nos propres composants plutôt que sur une bibliothèque externe, et développée avec l’assistance de l’IA comme partie normale du travail.


La seconde, c’est tout ce qui existait avant : une grande plateforme bien vivante qui roule toujours sur jQuery, Bootstrap et des pages générées en PHP, et qui ne disparaîtra pas de si tôt. Notre application React s’intègre à l’intérieur de ces pages plus anciennes, ce qui veut dire que les deux univers cohabitent souvent dans le même écran, et bien faire les choses demande un vrai jugement technique. Si vous ne voulez que du React en terrain neuf, ce poste vous frustrera. Si vous aimez faire cohabiter l’ancien et le nouveau comme il faut, c’est un travail particulièrement intéressant.

**Ce que vous ferez**

* Développer des fonctionnalités sur notre plateforme React : adaptatives, bilingues, accessibles, testées.
* Entretenir et faire évoluer les interfaces existantes en jQuery et en gabarits PHP, y compris aux endroits où notre application React s’y intègre.
* Transformer les maquettes en interfaces fonctionnelles, et nous dire quand une maquette ne survivra pas au contact de données réelles ou d’une deuxième langue.
* Créer des composants réutilisables, puisque nous maintenons les nôtres plutôt que de dépendre d’une bibliothèque.
* Consommer nos API internes, et nous le signaler lorsqu’une réponse mal structurée complique inutilement le travail côté front\-end.
* Tester et déboguer sur différents navigateurs, différentes tailles d’écran et nos deux applications hôtes.
* Intégrer les outils d’IA à votre travail quotidien, et nous aider à mieux les utiliser collectivement.

**Ce que vous apportez**

* Plusieurs années d’expérience en développement front\-end en production, avec une réelle profondeur en JavaScript, HTML et CSS; l’étendue et le jugement comptent plus qu’un nombre précis d’années.
* De l’expérience avec un cadriciel à composants moderne, idéalement React. Une personne solide en Vue, Angular ou Svelte prête à passer à React est bienvenue; nous préférons cela à quelqu’un qui n’a suivi que des tutoriels React.
* Une aisance véritable avec la pile technologique plus ancienne, jQuery, manipulation directe du DOM, CSS de l’époque Bootstrap, gabarits générés côté serveur; ce n’est pas de la nostalgie, c’est une part importante du travail.
* Assez de PHP pour être utile, ou la volonté d’y arriver rapidement; vous n’écrirez pas notre back\-end, mais vous lirez des gabarits PHP pour trouver où votre interface est générée.
* Un CSS que vous comprenez réellement : spécificité, cascade, mise en page, et ce qui arrive quand deux époques de feuilles de style se heurtent.
* L’accessibilité comme réflexe, pas comme case à cocher; comme nous créons nos propres composants, personne ne nous fournit gratuitement la navigation au clavier et le câblage ARIA corrects.
* Une bonne connaissance du développement bilingue. Nos interfaces sont livrées en français et en anglais ensemble; une chaîne de caractères qui n’existe que dans une seule langue est un bogue, pas un billet de suivi.
* Git, et de l’aisance en ligne de commande sous Linux.
* WordPress ou un système de gestion de contenu comparable, idéalement avec du développement d’extensions ou de thèmes sur mesure.
* Une compréhension du fonctionnement de l’hébergement Web et des noms de domaine : la seule chose que nous ne pouvons pas enseigner rapidement, et ce qui distingue une bonne personne en développement front\-end d’une bonne personne en développement front\-end chez nous.
* Une utilisation réfléchie de l’IA dans votre travail; nous voulons savoir où elle vous a réellement fait gagner du temps, et où elle vous a joué des tours.
* Autonomie et fiabilité, avec un souci réel de l’expérience vécue par la personne utilisatrice.
* Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit, pour travailler avec notre équipe basée au Québec, notre clientèle et nos partenaires internationaux.
* Réussite d’une vérification des antécédents en matière de sécurité.

**Atouts**

* Un sens du design visuel et de l’aisance à travailler à partir de fichiers de conception.
* Les principes de base du référencement (SEO).
* De l’expérience avec un système de composants ou de design.
* De l’expérience en tests (nous utilisons Vitest et React Testing Library).

**Pourquoi vous joindre à WHC?**

* Une culture d’équipe collaborative où votre travail est visible, où vos décisions comptent et où votre impact est significatif.
* Une entreprise canadienne et indépendante, dotée d’une identité de marché claire, d’une clientèle fidèle et d’une réelle volonté d’aider les Canadiens à réussir en ligne.
* Un environnement tourné vers l’IA, où nous explorons activement comment l’IA peut améliorer notre façon de bâtir, d’exploiter et de soutenir nos clients.
*

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst (Sales Product Management Portfolio)
jobs.description:
**Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.**


At Air Canada, we are passionate about building great product experiences that help our customers travel the world. As the company continues to evolve, Product Management and IT play a leading role across the customer journey. We are investing not only in what and how we build, but also in a collaborative, outcome\-focused culture.


Air Canada seeks a highly motivated, analytical, and detail\-oriented Technical Business Analyst to join the IT team supporting the Sales Product Management portfolio. The successful candidate will translate business objectives and customer needs into clear, testable requirements and solution outcomes. Working closely with Sales, Distribution, Digital, Commercial, Contact Centres, IT delivery teams, and SaaS providers, this role will help deliver integrated capabilities that support sales growth, strengthen agency and corporate customer experiences, and advance Air Canada’s commercial strategy.

**Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners to understand the product vision, roadmap, portfolio priorities, KPIs, and intended business outcomes.
* Lead business and technical analysis for sales\-related capabilities, from discovery and problem definition through implementation and post\-release optimization.
* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate functional and non\-functional requirements through interviews, workshops, process reviews, data analysis, and solution walkthroughs.
* Translate business needs into clear features, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process flows, data mappings, interface requirements, and traceability artifacts.
* Assess current\-state and future\-state business processes, identify gaps and dependencies, and recommend practical improvements that increase customer adoption, operational efficiency, and solution quality.
* Collaborate with Solution Managers, System Architects, developers, quality assurance teams, Release Train Engineers, cybersecurity, data teams, and external partners to support feasible and scalable solution designs.
* Analyze system integrations and end\-to\-end impacts across sales, distribution, digital, commercial, contact centre, and third\-party platforms.
* Maintain a well\-defined and delivery\-ready backlog by supporting refinement, prioritization, estimation, dependency management, and readiness for Program
* Increment and sprint planning.
* Support the Product Manager in defining PI objectives, release scope, milestones, assumptions, risks, and measurable outcomes.
* Facilitate stakeholder workshops, solution reviews, backlog refinement sessions, demos, and other forums that create shared understanding and timely decisions.
* Work with SaaS providers to clarify product capabilities, configuration options, roadmap alignment, release impacts, defects, service issues, and delivery commitments.
* Collaborate with QA and business teams to develop test scenarios and acceptance criteria, support system and integration testing, coordinate business validation and user acceptance testing, and help assess release readiness.
* Investigate production issues and business\-reported defects by documenting symptoms, impacts, expected behaviour, evidence, and resolution requirements.  

Create and maintain concise documentation for requirements, processes, decisions, data, integrations, controls, operating procedures, and handovers to support teams.
* Support change readiness and adoption by contributing to impact assessments, stakeholder communications, training materials, release notes, and operational transition plans.
* Provide analysis and inputs for business cases, portfolio reporting, technology estimates, benefits tracking, adoption metrics, risks, and executive updates.
* Promote consistent analysis practices, reusable templates, continuous improvement, and effective collaboration across business and technology teams.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Approximately 4 or more years of experience in business analysis, technical analysis, product delivery, sales enablement, commercial technology, or a related field.

jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About Behavox**



Behavox is a cloud\-native AI company providing an integrated controls platform for global banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, insurance businesses, and commodity firms. The platform unifies communications and trade surveillance, compliant archiving, policy management as well as front\-office analytics on a single, AI\-native technology stack, delivered as a globally scalable SaaS\-based cloud service.



At Behavox, our engineering culture is built around speed, experimentation, and technical excellence, following agile principles and rapid iteration. We constantly test and adopt the latest cloud technologies and AI tooling, optimising for fast feedback loops and execution. We look for people who can move fast, challenge conventional wisdom, and who want to work at the frontier of modern AI, SaaS platforms, and distributed systems.



Behavox is a high\-performance organisation with a strong bias toward delivery, ownership, and responsibility. We commit, and we execute. We are building systems that are complex, mission\-critical, and global in scale; systems that many consider too large or too difficult. To do that, we seek the smartest, most technically capable engineers and technologists who take end\-to\-end responsibility and want to win by building what others cannot.



Founded in 2014 and backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Behavox is headquartered in London, with offices worldwide, including New York City, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, and Tokyo.


### **About the Role**



The Senior FP\&A Analyst owns Behavox's core financial model — its architecture, the accounting beneath it, and the forecasts and analysis the company plans and decides by. The role exists to change decisions, not report them: it turns the numbers into the choices leadership actually faces. It reads and integrates budgets into the model, but does not run the budgeting cycle.



The same analyst builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro\-forma models behind every acquisition — evaluating targets, running diligence, and folding closed deals into a single consolidated view. This work is periodic and must be carried alone when it arrives; the steady state is the operating model and SaaS forecasting.



This is a high\-autonomy role that works without a detailed brief and sets the modeling standard others build on. It is accountable for the accuracy and integrity of the numbers, and for turning them into recommendations sharp enough to act on — the downside case included, not just the point estimate — for senior leadership, the board, and investors. It pressure\-tests the assumptions behind every result, works fluently with modern tooling and AI, and compounds that edge by learning relentlessly. Its influence comes from the rigor and reach of the analysis, not from authority: it owns the model and the truth it tells, not the decisions made from it.


### **What You'll Bring**


* **Financial Model \& Accounting Foundations** — Knows how an integrated three\-statement and operating model fits together, and the accounting that holds it up — SaaS revenue recognition and cost treatment included. Understands exactly how the company's budgets are built, and folds them into the model.


* **Forecasting \& SaaS Unit Economics** — Knows both bottom\-up short\-term forecasting and driver\-based long\-term modeling, and the SaaS metrics that actually reveal performance. Knows what moves each one and which lever changes it — not just how to report it.


* **Mergers, Acquisitions \& Integration** — Knows how to value an acquisition and how to fold it into one consolidated model: purchase accounting, combined\-entity projections, and the mechanics that make or break the integration.


* **Business \& Commercial Acumen** — Knows in depth how the business and every function make money — the revenue drivers, the cost structure, the operating levers — and spots a number that doesn't add up on sight.


* **Financial Systems \& AI Tooling** — Commands Google Sheets and Excel, and tracks the AI and automation landscape closely enough to know where it is trustworthy and where it isn't.


### **What You'll Do**


* **Financial Model Ownership** — Builds and maintains the core three\-statement and operating model with scenario and sensitivity layers, and keeps it accurate, clean, and easy to maintain. Integrates budgets without owning the cycle, and owns the accuracy of every output and the integrity of every assumption.


* **Acquisition Modeling \& Integration** — Builds the valuations, scenarios, and pro\-forma combined\-entity models behind acquisition evaluation and due diligence, and folds closed deals into a single consolidated view.


* **Business\-Review Reporting** — Drives much of the substance of the monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews — with the broader FP\&A team — for senior management, the board, and investors, turning the model into a narrative that explains what moved the results and what it means for the business.


* **Metrics Analysis \& Business Partnering** — Diagnoses why the metrics are moving and which lever changes them, pressure\-tests the assumptions behind every result, and hands the decision\-maker a recommendation they can act on.


* **AI\-Enabled Productivity** — Uses AI and spreadsheet automation to compress cycle time and harden data validation — automating the recurring work while keeping judgment on what stays manual.


### **What We Offer**

* The opportunity to work on a global, mission\-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies.
* A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence.
* A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, and an equity award aligned with long\-term value creation.
* Modern, comfortable offices in Toronto and Montreal. This is a hybrid

Designed for municipalities, community centers, nonprofits, businesses, and recreation organizations, **Amilia SmartRec™** streamlines operations, optimizes facility management, and simplifies program and membership management.


Since 2009, Amilia has been on a mission to revolutionize how communities connect and participate in activities. By combining cutting\-edge technology with deep industry expertise, the software empowers organizations to manage registrations, memberships, facilities, and finances more efficiently while enhancing community engagement.


Over 1,500 organizations across 6,600 locations in North America rely on Amilia to serve 4\.5 million participants and process $750M in transactions annually.


Caring is at the core of Amilia’s culture: for customers, tailored products, and colleagues alike. Driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for innovation, this mindset shapes everything we do.

  

Revenue Operations is a newly built function at Amilia, reporting to the COO, responsible for connecting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance into one operating system across the customer journey. Salesforce is our system of record, and RevOps owns every tool that touches it.

### **What you can expect:**


This is the first dedicated systems and tools hire inside RevOps. Reporting directly to the Director of Revenue Operations, you'll own the tools the GTM team runs on, and make them actually work: configuring the objects, building the flows, wiring the integrations, fixing the data, and using AI\-assisted development to move faster than a traditional admin queue allows.


Claude and Claude Code are already how this team builds, and you'll be expected to work the same way, not layer AI on as an afterthought.


You'll also help shape a function that's still being built: a RevOps team that already works AI\-natively, with the tooling and the mandate to use it, not just permission to ask. It's a category\-leading vertical\-SaaS environment with real technical depth in the systems you'd be running.

### **You will be responsible for:**

**Salesforce Administration**

* Declarative configuration: flows, validation rules, page layouts, permission sets, profiles, reports, and dashboards.
* User and license management, security review, and the field\-level hygiene that keeps Salesforce trustworthy as the system of record.
* Triage and close out the standing data\-quality and config backlog (duplicate records, broken flows, permission gaps, stale automation), work currently split between the Director and an external agency.
* Partner with the Director on architectural decisions such as object\-model changes and taxonomy rebuilds, and own the build, not just the ticket queue.

**Marketing \& GTM Tooling**

* Administer the martech stack RevOps is responsible for: HubSpot (workflows, lead scoring, campaign operations), Chili Piper (lead routing), Propensity (ABM), Fathom, RocketLane, CLM/quoting tools, and the sales\-engagement and cadence tooling inside Salesforce.
* Keep every tool's integration back to Salesforce clean. Salesforce is the hub, so nothing you administer should create a parallel data store.
* Support tool evaluation and pilots: set up trials, define what “pass” looks like, and carry a pilot into permanent operation once it earns its place in the stack.

**Data \& Reporting Infrastructure**

* Own the connective tissue between Salesforce, the marketing stack, and the reporting layer: keeping syncs, exports, and integrations running, and diagnosing them fast with the analytics engineer when they break.
* Build, maintain, and simplify the Salesforce reports, dashboards, and light data pipelines RevOps and its stakeholders depend on day to day, and support the shift to our “source of truth” cloud data\-lake reporting system as we build it out in 2027\.
* Work alongside the data/analytics function on schema and warehouse questions without owning deep analytics engineering. This is the operational admin seat, not the data\-architect seat.

**AI\-Native Systems Work**

* Use Claude and Claude Code as a standard part of how you build and maintain configuration: SFDX metadata changes, bulk data fixes, scripted QA, and automation that a point\-and\-click admin workflow would make too slow or too manual to attempt.
* Bring judgment about what to automate and what not to. AI makes bad changes cheap to ship, so config changes still get scoped, tested, and reviewed like engineering work, not shipped straight to production.

### **What we want from you:**

* 2 to 4 years of hands\-on Salesforce administration (Sales Cloud). Salesforce Administrator certification preferred, not required.
* Hands\-on, shippable experience with at least one AI coding/automation tool (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as a real part of your workflow today. This is a must\-have, not a nice\-to\-have, and you can point to something you've actually shipped with one.
* Experience administering at least one marketing automation or sales\-engagement platform (HubSpot, Marketo, Salesloft, Pardot, or similar).
* Comfortable writing basic SQL for data checks and light scripting for automation.
* You've administered Salesforce for real users in production, not a sandbox project, and you know the line between what's safe to build declaratively and what needs escalation.
* You default to fixing the data and the configuration, not building a report on top of the problem.
* You're comfortable inheriting and prioritizing your own backlog; this role starts with significant standing technical debt, not a clean system.
* You ask "does this write back to Salesforce cleanly?" before you ask "does this tool look nice?"
* Bonus: exposure to a CPQ/quoting tool, a contract lifecycle management (CLM) tool, or a data warehouse/BI layer.

* A competitive

jobs.description:
**VERSION FRANÇAISE**

**MAAT\-DAT Consulting Inc. recrute : Experts en données et DevOps**

**À PROPOS DE MAAT\-DAT CONSULTING INC.**  
MAAT\-DAT Consulting Inc. est une société de conseil spécialisée en données. En pleine croissance, nous bâtissons une équipe d'experts pour accroître notre capacité à livrer des mandats à forte valeur ajoutée auprès de nos clients. Nous recherchons plusieurs profils pour compléter notre équipe.

**PROFIL 1 – Data Engineer**

**Responsabilités**

* Concevoir, documenter et implanter des pipelines de données évolutifs (API, bases de données, fichiers, temps réel).
* Développer des solutions multinuages (Azure, AWS) sur Databricks et Snowflake.
* Optimiser la performance et les coûts des traitements, et assurer la qualité des données.

**Compétences recherchées**

* 5 ans et plus en ingénierie de données, Python et Spark; 4 ans et plus avec Databricks.
* Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake; BigQuery, un atout.
* AWS : S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, EMR; Kinesis ou MSK, un atout.
* Solide expérience en SQL, modélisation et entreposage de données.

**PROFIL 2 – Data Scientist**

**Responsabilités**

* Traduire les enjeux d'affaires en solutions d'apprentissage automatique.
* Concevoir, entraîner, mettre en production et surveiller des modèles (performance, dérive, fiabilité).
* Mettre en place des mécanismes d'alerte et de réentraînement selon les bonnes pratiques MLOps.

**Compétences recherchées**

* 5 ans et plus en science des données; maîtrise de Python (pandas, scikit\-learn, PySpark) et de SQL.
* Expérience démontrée en mise en production et monitoring de modèles (data drift, model drift, alertes).
* MLflow, Databricks, SageMaker ou Azure ML; Bedrock, Docker, PyTorch ou TensorFlow, des atouts.
* Maîtrise ou doctorat en statistique, mathématiques ou informatique, un atout.

**PROFIL 3 – Data Architect**

**Responsabilités**

* Définir l'architecture de données cible des clients en lien avec leur stratégie d'affaires.
* Concevoir des architectures multinuages (entrepôt, lac, *lakehouse*, *Data Mesh*) intégrant Databricks et Snowflake.
* Établir les normes de modélisation, de qualité, de sécurité et de gouvernance; contribuer aux avant\-ventes.

**Compétences recherchées**

* 8 ans et plus en données, dont 3 ans en architecture.
* Expertise en modélisation (Kimball, Data Vault, dimensionnelle), Databricks (Unity Catalog) et Snowflake.
* AWS : S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, Lake Formation, IAM, KMS, VPC; écosystème Azure.
* Connaissance de la gouvernance, des métadonnées et du FinOps.

**PROFIL 4 – DevOps Engineer**

**Responsabilités**

* Concevoir, automatiser et maintenir l'infrastructure infonuagique des plateformes de données (Azure, AWS).
* Mettre en place et optimiser les chaînes CI/CD pour les pipelines de données et les modèles d'apprentissage automatique.
* Assurer la sécurité, la surveillance, la fiabilité et l'optimisation des coûts des environnements.

**Compétences recherchées**

* 5 ans et plus d'expérience en DevOps ou en ingénierie de plateforme infonuagique.
* Expertise en Terraform et en infrastructure en tant que code.
* Maîtrise de GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines et des stratégies de déploiement.
* Conteneurisation et orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, EKS ou AKS).
* AWS : IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, KMS; équivalents Azure.
* Scripting (Python, Bash) et outils de monitoring (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Datadog ou Grafana).
* Connaissance de Databricks et Snowflake, un atout.

**EXIGENCES COMMUNES À TOUS LES PROFILS**

* Maîtrise de GitHub et des pratiques CI/CD; Terraform, un atout (requis pour DevOps).
* Connaissance des méthodologies Agile.
* Baccalauréat en TI, informatique, génie, statistique, mathématiques ou domaine connexe.
* Expérience en contexte de conseil ou de mandats clients, un atout.
* Excellentes aptitudes de communication et de résolution de problèmes.
* Bilinguisme (français et anglais).

**POURQUOI JOINDRE MAAT\-DAT?**

* Une équipe d'experts en croissance et des mandats variés dans plusieurs secteurs.
* Un budget de formation et de certifications (AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake).
* Une rémunération concurrentielle et un mode de travail flexible. *(à préciser)*

**Pour postuler**, envoie ton CV en précisant le profil visé. (info@maatdat.com)

**ENGLISH VERSION**

**MAAT\-DAT Consulting Inc. is hiring: Data and DevOps Experts**

**ABOUT MAAT\-DAT CONSULTING INC.**  
MAAT\-DAT Consulting Inc. is a data\-focused consulting firm. As we grow, we are building a team of experts to increase our capacity to deliver high\-value engagements for our clients. We are looking for several profiles to join our team.

**PROFILE 1 – Data Engineer**

**Responsibilities**

* Design, document, and implement scalable data pipelines (APIs, databases, files, real\-time).
* Build multi\-cloud solutions (Azure, AWS) on Databricks and Snowflake.
* Optimize processing performance and cost, and ensure data quality.

**Required Skills**

* 5\+ years in data engineering, Python, and Spark; 4\+ years with Databricks.
* Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake; BigQuery is an asset.
* AWS: S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, EMR; Kinesis or MSK is an asset.
* Strong SQL, data modeling, and data warehousing skills.

**PROFILE 2 – Data Scientist**

**Responsibilities**

* Translate business problems into machine learning solutions.
* Design, train, deploy, and monitor models in production (performance, drift, reliability).
* Implement alerting and retraining mechanisms following MLOps best practices.

**Required Skills**

* 5\+ years in data science; proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit\-learn, PySpark) and SQL.
* Proven experience deploying and monitoring models in production (data drift, model drift, alerting).
* MLflow, Databricks, SageMaker, or Azure ML; Bedrock, Docker, PyTorch, or TensorFlow are assets.
* Master's or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, or Computer Science is an asset.

**We are:**


The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) are the engine for reinvention in our clients’ transformation journey. Powered by more than 255,000 people across 24 countries, ATCs provide our clients with seamless access to industry insights and innovative technology solutions.

 **Stronger together!**


The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) make a tremendous impact in solving our clients’ business problems by leveraging innovation, intelligence, industry insights, new IT, and new technology skills. With the global environment changing at a faster pace, our clients are facing unprecedented challenges, and they need us more than ever before. As a Network, ATCs are positioned to unlock greater opportunities and exponential value for our clients.

 **The value for our clients and our people:**


For our clients, the Network provides the strength of our geographic diversity, greater resilience, and seamless access to the deepest industry knowledge, the latest in Gen AI solutions, and tech expertise from around the world.


For our people, it brings an opportunity to shape truly boundaryless career paths in a highly collaborative team of experts where they can learn from each other and solve the world’s most complex client challenges.

 **You Are**


A Full Stack Developer with strong experience in Java, J2EE, web technologies, and enterprise application delivery. You bring hands\-on capability across frontend development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, backend services, SQL, and database management systems. Curam experience is strong asset; candidates with a demonstrated willingness and ability to learn Curam will also be considered. You apply sound software engineering practices throughout the development lifecycle and collaborate effectively with Curam business analysts, UI/UX designers, experience designers, and automation engineers. You are also interested in using Agentic AI capabilities to improve development productivity, solution delivery, and user outcomes.

 **The Work**


You will be part of a cross\-functional Agile delivery team responsible for designing, building, configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting Curam\-based solutions. You will implement product features across the full technology stack and translate functional requirements into secure, maintainable technical solutions.


You will own or contribute to Curam technical design, user story creation and refinement, application configuration and customization, code implementation, deployment, unit testing, and defect resolution. You will work closely with multidisciplinary partners to ensure solutions meet business, usability, quality, and delivery objectives.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Develop full stack application components using Java, J2EE, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, and related web and database technologies.
* Build maintainable, reusable, and testable code that follows established architecture, development, security, and accessibility standards.
* Prepare and deploy application code across development and test environments using established release and configuration\-management processes.
* Perform unit testing, support integration and system testing, analyze defects, and deliver timely bug fixes.
* Troubleshoot application, integration, data, and environment issues and contribute to root\-cause analysis and permanent resolution.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, sprint ceremonies, technical discussions, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Support application releases, production validation, ongoing maintenance, and operational issue resolution.

  

**Here's What You Need: (skills)**

* Bachelor Degree or College Diploma or equivalent work experience
* Atleast 2 \-3 years of overall experience in JAVA development
* Demonstrated experience developing enterprise applications using Java and J2EE technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with frontend web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, relational data concepts, and database management systems.
* Experience designing and implementing both frontend and backend components for enterprise web applications.
* Experience with object\-oriented design, service integration, application architecture, and secure coding practices.
* Familiarity with Agentic AI concepts and the ability to apply AI\-enabled tools responsibly within software delivery workflows.
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery practices, and DevOps principles.
* Experience writing unit tests, diagnosing defects, and supporting integration and system testing.
* Experience with build, deployment, configuration\-management, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience using Git or a comparable source\-control system and working effectively in collaborative development workflows.
* Strong problem\-solving, debugging, analytical, and technical documentation skills.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and stakeholder\-collaboration skills
* Must have Reliability Security Clearance or be eligible to obtain it.
* English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English\-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

 **Nice to have skills:**

* Experience with IBM Curam solutions or willingness to learn it.
* Experience delivering solutions in regulated environments with security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting large\-scale public\-sector or enterprise digital transformation programs.

*Our employees are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we help people, businesses, and society prosper in good times and be resilient in bad times.*
