jobs.title: Automation and integration developer
jobs.description:
✔ You’d rather solve a problem once than a hundred times.
  

✔ When you see a repetitive task, your first instinct is to figure out how to automate it.
  

✔ You enjoy connecting systems, building workflows and getting different technologies to work together.
  

✔ You want to build solutions that make a difference across an entire organization.
  

✔ You’d rather design automations than do the same tasks over and over.
  

✔ You want to work with modern cloud technologies, APIs and AI services.
  

✔ You like working with technical teams and business departments alike to help them work smarter.
  

✔ You want the freedom to design solutions, not just follow set procedures.
  

✔ You want to grow with one of the most innovative automation platforms in the IT services industry.


**The challenge**
-----------------


Automation is a core part of our business strategy. Every department is always looking for ways to work more efficiently, cut out repetitive tasks and get their tools talking to each other. Your mission is simple. Build the next generation of automations that will make the whole organization run better.


**Your role at S3**
-------------------


### **Build automations that add real value**


* Design, develop and maintain automation workflows in Rewst.
* Build integrations between our internal systems and other platforms using REST APIs and webhooks.
* Design automation solutions using Microsoft Azure services and other cloud technologies.
* Create reusable components to speed up the development of new automations.
* Build templates and application logic with Jinja.

### **Improve processes across the company**


* Analyze existing processes and identify the best opportunities for automation.
* Work directly with departments to understand their operational needs.
* Turn repetitive tasks into reliable, scalable automated processes.
* Keep refining existing automations so they grow with the business.

### **Build solutions that last**


* Write clean, well\-structured, maintainable code.
* Troubleshoot and fix issues with existing automations.
* Apply best practices for development, security and reliability.
* Contribute to technical documentation and help raise the team’s standards.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------


* 2 to 5 years of experience in automation, systems integration, software development, DevOps or a related field.
* Experience building automation workflows or business processes.
* Strong knowledge of REST APIs and system integrations.
* Experience with JSON and data transformation.
* Experience with Jinja or a similar templating language.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to turn business needs into technical solutions.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Curious, self\-driven and always looking to improve.

**Nice to have:** Microsoft Azure • PowerShell or Python • Git • Experience using AI tools for development • Experience in an MSP (Managed Service Provider) environment


**What you get at S3**
----------------------


### **Perks**


* Competitive salary based on experience
* Flexible remote work (fully remote, with access to our new offices at Place des Arts)
* Comprehensive group insurance and telemedicine
* 5 PTO days, paid out if unused
* $700 equipment allowance
* Monthly phone allowance

### **Environment**


* A team of 100 IT pros who speak the same technical language as you
* An annual company retreat that includes your family
* Downtown office (Place des Festivals)
* Gym, showers and social activities

**Your path to success**
------------------------


### **After 6 months**


* You’re independently designing automations used by multiple departments.
* You understand how our main business systems interact.
* Teams rely on you to simplify and improve their processes.
* Your automations are already saving hundreds of hours of manual work.

### **After 12 months**


* You’ve built a library of reusable components used across the company.
* You’re spotting the next automation opportunities on your own.
* You’re actively shaping S3’s automation strategy.
* You’re recognized as the go\-to person for automation and systems integration.

**Why S3?**
-----------


At S3, automation isn’t a side project. It’s central to how we work.


You’ll build modern solutions using automation platforms, cloud services, enterprise APIs and AI to make a real difference in the daily work of hundreds of people.


If you love solving problems, building elegant solutions and having a tangible impact on an organization, you’ll feel right at home here.


**Ready to build the next generation of automations?**
------------------------------------------------------


If you enjoy connecting systems, automating processes and creating solutions that make teams’ work easier, we’d love to meet you.

Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.


**Spécialiste en développement logiciel, IA et modernisation**


**Résumé du poste**


Le ou la Spécialiste en développement logiciel, IA et modernisation est responsable de la conception, du développement, du soutien et de la modernisation d’applications essentielles aux activités de l’écosystème de distribution pharmaceutique de McKesson.


Contrairement aux développeurs spécialisés dans une plateforme particulière, ce poste met l’accent sur la résolution de problèmes d’affaires au moyen de pratiques modernes de génie logiciel, de l’intelligence artificielle, de l’automatisation et d’une capacité d’apprentissage rapide de diverses technologies.


La personne retenue utilisera des outils de développement alimentés par l’IA, tels que GitHub Copilot, Claude, ainsi que des plateformes automatisées d’analyse de code, afin d’accélérer la livraison de solutions, d’améliorer la résilience des systèmes et de réduire la dépendance envers des compétences spécialisées liées aux technologies patrimoniales. Bien qu’une expérience des environnements IBM i / RPG soit considérée comme un atout, la principale attente est la capacité à comprendre rapidement des processus d’affaires complexes, à effectuer l’ingénierie inverse de solutions existantes et à livrer des résultats modernes et évolutifs.


Ce poste convient parfaitement à une personne hautement adaptable qui s’épanouit dans des environnements exigeants et qui aime résoudre des problèmes d’affaires et techniques complexes, peu importe la technologie utilisée.

* Valider et réviser tout contenu généré par l’IA afin d’assurer son exactitude, sa sécurité et sa conformité.

jobs.title: 3D Programmer - (Assassin's Creed HEXE)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Ubisoft is a global leader in the video game industry, with teams around the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from *Assassin’s Creed* and *Rainbow Six* to *Just Dance* and many more. We believe that diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you are passionate about innovation and pushing the boundaries of entertainment, join us and help create the unknown!

 **Job Description**  

As a **3D Programmer** at **Ubisoft Montreal**, you will focus on the rendering systems for the *Assassin's Creed HEXE* project. You will work closely with the **Anvil Pipeline Rendering Team** to maintain the stability, efficiency, and adaptability of the engine across current\-generation consoles and PC.


What you'll do

* Contribute to the entire rendering engine, including opaque rendering, shadows, post\-processing effects, and compute\-based systems.
* Support rendering development in close collaboration with the Anvil Pipeline Rendering Team.
* Diagnose project\-specific issues, including GPU hangs and complex rendering bugs.
* Evaluate performance and implement optimizations throughout the rendering pipeline.
* Design and implement alternative rendering solutions tailored to consoles with more limited hardware capabilities.
* Support the Toolmode Data Generation pipeline from a rendering perspective.

  

**Qualifications** **What you bring to the team**

* A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent qualification.
* Strong understanding of modern real\-time rendering systems, including opaque rendering, shadows, post\-processing effects, and compute\-based pipelines.
* Hands\-on experience shipping games on **PlayStation 5**, **Xbox Series X/S**, or **Nintendo Switch 2**.
* Experience troubleshooting platform\-specific rendering issues, including GPU hangs.
* Proficiency with GPU profiling tools to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Ability to navigate large codebases and effectively contribute to less familiar systems.
* Experience with proprietary game engines such as **Anvil** is an asset.
* Knowledge of toolchains and data generation pipelines such as **Toolmode** is an asset.
* Experience collaborating with engine or pipeline teams distributed across multiple studios is an asset.

**What to send our way**

* Your resume highlighting your skills and experience.
* Code samples, repository links, or other relevant projects.

Pratt \& Whitney Canada (P\&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928\. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

Nous sommes en pleine transformation numérique, redéfinissant notre manière de travailler, optimisant nos opérations et transformant nos produits et services pour améliorer les expériences des employés et des clients.

 **À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien ?**

  

* Concevoir et développer des applications et des systèmes pour soutenir les essais moteurs, avec un emphase initial sur les outils d'analyse thermodynamique, les outils d'analyse vibratoire et les systèmes de production de moteurs;

* Baccalauréat en génie logiciel/informatique, électrique, mécanique ou aérospatial avec au moins 8 ans d'expérience (ou 5\+ ans avec un diplôme de maîtrise);
* Expérience en tant que développeur Full\-Stack, avec une expertise dans des langages et des frameworks tels que C/C\+\+, Java, JavaScript, FORTRAN, Vue.js;
* Expérience avec SQL, Oracle DB et les outils qui y sont associés;
* Solide connaissance de l'architecture logicielle, de la mise en œuvre, de la validation et du cycle de vie du développement logiciel;
* Expérience pratique des cadres Agile (par exemple, Scrum, Kanban) et une familiarité avec les outils DevSecOps tels que Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence et GitHub.
* Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une très bonne connaissance de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre, sur une base quotidienne, de la documentation et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

 **Qualifications privilégiées**

  

* Une connaissance des analyses thermodynamiques, des analyses vibratoires et des systèmes d’exécution de la fabrication serait un atout majeur.

* Garderies à proximité

 **Travailler chez Pratt \& Whitney Canada**

  

Le masculin est utilisé sans discrimination et uniquement dans le but d’alléger le texte. Nous étudierons la demande d’emploi de tous les candidats qualifiés.

**Overview**
------------

  

As part of the national GIS team, you will design and maintain automation and data integration solutions for the ALTO project. Working with GIS, CAD/BIM, engineering, and information management teams, you will develop reusable ETL workflows, automate data validation and synchronization, and ensure the reliability of production processes. You will also contribute to integrating GIS with the project's systems and data environments.


Location – Toronto, Ontario; Montréal or Québec City, Quebec.

**Your role**
-------------

  

* Analyze the project's geospatial data integration, transformation, validation, and synchronization requirements.
* Design, develop, test, and document reusable ETL workflows using FME Form.
* Deploy, schedule, monitor, and maintain automations in FME Flow, as required.
* Automate quality\-control checks, anomaly detection, and validation reporting.
* Integrate and synchronize data among ArcGIS Enterprise, PostgreSQL, CAD/BIM environments, and other project systems.
* Develop robust logging, error\-handling, alerting, and process\-recovery mechanisms.
* Optimize processing workflows to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Troubleshoot production automation incidents and implement the necessary corrections.
* Establish and apply development, version\-control, testing, documentation, and deployment practices for automated solutions.

**About you**
-------------

  

* A university degree in geomatics, computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* A minimum of five years of relevant experience is required, including at least three years of hands\-on FME development experience.
* Hands\-on experience with ArcGIS Enterprise and PostgreSQL is mandatory, particularly in integrating, managing, and supporting enterprise geodatabases.
* Experience with FME Flow for deploying, scheduling, monitoring, and managing production automations is considered a significant asset.
* Experience integrating GIS data with CAD/BIM sources, geodatabases, relational databases, files, and web services.
* Proficiency in FME Form for designing, developing, testing, and optimizing complex, reusable ETL workflows.
* Strong knowledge of geospatial formats, coordinate systems, data schemas, validation rules, and data\-quality principles.
* Strong command of SQL in PostgreSQL; knowledge of Python, REST APIs, web services, and version\-control practices is considered an asset.
* Ability to document requirements, architecture, processing logic, tests, dependencies, and support procedures.
* Proficiency in French or English; French–English bilingualism is a significant asset because of collaboration with teams in Quebec and elsewhere in Canada.\*
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills for designing reliable and efficient automations.
* Rigour in development, testing, documentation, and change management.

* Ability to translate operational needs into simple, reusable, and maintainable technical solutions.

jobs.title: Software Developer / Développeur(euse) logiciel
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real\-time, centimeter\-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.


With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future\-proof, backwards\-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.


Xona is seeking a skilled Software Engineer to work as a contributor to the development and integration of a desktop application to interact with our in\-house satellite receivers and to write application code for our satellite subsystem components.


The ideal candidate thrives in fast\-paced start\-up environments, and can confidently work independently and collaboratively to deliver mission\-critical insights.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience with C and Python coding languages
* Experience with hardware communication system protocols such as RS\-485, UART, I2C, CAN, SPI, and ethernet TCP/IP Strong experience with PyQt / PySide (or Qt\-based GUI development)
* Experience with hands\-on testing and prototyping (dev kits, logic analyzers, decoding bitstreams)
* Experience Software architecting \& Embedded development \& Bash scripting
* Experience with RTOS
* Background in Control systems and/or motor control
* Experience as a team lead/manager


\-


Xona est l’entreprise d’intelligence de navigation qui apporte une certitude en temps réel, à l’échelle du centimètre, à tout appareil, partout sur Terre.


Grâce à Pulsar — l’infrastructure satellitaire PNT en orbite terrestre basse la plus avancée au monde — Xona offrira un système un système de positionnement global évolutif et rétrocompatible, optimisé pour une précision absolue, une puissance supérieure et une protection renforcée.


Xona est à la recherche d’un(e) ingénieur(e) logiciel qualifié(e) qui contribuera au développement et à l’intégration d’une application de bureau permettant d’interagir avec nos récepteurs satellitaires développés à l’interne.


La personne retenue participera également au développement du code applicatif destiné aux composants de nos sous\-systèmes satellitaires. La personne idéale s’épanouit dans l’environnement dynamique d’une entreprise en démarrage et est en mesure de travailler avec assurance, tant de façon autonome qu’en collaboration avec les autres membres de l’équipe, afin de fournir des solutions et des renseignements essentiels à la mission.

**Qualifications requises**

* Expérience en programmation avec les langages C et Python.
* Expérience avec des protocoles et interfaces de communication matérielle, notamment RS\-485, UART, I2C, CAN, SPI et Ethernet TCP/IP.
* Solide expérience avec PyQt / PySide ou dans le développement d’interfaces graphiques basées sur Qt.
* Expérience pratique en matière d’essais et de prototypage, notamment avec des trousses de développement, des analyseurs logiques et le décodage de flux binaires.
* Expérience en architecture logicielle, en développement de systèmes embarqués et en création de scripts Bash.
* Expérience avec des systèmes d’exploitation en temps réel (RTOS).
* Connaissances ou expérience en systèmes de commande et/ou en commande de moteurs.

**For U.S. Roles:** To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).


**For U.K. Roles:** To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

**For Canada Roles:** Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

Au sein du service national de géomatique, vous concevrez et maintiendrez les solutions d'automatisation et d'intégration de données du projet ALTO. --------------

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Ingénieur en développement logiciel de tests (SDET)**

**Plateformes de surveillance de la fibre et de visibilité réseau**

  

**À propos de nous**

Nous développons des plateformes critiques de surveillance de la fibre et de visibilité réseau utilisées par de grands opérateurs de télécommunications et fournisseurs de centres de données partout dans le monde. Nos solutions permettent la surveillance en temps réel des réseaux de fibres optiques, notamment la détection et la localisation des défauts, l’analyse de la dégradation du signal et l’assurance de service, dans les réseaux extérieurs (OSP), les centres de données et les environnements DCI.  



  

Notre plateforme logicielle repose sur une architecture de microservices conteneurisés, fonctionne principalement sous Linux et est déployée dans des environnements sur site, infonuagiques et hybrides. La fiabilité, l’évolutivité, la performance et l’excellence opérationnelle sont au cœur de nos activités.  



  

**Le rôle**

Nous recherchons un ingénieur en développement logiciel de tests (SDET) possédant de 5 à 7 ans d’expérience afin de concevoir, développer et faire évoluer les capacités de tests automatisés au cœur de nos plateformes de surveillance de la fibre.  



  

Vous travaillerez sur les tests manuels et exploratoires, l’automatisation des tests, les pipelines CI/CD, les systèmes distribués, les API, les intégrations, les flux de bout en bout et la validation des performances. Dans notre contexte, où la couverture automatisée est encore en développement, les tests manuels constituent une responsabilité essentielle et le fondement de toute automatisation pertinente. Le titulaire devra d’abord comprendre en profondeur le domaine de la surveillance de la fibre, les cas d’utilisation des clients et le comportement du système avant de concevoir ou d’automatiser les scénarios de test. Ce rôle combine l’ingénierie logicielle, l’ingénierie de la qualité et les pratiques DevOps.  



  

**Principales responsabilités**

* Concevoir, développer et maintenir des cadres de tests automatisés pour les API, les microservices, les applications Web, les intégrations et les flux système.
* Automatiser les tests fonctionnels, d’intégration, de régression, de bout en bout (E2E) et de performance.
* Intégrer les suites de tests automatisés, les contrôles de qualité, les rapports et la validation des versions aux pipelines CI/CD.
* Créer et maintenir les environnements de test, les données de test, les objets simulés, les simulateurs et l’infrastructure de test conteneurisée.
* Créer et exécuter des tests de charge, de stress, d’endurance, d’évolutivité et de régression des performances.
* Analyser les goulots d’étranglement et collaborer avec les développeurs et les ingénieurs DevOps afin de prévenir les régressions de performance.
* Valider les flux de travail entre les services distribués, les conteneurs, les bases de données, les composants réseau et les interfaces proches du matériel.
* Effectuer des tests manuels, exploratoires, d’utilisabilité et de mise en production afin de comprendre le produit, valider les comportements attendus et établir des scénarios de test fiables avant leur automatisation.
* Développer une compréhension approfondie de la surveillance de la fibre, des flux opérationnels et des cas d’utilisation des clients afin de déterminer quoi automatiser, à quel niveau et avec quels résultats attendus.
* Analyser les défaillances des pipelines et des tests, distinguer les défauts du produit des problèmes d’automatisation ou d’infrastructure et améliorer la stabilité des tests.
* Participer aux discussions d’architecture ainsi qu’aux revues de conception, de code et de tests.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit, Développement, DevOps, Soutien et les autres ingénieurs afin de livrer des fonctionnalités fiables et à valeur ajoutée.

  

**Compétences techniques requises**

* De 5 à 7 ans d’expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel, ingénierie de la qualité, automatisation des tests ou dans un rôle de SDET.
* Solides compétences en programmation ou en script avec Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go ou des langages comparables.
* Expérience approfondie dans le développement et la maintenance de cadres de tests automatisés dans des environnements logiciels de production.
* Expérience des tests d’API REST, de microservices, d’applications Web et d’intégrations de systèmes.
* Capacité et volonté d’acquérir une compréhension approfondie du domaine de la surveillance de la fibre et de valider manuellement les scénarios avant de les automatiser.
* Bonne compréhension de la conception des tests, de l’architecture d’automatisation, de la stratégie de régression, de l’isolation des défauts et des tests fondés sur les risques.
* Expérience pratique démontrée en automatisation de tests E2E dans des systèmes distribués ou comportant plusieurs composants.
* Expérience pratique démontrée en tests de performance, notamment les tests de charge, de stress, d’endurance et d’évolutivité, ainsi que l’analyse des résultats.
* Expérience pratique démontrée avec Docker et les environnements de test ou d’application conteneurisés.
* À l’aise dans les environnements Linux.
* Maîtrise de Git et des méthodes de développement collaboratif.
* Bonne compréhension de la concurrence, des réseaux, du traitement asynchrone et des considérations de performance propres aux systèmes distribués.

* Expérience de l’intégration des tests automatisés aux pipelines CI/CD.
* Expérience de l’intégration continue, des pipelines sous forme de code, des contrôles de qualité automatisés et de la production de rapports de tests exploitables.
* Capacité à définir des étapes de test qui équilibrent rapidité, couverture, stabilité et confiance envers les versions.

jobs.title: Analyste QA - Développement, automatisation et IA
jobs.description:
Outbox est un leader mondial de la billetterie de spectacles, avec plus de 500 millions de billets traités à ce jour. Nous mettons notre expertise au service de clients prestigieux comme le Cirque du Soleil et le CF Montréal, en leur offrant des solutions innovantes qui redéfinissent l'expérience de vente de billets.

  

Nous recherchons **un·e analyste en assurance qualité** spécialisé·e dans le **développement de tests automatisés** pour rejoindre notre équipe de développement. Chez Outbox, tu évolueras dans un environnement de travail collaboratif au sein d’une équipe passionnée et engagée à offrir la meilleure expérience d’achat de billets, tant pour les consommateurs que pour nos clients en arrière\-scène.

* Concevoir, développer et maintenir des **tests automatisés**, qu’ils soient fonctionnels (FAATS) ou de régression visuelle, en utilisant **Playwright**.
* Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus QA en intégrant de l’automatisation et en exploitant **l’IA** pour générer des tests automatisés, analyser des logs et améliorer la détection des anomalies.
* Comprendre les objectifs et résultats attendus d’une fonctionnalité et les transformer en **plans de tests structurés et détaillés** afin d’assurer une couverture optimale.
* Réaliser des **tests en préproduction** et effectuer des **tests de bout en bout**.
* Gérer une **flotte de serveurs de test** et collaborer avec les collègues pour optimiser leur utilisation.

**Ce qu’il faut pour exceller dans ce rôle:**

* Minimum **d’un an d’expérience** dans la création de tests automatisés.
* Minimum **d’un an d’expérience** en test manuel d’applications.
* Diplôme universitaire en **informatique** ou dans un domaine connexe.
* Maîtrise des **standards et meilleures pratiques QA** de l’industrie.

* Compétences en **ligne de commande Linux**.

* Compréhension des **enjeux de compatibilité entre navigateurs** sur ordinateurs et mobiles.

* Bonne capacité **d’analyse et de rétrospection**.
* Une expérience avec **N8N** ou un outil d’automatisation similaire serait un atout.

**Pourquoi rejoindre Outbox?**

* Opportunité de travailler sur des **solutions de billetterie innovantes** pour l’industrie du divertissement.
* Environnement **stimulant, inclusif et propice à l’apprentissage**.
* Possibilité d’évoluer au sein d’une **équipe talentueuse et passionnée**.

**Chez Outbox, nous croyons que chaque talent est unique et que c’est ensemble que nous avançons**. Ici, tu évolueras dans un environnementdynamique et formateur, où l’esprit d’équipe et les opportunités de croissance sont au cœur de notre culture.

#### **Job Description**


**Job Title:** Security Risk Analyst

### **Job Description**


We are seeking a skilled **Security Risk Analyst** to assess, measure, and enhance the effectiveness of cybersecurity controls across the organization. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **cybersecurity risk assessment, security controls, compliance, risk monitoring, and reporting**.


The Security Risk Analyst will be responsible for identifying control gaps, evaluating risk exposure, validating compliance with security policies and regulatory requirements, and providing actionable recommendations to strengthen the organization's overall cybersecurity posture.


A key focus of this role will be **Metrics, Reporting, and Continuous Monitoring**, including the development and tracking of **Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** to measure control effectiveness and proactively identify potential security risks.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Assess and evaluate the effectiveness of cybersecurity controls across the organization.
* Identify control gaps, weaknesses, and areas of risk exposure.
* Perform security risk assessments and provide actionable recommendations for risk mitigation.
* Validate compliance with organizational security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Support **Continuous Control Monitoring (CCM)** initiatives to identify and address control deficiencies.
* Develop, monitor, and maintain **KRIs and KPIs** to measure cybersecurity and control effectiveness.
* Create dashboards, metrics, and reports for leadership, audit, and regulatory reviews.
* Analyze security risk trends and proactively identify emerging risks.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, IT, compliance, audit, and business teams to strengthen the control environment.
* Track remediation activities and ensure identified control gaps are appropriately addressed.
* Support internal and external audits by providing risk assessments, control evidence, metrics, and reporting.
* Continuously recommend improvements to cybersecurity controls, processes, and risk management practices.

* Strong experience in cybersecurity risk management and security control assessment.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, security policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience identifying control gaps and evaluating cybersecurity risk exposure.
* Hands\-on experience with **KRI/KPI development, metrics, reporting, and continuous monitoring**.
* Experience supporting **Continuous Control Monitoring (CCM)** programs.

**This position is 4 days in office**

  

**The Role**

Reporting to the Director, Financial Applications, the SAP Functional Analyst provides functional analysis, configuration, support, and continuous improvement for SAP Finance processes and related financial applications across the firm. The role has primary responsibility for Record to Report, including General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Controlling, period\-end close, financial reporting, postings, reconciliations, and controls.


Working closely with Finance, Procurement, HR, Operations, IT, vendors, and implementation partners, the SAP Senior Functional Analyst is accountable for maintaining the functional integrity of the SAP platform while ensuring solutions remain scalable, supportable, auditable, and aligned with firm objectives.


The role supports process standardization, data quality, controls compliance, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement while helping shape the long\-term evolution of NRF Canada's SAP Centre of Excellence.


Duties include, but are not limited to:  



  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide functional support and analysis for SAP Finance, with primary focus on Record to Report processes.
* Gather and document business requirements, process issues, enhancement needs, and acceptance criteria with Finance stakeholders.
* Translate approved requirements into functional specifications, process flows, configuration changes, test scenarios, and support documentation.
* Configure and maintain SAP ECC functionality within assigned Finance areas in accordance with approved standards and controls.
* Investigate and resolve production incidents and functional defects, escalating cross\-module or complex design issues as required.
* Collaborate with Senior SAP Functional Analysts, Technical Analysts, Reporting, Security, business teams, and vendors to deliver integrated solutions.
* Support functional testing, business validation, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, and deployment readiness.
* Maintain functional configuration records, process documentation, test evidence, knowledge articles, and support procedures.
* Apply established internal controls, segregation\-of\-duties requirements, audit standards, data\-governance practices, and change\-management procedures.
* Support SAP enhancements, patches, releases, integrations, reporting changes, cutover activities, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for recurring process and application issues and recommend practical corrective actions.
* Provide functional guidance and knowledge transfer to users and support teams within the assigned Finance scope.
* Contribute estimates, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to enhancement prioritization and release planning.

Support SAP S/4HANA readiness and transformation activities through process documentation, testing, data validation, and assigned transition activities.  

* 

  

**Skills and Experience Required**

* 7\+ years of experience supporting SAP functional configuration and analysis in Finance, accounting, or a related business environment.
* Hands\-on SAP ECC Finance experience, with strong knowledge of Record to Report processes including General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Controlling, period\-end close, financial reporting, postings, reconciliations, and controls.
* Fluently bilingual in English and French
* Ability to analyze Finance and SAP process requirements and produce clear functional specifications, test scenarios, support documentation, and practical recommendations.
* Experience supporting SAP production issues, enhancements, patches, releases, integrations, reporting changes, or broader Finance Applications initiatives.
* Experience with functional configuration, testing, defect resolution, deployment readiness, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Working knowledge of SAP internal controls, segregation of duties, audit requirements, data governance, change management, and release management.
* Awareness of adjacent SAP processes and modules that integrate with Finance, with the ability to identify cross\-functional impacts and engage the appropriate specialists.
* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA through an implementation, migration, upgrade, assessment, readiness, or transformation initiative is an asset.
* Experience working with systems integrators, managed service providers, implementation partners, or third\-party vendors.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, stakeholder\-management, facilitation, and communication skills across business, end\-user, and technical audiences.
* SAP certification and experience in a professional\-services or legal environment are assets.

Ability to work independently within an assigned functional scope while escalating complex or cross\-functional decisions appropriately.  

* 

  

**Why join our team:**

* Hybrid work environment
* Retirement savings plan with employer contribution
* Benefit premiums paid by the firm

Specializing in stylish and accessible footwear, handbags, and accessories, the ALDO Group has been around for more than 50 years. With over 1,500 stores in more than 100 countries, we operate under two signature brands, ALDO and Call It Spring, and we are the core footwear partner for Sperry in North America. The ALDO Group is also an industry\-recognized wholesale licensed partner, specializing in the design, sourcing, and distribution of fashion footwear, handbags, and accessories. In addition to our head office in Montreal, the ALDO Group maintains international offices in Europe and Asia. For more information, visit www.aldogroup.com.

**Overview**

  

The Technical Support Analyst Level II is responsible for delivering timely and effective support for IT\-related incidents and service requests for Head Office and Store Associates. The role focuses on resolving complex tickets escalated from Level I support through the IT Service Management tool. In addition to troubleshooting, the analyst contributes to Head Office and Store projects, ensures tasks are completed within established service levels, and maintains a high level of customer satisfaction. When required, the analyst acts as a client\-facing representative for IT support while maintaining strong communication and service standards.

* Excellent problem\-solving skills.

Don't skip a beat, apply to JAM Industries!
  
  

JAM, making the world sound better, one brand at a time! Do these words sound like music to your ears?
  
  

Since 1972, JAM has grown to be one of the largest distributors of consumer electronic goods, pro\-audio equipment, and musical instruments. Come join us to stay true to our mission of delivering ONLY the best customer service!
  
  

Systems Administrator
  
**Location:** Montréal, QC
  
**Department:** IT
  
**Reports to:** IT Infrastructure Manager
  
**Works under the guidance of:** Lead Systems Administrator / Architect
  
**Position Type:** Full\-Time
  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday during regular business hours, with the ability to perform administrative duties and maintenance outside business hours as required.
  
  

Role Summary
  
The mid\-level Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, and operational support of the organization’s Windows, Active Directory, and Azure environments. This role provides L2/L3 escalation within the Infrastructure and Security team and works under the guidance of the Lead SysAdmin/Architect to ensure stable, secure, and reliable infrastructure operations across North America. The ideal candidate brings strong systems administration experience with solid Azure skills and good networking fundamentals.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
* Administer and maintain Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP.
* Perform daily operational tasks in Azure/Entra, including VM management, VNet/NSG configuration, storage, monitoring, and backups.
* Support and troubleshoot issues involving Azure hybrid identity (Entra Connect).
* Provide L2/L3 escalation for systems\-related incidents and service requests.
* Monitor system health, performance, and capacity; apply patches and updates.
* Perform backup/restore operations and ensure recovery readiness.
* Conduct log analysis and root\-cause troubleshooting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and OS\-level logs.
* Collaborate with other SysAdmins, network, security, web/application, and SQL teams.
* Support infrastructure\-related components of business applications and peripheral systems (e.g., integrations, printers, and warehouse/RF devices).
* Follow standards and direction set by the Lead SysAdmin/Architect.
* Document system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.


Required Skills \& Experience
  
* 3–6 years of hands on experience in a Systems Administrator role, including at least 3 years working with Microsoft Azure in an operational capacity
* Strong experience with Windows Server and Active Directory administration (users, groups, OUs, GPO basics, DNS/DHCP).
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (IP addressing, subnets, routing basics, firewall concepts, DNS).
* Operational experience with Microsoft Azure, including:
* Virtual Machines
* VNets, NSGs, routing basics
* Azure Backup
* Azure Monitor and basic Log Analytics
* Hybrid identity components (Entra Connect)
* Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams).
* Experience supporting enterprise or mid\-sized environments (1000–5000 users preferred).
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical abilities, especially log\-driven debugging.
* Basic PowerShell scripting for administration tasks.
* Ability to handle L2/L3 support independently while collaborating with senior team members.


Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications
  
* Experience with Linux or Unix appliances (bonus only).
* Familiarity with Cloudflare concepts (DNS, WAF).
* Basic understanding of SQL connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience working in ITIL\-driven or structured operational environments.


Competencies
  
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking
* Effective collaboration and communication
* Adaptability and willingness to learn
* Attention to detail and adherence to standards
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment


Why Join Us
  
  

Ready to join our team? Here’s why …

* Wellness Incentive Program and Employee Assistance Program

* A casual, fun, and collaborative work environment
* Lively social calendar—there’s always something for everyone

Workplace Commitments
  
  

We are committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment. All employees are expected to follow workplace safety protocols, including compliance with local regulations and internal standards, to ensure the well\-being of everyone.

**Mission**
-----------


**À Santé Québec, prendre soin des gens est au cœur de notre engagement.**

C’est ce qui nous unit et nous anime.


Nous regroupons les 30 établissements publics de santé et de services sociaux du Québec et comptons sur l’engagement de près de 325 000 personnes qui, chaque jour, mettent leur savoir\-faire au service du mieux\-être de toute la population.


Nous croyons que c’est par la collaboration, l’engagement, le respect, la bienveillance et l’excellence que se construit un réseau plus humain, plus fort, plus juste.


Travailler au sein de Santé Québec, c’est contribuer à une mission profondément humaine, dans un environnement en constante évolution, axé sur l’innovation et l’amélioration continue.


Si vous partagez cette vision, si vous souhaitez y contribuer et changer réellement les choses, votre place est ici.

  

  

**Libellé de la nomenclature**


**1124 \- Analyste spécialisé ou analyste spécialisée en informatique**


Personne qui assure la coordination, la gestion et la supervision des activités d'analyse, de mise en œuvre, d'évolution, d'implantation, de support et de soutien opérationnel de projets concernant des systèmes d’information complexes, multisites et touchant plusieurs secteurs de l’organisation. Elle agit à titre d'experte dans son domaine de spécialisation. Elle coordonne le travail d'une équipe d'analystes et de techniciens en informatique.

  

  

**Attributions**


La Direction adjointe des solutions numériques en services de santé et administratifs (DASNSSA) a pour mission d’assurer l’exploitation, la pérennité et l’évolution des solutions numériques (SN) essentielles au bon fonctionnement de Santé Québec, du ministère de la Santé et des Services sociaux (MSSS) et de plusieurs organismes partenaires, tels que l’Institut national de santé publique (INSPQ) et Héma Québec. Ces solutions sont utilisées quotidiennement par des milliers d’utilisateurs et utilisatrices dans divers secteurs, allant des services de première ligne aux services jeunesse, en passant par les services médico\-administratifs et administratifs.


La DASNSSA propose également des services transversaux stratégiques, notamment du soutien au développement de projets numériques et la gestion du domaine de l’imagerie médicale du Dossier Santé Québec (DSQ).


Relevant de la Coordination des SN administratives et de santé (CSNAS), le Secteur des SN administratives est responsable de l’entretien, de l’évolution, de l’exploitation et du soutien de plusieurs SN soutenant les activités administratives et organisationnelles de Santé Québec. Ces solutions contribuent notamment à la gestion des ressources, à la production d’informations de gestion ainsi qu’à l’amélioration de l’efficacité opérationnelle du réseau.


Sous la supervision de son gestionnaire, la personne titulaire joue un rôle clé dans le développement et l’entretien des SN relevant de la Direction des solutions numériques. Elle planifie et exécute les activités nécessaires pour répondre aux besoins identifiés, en collaborant étroitement avec les ressources impliquées dans les projets. Pour ce faire, elle recueille et analyse les besoins, rédige la documentation pertinente, développe les composantes requises et assure une coordination efficace tout au long du processus.


Elle contribue à la réalisation de projets numériques stratégiques et à l’évolution de SN critiques pour Santé Québec et son réseau. Elle participe notamment à des initiatives d’envergure provinciale telles que Talent Santé Québec (TSQ), une solution visant à soutenir l’attraction, le recrutement et la gestion des talents du réseau, ainsi que le Gestionnaire de rendez\-vous, une solution favorisant la gestion et l’optimisation des rendez\-vous et l’amélioration de l’accès aux services de santé pour la population. Elle peut également contribuer à d’autres priorités organisationnelles. À ce titre, elle intervient à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie des solutions, de l’analyse à la mise en production et au soutien évolutif.


Dotée d’une compréhension approfondie de la structure organique des SN, elle effectue des analyses détaillées, développe ou adapte les modules requis et propose des améliorations visant à optimiser le fonctionnement des systèmes. Elle contribue au choix des technologies et aux orientations techniques afin d’assurer la qualité, la performance, la sécurité et la pérennité des solutions. Elle participe également à l’élaboration des règles d’architecture, à la définition des normes techniques et à la rédaction de la documentation qui en découle.


Elle joue un rôle\-conseil auprès des chargés de projet, en les informant des impacts des choix technologiques et structurels sur les délais de développement. En collaboration avec les administrateurs de bases de données, elle veille à une intégration harmonieuse des divers composants applicatifs et technologiques.


À la demande de ses supérieurs, elle peut être amenée à produire des avis sur les avancées technologiques pertinentes pour son secteur ou pour l’ensemble de Santé Québec. Elle identifie les besoins fonctionnels, opérationnels et technologiques liés aux solutions dont elle assure le développement ou le soutien, et propose des solutions adaptées et alignées sur les orientations organisationnelles.


Enfin, elle participe activement à l’implantation de SN développées, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les ressources internes de Santé Québec, les partenaires externes et la clientèle utilisatrice, afin d’assurer le succès des déploiements. Elle s’assure que les activités de déploiement, de transition et de soutien soient réalisées efficacement et contribuent à garantir la stabilité, la performance et la qualité de la SN.

Croesus provides innovative, high\-performance, and secure wealth management solutions that include portfolio management systems, portfolio rebalancing tools, and application programming interfaces (APIs). These solutions empower wealth management professionals to improve their productivity, enhance their client relationships, make informed decisions, and maximize the management of their assets under management.

  

Croesus’s mission is to provide a superior experience to its clients, users, partners, and employees and to positively impact the community. With more than 200 employees in its Montréal, Toronto, and Geneva offices, Croesus has won several industry awards for being a high\-quality solution provider and an outstanding employer.

As part of the Product Ops team, you will be the driving force behind our internal technological ecosystem. Your mission: design, power, and operate the internal AI layer and data structures that transform how Croesus’ Product team (Product Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technical Writers, UX Designers) designs, delivers, and operates its wealth management solutions.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Skiffra**
=================


Skiffra is building the intelligence layer for the physical world. We translate complex, real\-world environments into clear, actionable data.  

  

While most AI companies focus on digital industries, we design AI native orchestration systems for the sectors that extract, move, and build ecosystems around us. We turn messy, high stakes operations into intelligent, adaptive workflows that improve decisions in real time.  

  

Our first proving ground is mining and natural resources, but the platform is modular by design and built to scale into any industry where decisions are expensive and the consequences are real.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**.


As Business Analyst, you'll assist with mapping how operations really run. Translating multiple systems into documented processes and system requirements, and turning what you find into tools the client can use.


You'll spend real time at our client site— roughly a week a month, more during intensive mapping phases — learning the work directly from the people who run maintenance, the fleet, the plant, and payroll, in French. The rest of your time you'll be based in Montreal, working with Skiffra's IT, engineering and product team to turn process insight into production tools.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Map and document business processes end to end — maintenance, fleet, plant, supply chain, HR, and finance — in a consistent, build\-ready notation such as BPMN.
* Go on site, run workshops, and surface the gap between how a process is documented and how it actually runs.
* Quantify the value at stake and turn your analysis into a working tool: a dashboard, data pipeline, or workflow app
* Establish the financial baseline and post\-implementation KPIs for every tool you build — cost, time, and error\-rate impact — and maintain a running scorecard so the value of each implementation is provable in dollars, not just described.
* Analyze integrations between operational and enterprise systems, and specify the data that has to move between them — its owner, its quality, its lineage.
* Translate operational language into system requirements, and system behaviour back into language the site understands — you are the interpreter between the mine and the technology function.
* Establish process ownership: every process you document gets a named business owner who signs off and keeps it current.
* Train client users, hand over ownership, and document what you build.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED**

* Experience in business analysis or business process mapping, ideally with exposure to an industrial, asset\-intensive, or mining environment.
* Working\-level SQL and Python, and comfort with a BI or low\-code tool.
* Practical exposure to an ERP — SAP strongly preferred.
* Comfort running workshops and translating between operational staff and technical teams.
* Understanding of data governance concepts: ownership, lineage, and quality.
* Fluent French and working English — the site operates in French; group standards and vendors work in English.
* Based in Montreal and available to travel regularly to the operation site, on the order of once a month.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Prior exposure to mining, heavy industry, or another asset\-intensive operating environment.
* Experience in a carve\-out, post\-acquisition, or greenfield environment where documentation had to be created rather than inherited.
* Familiarity with a modern data platform — lakehouse, lineage tooling, semantic modelling.
* Time in a startup or founding\-stage environment.

**À PROPOS DE SKIFFRA**


Skiffra est une plateforme d'orchestration native à l'IA pour les opérations industrielles du monde physique, en commençant par le secteur minier et les ressources naturelles. Les données opérationnelles sont aujourd'hui emprisonnées dans les PGI, les historiens de données et les systèmes d'équipement — elles n'atteignent jamais les personnes qui prennent des décisions en temps réel. Nous bâtissons la couche d'intelligence qui change cela, en travaillant directement à l'intérieur des sites et des systèmes de nos clients plutôt que de l'extérieur.

**À PROPOS DU POSTE**


En tant qu'analyste d'affaires (Business Analyst), vous participerez à la cartographie du fonctionnement réel des opérations. Vous traduirez les données issues de multiples systèmes en processus documentés et en exigences fonctionnelles, tout en transformant vos conclusions en outils exploitables par le client.


Vous passerez du temps sur le terrain, dans les locaux du client — environ une semaine par mois, voire davantage lors des phases intensives de cartographie — pour appréhender le travail directement auprès des équipes responsables de la maintenance, de la gestion de flotte, de l'usine et de la paie, le tout en français. Le reste du temps, vous serez basé à Montréal et travaillerez avec les équipes informatique, ingénierie et produit de Skiffra pour transformer les enseignements tirés des processus en outils de production.

**CE QUE VOUS FEREZ**

* Cartographier et documenter les processus d'affaires de bout en bout — entretien, flotte, usine, chaîne d'approvisionnement, RH et finance — dans une notation cohérente et exploitable, telle que BPMN.

jobs.title: Analyste financier(-ère) | Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Group Ventures is Valsoft's incubator. We find opportunities in the market and build companies to address them. The finance team inside Group Ventures keeps the books for four of those companies so far: ValPay, Tenerum, Sadie Technology, and Plug \& Pay.


We're looking for a financial analyst to run their day\-to\-day accounting cycle: vendors, payments, banking operations, recurring schedules, and close support. You'll work directly with the Finance Controller, who keeps responsibility for accounting judgement, financial statements, and technical positions. You'll be the one running the accounting engine each day.


The work spans several entities and seven currencies (CAD, USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, NZD, CHF) on NetSuite OneWorld. Volume is high and close deadlines are tight.


AI should be part of how you work. Use it to draft, analyse, and automate the repetitive parts of the cycle. You're responsible for the accuracy of whatever gets posted.




**What we value**

* Accuracy, and the habit of checking your own work before anyone else has to.
* Finishing what you own without being chased.
* Understanding how each entity earns and spends money.
* Discretion with confidential financial information.
* Curiosity, and a willingness to fix a process that keeps producing the same error.
* The honesty to say when something is wrong, including your own work.




**What you'll do**

* Keep payables accurate and vendors paid on time
* + Monitor the AP shared mailboxes (ValPay, Tenerum, Sadie) and run the weekly invoice\-entry batch: triage, rename and file PDFs, code invoices by entity, division and GL account, prepare the NetSuite bill import file, and attach supporting documents. Process recurring invoices per established coding rules.
	+ Obtain missing spend approvals from budget owners, reconcile vendor statements, investigate differences, and clear past\-due invoices.
	+ Set up and maintain vendor records in NetSuite, including banking details, tax forms and payment terms, checking every banking change before it goes in.
	+ Prepare the weekly payment run: payment proposal, draft\-only payment entry in the banking portal, remittance advices, and approval follow\-up.
* Keep cash and bank records reconciled
* + Download bank statements and transactions for all entities, code and post entries in NetSuite, and prepare the monthly bank reconciliations with reconciling items listed for review.
	+ Own the credit card cycle: collect receipts, chase cardholders, produce the monthly expense file, and prepare the reconciliation and journal\-entry upload file.
* Get customers invoiced and cash applied
* + Issue and send customer invoices, and follow up on missing or corrected ones.
	+ Apply cash receipts, maintain the AR aging, and handle first\-level collection follow\-up, flagging past\-due accounts and disputes to the Controller for escalation.
* Support the month\-end close
* + Maintain recurring schedules (prepaids, accruals, fixed assets and depreciation, deferred revenue) and prepare balance sheet reconciliations for lower\-complexity accounts, documenting open items.
	+ Prepare standard and recurring journal entries with full supporting documentation for Controller review and approval, then upload the approved files to NetSuite and verify posting accuracy.
	+ Run intercompany confirmations: prepare balance confirmations, circulate them to group entities, follow up, and assemble settlement support.
* Keep records audit\-ready and support the Controller
* + File and archive supporting documentation per the established folder structure, pull samples and documents requested by external auditors, and keep audit folders current.
	+ Handle finance requests in Jira, gathering documentation, keeping tickets updated and closing them once resolved. Write and maintain the procedures for the tasks you own.
	+ Work with the Controller on ad hoc requests and special projects: onboarding new entities or acquisitions, opening and closing bank accounts, system implementations, and data gathering for analyses and reporting. Prepare the documents, data extracts and working files for files the Controller leads, and pick up other accounting\-cycle work as team needs and period priorities change.




**What you'll bring**

* A DEC in accounting and management techniques, an AEC in accounting, or equivalent training.
* Two to four years of full\-cycle accounting experience.
* Intermediate to advanced Excel. You're comfortable with lookups, pivot tables, and high volumes of data.
* ERP experience. NetSuite is strongly preferred; Sage, Dynamics, or QuickBooks are accepted.
* Accuracy and attention to detail, with the discipline to meet tight close deadlines.
* Self\-direction and organisation. You can carry a high volume of recurring tasks with minimal supervision.
* Follow\-through. You chase the missing approval, receipt, or confirmation until it arrives.
* Discretion and judgement with confidential financial information.
* Clear writing. You can explain a reconciling item or a vendor discrepancy in a few lines.
* You use AI tools in your work and check the results before they reach the ledger.




**Useful experience**

* Multi\-entity or multi\-currency accounting.
* Power Query.
* Payments, fintech, or software.
* Using a corporate banking portal.
* Jira.
* Writing procedures for a finance team that is still being built.




**Who will enjoy this role**


You notice when a vendor statement doesn't match, a bank line has no home, or an intercompany balance is off by the same amount two months running. You want to know why, and you fix the cause.


In one week you might clear an invoice batch across three entities, chase a cardholder for receipts, reconcile an AUD bank account, and pull audit samples. Most of the work recurs, and the value is in getting it right every time.


The hard parts are specific. Volume is high and the close date doesn't move. Across seven currencies and several entities, small mistakes compound. Y

* Strong community involvement and a commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion.
* A collaborative, cohesive culture that connects lawyers and business teams through collective purpose.

**How to Apply:**  

We encourage external candidates to apply online and internal applicants must apply directly through our internal careers portal on Espresso. We look forward to receiving your application. *We thank all applicants for their interest in McCarthy Tétrault; however, only chosen applicants will be contacted. We regret that we are unable to respond to individual inquiries about application status. McCarthy Tétrault is an equal opportunity employer that fosters an inclusive, equitable, and accessible environment. jobs.title: Staff Platform Developer
jobs.description:
Newforma provides industry\-leading Information Management and collaboration software for the Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Owner/Operator (AECO) industry. With over 500,000 users in more than 1,500 firms worldwide, our mission is to empower AECO teams by delivering technology solutions that drive better project outcomes throughout the construction project lifecycle. As a portfolio company of Ethos Capital, we're committed to innovation and excellence in connecting project data, processes, and people.



We're looking for a Staff Platform Developer to join our Platform Engineering team and help build the foundation that our AI\-powered future runs on. This is a senior, hands\-on role that spans three connected areas: the data platform that feeds our AI and analytics, the harness engineering that makes our agentic framework reliable in production, and our agentic software factory, where AI agents help us design, build, test, and ship software.



You'll be a technical anchor for the team. You'll write a lot of code, but you'll also set patterns, raise the bar on engineering quality, and mentor developers as agentic practices spread across the organization. You'll work closely with our Lead Architect, the Platform Engineering team, and the product teams building on top of the platform, all while we complete our transition from Azure to AWS with the support of our strategic AWS partnership.



Newforma manages billions of emails, documents, and project artifacts for construction teams around the world. We've already shipped AI features like Smart Email Filing, and we're building an extensible agentic framework that orchestrates many specialized agents to search, answer questions, and take action for our users. At the same time, we're changing how we build software, moving from AI\-assisted coding toward an agentic software factory where product intent goes in and tested pull requests come out.



All of this depends on a strong platform underneath. You'll help us solve three problems at once:


* Data: getting the right data, in the right shape, to the right agents and dashboards, in near real time
* Harness engineering: giving agents the tools, context, guardrails, evaluations, and observability they need to behave reliably at scale
* The agentic factory: building the pipelines, quality gates, and developer tooling that let agents contribute production\-grade code safely

**Responsibilities for this role include:**



Data Platform \& Engineering


* Contribute to the design and build\-out of our medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold layers) on AWS, supporting both AI initiatives and analytics
* Build and operate event\-driven data flows (Kafka/MSK, EventBridge, Kinesis, SQS/SNS) that keep search indexes, vector stores, and analytics pipelines in sync with source systems
* Define repeatable patterns for onboarding new datasets into the platform, including change data capture, snapshots, and deltas
* Build indexing and embedding pipelines that feed our vector databases and semantic search capabilities
* Ensure data is governed, secure, and tenant\-aware, working with our DevSecOps practice on access controls and compliance
* Partner with our data architect and data engineers on data modeling, quality checks, and lineage

Harness Engineering for Our Agentic Framework


* Build and evolve the agent harness: the runtime, tool interfaces, context management, memory, and orchestration that our agents run on
* Design how agents access Newforma data and capabilities through well\-defined tools and APIs, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
* Implement guardrails, permission boundaries, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns so agents act safely on behalf of users
* Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent quality, catch regressions, and let teams ship agent changes with confidence
* Establish observability for agentic systems: tracing, cost and token tracking, latency, and failure analysis
* Support multi\-model strategies (AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) with routing, fallbacks, and cost optimization
* Make it easy for product teams to build new agents on the framework through reusable components, templates, and clear documentation

Agentic Software Factory


* Help build our agentic software factory, the pipeline that takes product intent through specification, agent implementation, automated quality gates, and human review to a merged pull request
* Design and implement the harness that coding agents operate within: repository context, specifications, test scaffolding, and sandboxed execution environments
* Build automated quality gates (tests, static analysis, security scanning, graders) that make AI\-generated code trustworthy
* Measure and improve factory throughput, quality, and cost, and identify where human review adds the most value
* Integrate the factory with our CI/CD pipelines, Pulumi\-managed infrastructure, and developer workflows
* Help teams adopt agentic coding practices and share what works across the engineering organization

Technical Leadership


* Act as a senior technical voice on the Platform Engineering team, setting patterns and standards others build on
* Lead technical design for cross\-cutting platform initiatives and write clear design documents
* Mentor developers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing
* Collaborate with the Lead Architect on platform direction and architecture decisions
* Contribute to our Azure\-to\-AWS transition, ensuring new platform capabilities are built AWS\-native
* Occasionally support production systems, including participation in an on\-call rotation

**Required qualifications for this role include:**


* 8\+ years of software development experience, with at least 3 years working on platforms, infrastructure, or data systems used by other engineering teams
* Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of TypeScript/Node.js or C\#/.NET
* Hands\-on experience building production syst

Ces données sont utilisées par l’ensemble de notre infrastructure publicitaire, et nos API constituent la source de référence pour la diffusion, la facturation et la production de rapports.


Ce poste ne consiste pas simplement à créer une API avant de passer au prochain projet. Les données que vous modélisez sont utilisées par des systèmes dont vous n’êtes pas responsable, dans des processus où une valeur erronée peut entraîner des pertes financières. Vous concevrez des contrats qui demeurent stables à mesure que le produit évolue, veillerez à la cohérence des états entre les différents services et assumerez la responsabilité de l’exactitude et de la disponibilité de l’ensemble de ces éléments en production.


Ce poste convient parfaitement à une personne qui maîtrise autant le côté serveur que le côté client, qui accorde une grande importance aux contrats de données et à l’exactitude, et qui souhaite assumer pleinement la responsabilité de systèmes dont dépendent d’autres équipes de développement.

**Ce que vous allez faire**
---------------------------

* Concevoir, développer et exploiter des services dans notre plateforme TypeScript (NestJS) pour un vaste modèle de domaine, tout en étant responsable des API et des contrats de données dont dépendent les systèmes publicitaires en aval.
* Modéliser les données d’entité en tenant compte de l’évolutivité et des changements, notamment par la conception de schémas relationnels, les migrations et l’évolution des schémas des tables utilisées pour la diffusion, la facturation et la production de rapports.
* Concevoir et développer des intégrations événementielles avec Kafka et Google Cloud Pub/Sub, au moyen de modèles tels que la boîte d’envoi transactionnelle et les consommateurs idempotents, afin de maintenir la cohérence entre les différents services.
* Créer les interfaces destinées aux utilisateur(rice)s dans React et TypeScript, en transformant des données complexes sur les entités et la performance en processus auxquels les éditeur(rice)s et les annonceur(euse)s peuvent se fier.
* Exploiter les solutions que vous développez sur Kubernetes, où le service déclare sa propre infrastructure infonuagique avec son code, et assumer pleinement la responsabilité de ses objectifs de niveau de service.
* Renforcer l’observabilité et la qualité de la plateforme au moyen du traçage distribué, des mesures et des cadres de test.
* Établir les normes de développement du service et veiller à leur respect lors des revues de conception et de code, tout en accompagnant les développeur(euse)s.

**Ce que nous recherchons**
---------------------------

* Au moins six ans d’expérience en développement et en exploitation de logiciels en production, avec une expertise approfondie des services côté serveur et des technologies modernes côté client.
* Une maîtrise avancée de TypeScript et une expérience avec un cadre modulaire structuré pour Node côté serveur, comme NestJS, ou avec une architecture comparable reposant sur l’injection de dépendances et les modules.
* De solides compétences en modélisation de données et en SQL, notamment en conception de schémas, en migrations et en optimisation de la performance à grande échelle, ainsi qu’un bon jugement en matière de gestion des versions d’API. Vous avez déjà dû modifier de façon sécuritaire des données utilisées par d’autres équipes.
* Une expérience des systèmes événementiels, comme Kafka, Pub/Sub ou un outil comparable. Vous comprenez les garanties de livraison, l’ordre des événements, l’idempotence et les conséquences d’une divergence entre deux systèmes.
* Une maîtrise avancée de React ainsi qu’un excellent jugement en matière de conception de composants, de gestion des états et de performance des interfaces qui traitent un volume important de données.
* Une expérience de l’exploitation infonuagique native, notamment des services conteneurisés sur Kubernetes, et une capacité à assumer la responsabilité d’un système en production, y compris son déploiement, sa mise à l’échelle, sa surveillance, l’intervention en cas d’incident et les périodes de disponibilité sur appel.
* Un fort sens des responsabilités, axé sur l’exactitude, l’observabilité et la maintenabilité à long terme, soutenu par une discipline rigoureuse en matière de tests, de revues et d’accessibilité.

**Vous avez peut\-être également (facultatif)**
-----------------------------------------------

* Expérience avec Go.
* Expérience dans les systèmes publicitaires, d’attribution, de facturation ou de monétisation.
* Expérience de l’infrastructure en tant que code, notamment la gestion des ressources native à Kubernetes, Terraform ou les maillages de services.

jobs.description:
**What if you could redefine what’s possible? With us, you can.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------

With us, you can. You want **Purpose. Growth. Opportunity.** People who get it.
We are the home of ambitious, passionate, and innovative world shapers.
With an unmatched breadth and depth of engineering, advisory and science\-based expertise, our global minds unite to power local solutions.
We are pathfinders and impact makers.
We are **Visioneers** .
We are **WSP** .
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

The A **I Adoption \& Enablement Analyst** ensures support readiness by creating knowledge base content and delivering targeted enablement for the Service Desk and OSS to improve first\-contact resolution. The role also measures and communicates impact by tracking adoption and value metrics, analyzing trends to remove barriers, and producing dashboards and leadership readouts with clear recommendations.
Beyond that, the role is the operating engine behind WSP’s AI governance. It manages the intake and triage of new AI requests, coordinates cross\-functional review and approval, and keeps decision records accurate and audit\-ready. This is a role built on trust and judgement. You will work shoulder to shoulder with the leader of AI adoption and enablement, carrying decisions to closure on their behalf and owning the day\-to\-day management of AI requests.
**Your Impact**
---------------

You will:
* Maintain a governed, searchable library of approved playbooks and prompts, including version control, change notes, and the deprecation of outdated patterns.
* Create and maintain knowledge base articles, including how\-to guidance, troubleshooting, known issues, and escalation paths, to keep the Service Desk and OSS ready to support AI tools and products.
* Deliver targeted enablement for support teams through walkthroughs, office hours, and release briefings to reduce time\-to\-resolution and improve first\-contact support.
* Track and report adoption and value metrics, including usage, retention, feature penetration, and time saved, with segmentation by persona, region, and business line.
* Analyze trends to identify adoption barriers and opportunities and recommend targeted actions such as new playbooks, training updates, or product feedback.
* Produce dashboards and monthly or quarterly leadership readouts that connect adoption metrics to outcomes, risks, and recommended next steps.
* Act as the first point of contact for incoming AI requests, assessing each against established risk and suitability criteria and recommending the appropriate review route.
* Review incoming submissions for completeness and quality, follow up with requesters for missing detail, and keep them informed at every stage so reviewers receive requests that are ready to assess.
* Coordinate the AI review and approval forum end to end, including agendas, pre\-reads, scheduling, minutes, decisions, and follow\-through on action items, bringing together stakeholders from across the business and specialist functions.
* Prepare the assessment material for each request under review, drafting the business perspective and consolidating specialist input ahead of the meeting rather than during it.
* Track decisions through to closure and keep governance records accurate, current, and audit\-ready.
* Extend reporting to cover governance as well as adoption, including request volumes, review outcomes, and cycle times, so leadership has a clear view of what is in progress and how long decisions take.
* Prepare the data, briefing notes, and talking points behind leadership presentations, steering forums, and business\-line conversations.

**The Skills That Set You Apart**
---------------------------------

You bring:
* Demonstrated success working in a matrixed environment, aligning priorities across teams to execute shared goals.
* Experience developing and maintaining reusable AI playbooks and prompt patterns, including version control, change notes, and retirement of outdated content.
* Working knowledge of responsible AI and safe\-use practices, including privacy, confidentiality, and data handling, and the ability to embed quality and verification guardrails into enablement materials.
* Strong technical writing skills with experience producing knowledge base content, including how\-to guidance, troubleshooting, known issues, and escalation paths, and applying content standards and taxonomy to keep information easy to find.
* Proven ability to enable support teams with a focus on improving first\-contact resolution and time\-to\-resolution.
* Strong analytical skills with experience tracking adoption and value metrics, including usage, retention, feature penetration, and time saved, and segmenting insights by persona, region, and business line.
* Experience producing dashboards and leadership readouts that connect metrics to outcomes, risks, and clear recommendations.
* Ability to identify adoption barriers, synthesize root causes, and drive improvements through updated playbooks, targeted enablement, and actionable product feedback.
* Sound judgement, with the ability to take ownership of a problem and instinctively recognize which decisions need to be escalated.
* Experience coordinating a governance, review, or approval body, including agendas, pre\-reads, cross\-functional reviewers, decision records, and disciplined follow\-up on actions.
* Hands\-on dashboard and reporting skills using Power BI and the Microsoft 365 toolset, comfort with enterprise service management and collaboration platforms, and the discipline to keep records clean, current, and audit\-ready.
