jobs.title: Développeur BI
jobs.description:
**Relève du :** Directeur, Développement corporatif et BI d’entreprise

  

Depuis plus de 70 ans, Walter Technologies pour surfaces est un chef de file mondial dans les technologies de traitement de surface, offrant des abrasifs haute performance, des outils, des outils électriques, des solutions chimiques et des solutions de procédés de soudage spécialement conçus pour l’industrie du travail des métaux. Notre philosophie repose sur l’objectif d’aider nos clients à mieux travailler en leur offrant « seulement ce qu’il y a de mieux » : la meilleure technologie, les meilleurs produits, la meilleure performance, le meilleur en matière de sécurité et le meilleur en matière de durabilité, le tout afin d’accroître leur productivité et leur rentabilité.

 **Sommaire du poste**


Walter Technologies pour surfaces est à la recherche d’un développeur BI senior pratique et orienté terrain afin de développer, maintenir et soutenir son environnement d’intelligence d’affaires et d’analytique.

  

En travaillant avec Sigma, Power BI, Snowflake, SQL et dbt, le développeur BI senior traduira les besoins d’affaires en solutions de données et de rapports précises, évolutives et bien gouvernées. Le rôle combine le développement BI, la modélisation des données, le soutien en production, la validation, la documentation et une collaboration étroite avec les parties prenantes internes. Il soutiendra également la migration des flux de travail Alteryx et d’autres processus de rapports existants vers des solutions Snowflake et dbt maintenables.

  

La personne retenue sera à l’aise d’utiliser des outils de développement assisté par l’IA, tels que Codex ou Claude Code, afin d’améliorer la productivité, la qualité du code, la documentation, les tests et le dépannage, tout en respectant les exigences de l’entreprise en matière de sécurité et de gouvernance des données.

 **Responsabilités clés**

* Concevoir, développer, tester, déployer et maintenir des tableaux de bord, rapports, jeux de données et modèles sémantiques à l’aide de Sigma et Power BI.
* Traduire les besoins d’affaires en solutions BI intuitives et évolutives, appuyées par des mesures, dimensions et définitions d’affaires cohérentes.
* Développer et maintenir des transformations SQL et des modèles analytiques dans Snowflake.
* Contribuer aux modèles dbt, aux tests, à la documentation et aux standards de développement.
* Surveiller les rapports critiques, les jeux de données, les actualisations, les passerelles et les processus connexes.
* Diagnostiquer les échecs de rapports, les enjeux de performance, les problèmes d’accès et les enjeux de qualité des données à travers les couches de rapports et de données.
* Évaluer les flux de travail Alteryx et migrer la logique d’affaires appropriée vers des modèles SQL et dbt maintenables.
* Valider et réconcilier les nouvelles solutions ou les solutions migrées avec les systèmes sources, les résultats existants et les règles d’affaires approuvées.
* Utiliser Git, GitHub et des outils de développement assisté par l’IA tels que Codex ou Claude Code pour soutenir le contrôle de version, la revue de code, les tests, la documentation, le dépannage et le déploiement contrôlé.
* Faire preuve de jugement dans l’utilisation des outils d’IA et protéger les renseignements confidentiels, propriétaires et sensibles conformément aux politiques de l’entreprise.
* Maintenir la documentation relative aux modèles de données, règles d’affaires, dépendances, responsabilités, traçabilité et procédures de soutien.
* Collaborer avec les équipes Finance, Ventes et Marketing, Chaîne d’approvisionnement, Opérations et autres fonctions concernant les besoins, les tests, la formation, le déploiement et l’adoption.
* Identifier les occasions de consolider les rapports redondants, de réduire la dette technique et d’améliorer la performance, la fiabilité et la maintenabilité.

 **Qualifications**

* Solides compétences en SQL et capacité à travailler avec des jeux de données relationnelles complexes.
* Expérience pratique dans le développement et le soutien de tableaux de bord, rapports, modèles sémantiques ou jeux de données analytiques gouvernés à l’aide de Sigma, Power BI ou d’une autre plateforme BI moderne.
* Expérience avec Snowflake ou une plateforme de données infonuagique comparable.
* Connaissance de dbt ou d’un autre cadre de transformation de données basé sur SQL.
* Compréhension pratique de la modélisation dimensionnelle, des tables de faits et de dimensions, de l’entreposage de données et des concepts ETL ou ELT.
* Expérience en validation et réconciliation des données entre les systèmes sources, les transformations et les rapports.
* Familiarité avec Git, GitHub, la revue de code et les pratiques de déploiement contrôlé.
* Expérience avec des outils de développement assisté par l’IA tels que Codex, Claude Code ou des outils comparables, considérée comme un atout.
* Capacité à évaluer le code et le contenu générés par l’IA pour en assurer l’exactitude, la sécurité, la maintenabilité et l’alignement avec les besoins d’affaires.
* Fortes compétences analytiques et en résolution de problèmes, avec une grande attention à l’exactitude et à la qualité des données.
* Capacité à gérer le travail depuis les besoins et la conception jusqu’aux tests, au déploiement, à la documentation et au soutien.
* Solides compétences en communication et capacité à expliquer des concepts de données et de rapports à des publics non techniques.

**À propos d’AppDirecte**



Devenez un citoyen du monde à l’ère numérique et outillez une nouvelle génération d’entrepreneurs branchés aux quatre coins du globe. AppDirecte offre une plateforme d’abonnement permettant de vendre n’importe quel produit en tant que service, et ce, par n’importe quel canal et sur n’importe quel appareil. Nous alimentons des millions d’abonnements pour le compte d’organisations de partout dans le monde. Notre action est toujours guidée par nos valeurs et notre culture – une culture qui vous permet d’être vu, de rester authentique et d’exceller.


**Votre profil**



Nous sommes à la recherche d’une personne compétente et ambitieuse pour combler un poste de développeur/développeuse logiciel à Montréal. Vous êtes un développeur fullstack technique et impliqué, passionné par la production de code maintenable et robuste? * Participer à l’effort de migration vers une architecture axée sur les microservices.

jobs.description:
\-Version française à suivre\-

**About Stay22**
  

Based in Montreal, Stay22 helps ambitious creators and intent\-rich digital platforms turn their existing traffic into incremental revenue, with technology that works quietly in the background.
  

Today, more than 6,500 creators and platforms rely on Stay22, with over $1 billion in annual transactions flowing through the platform. Originally built for travel, the company now supports partners across retail, lifestyle, publishing, events, and transport as it expands its monetization infrastructure for the modern creator economy.
  

**About the role**  

At Stay22, integrations with external travel suppliers are core to our product. The Integrations squad ensures third\-party data is clean, reliable, and available to power our platform.

We're seeking a **Fullstack Developer** who thrives on connecting complex systems, primarily focused on backend development. You'll shape how we ingest, normalize, and manage supplier data, working closely with our Product Manager in a dynamic, fast\-moving environment. Your expertise in **Node.js** and **TypeScript** will be critical to ensuring our platform remains robust, scalable, and reliable.
  

**Key Responsibilities**
  

* Contribute to the design, development, and rollout of supplier integrations and data pipelines.
* Build and maintain integration services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript.
* Integrate data from APIs, SFTP, and other feeds, ensuring reliable ingestion and updates.
* Implement supplier\-specific deep\-linking solutions for a seamless user experience.
* Parse, normalize, and store large volumes of listings data to support search and booking features.
* Retrieve and integrate booking and commission data for accurate reporting.
* Ensure pipelines meet best practices for security, scalability, and observability; collaborate with Infrastructure on CI/CD, secrets management, and monitoring.
* Partner with other squads to maximize data value for user\-facing features and analytics.
* Contribute to clean, maintainable code and continuous improvement.

  

**Requirements**
  

* 3\+ years in backend/fullstack development with Node.js, TypeScript, and databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
* Experience building scalable APIs and web services; cloud experience (GCP preferred); Python a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving skills for complex data integration challenges.
* Experience improving code quality, and team practices.
* Comfortable with agile development, rapid iteration, and shifting priorities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with product managers and cross\-functional teams.

* English proficiency is required for daily communication with international colleagues.


* B.S./M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent experience.


  

**What to Expect from our Hiring Process**
  

We know your time's valuable, so here's the quick rundown of what to expect.
* Screening call with our Talent Acquisition Advisor \- virtual (20\-30 minutes)


* Hiring Manager Interview \- virtual (30min)


* Whiteboarding session oriented on System Design (Miro) with the Engineering Team \- virtual (60 minutes)


* Panel Interview with stakeholders and peers \- in person (45min)


* Final interview with our CEO \- virtual (30 minutes)


Offer \& Onboarding
*Please note that this process is subject to change at any point, based on additional requirements from the team.*  

  

**Why join Stay22?**
* **Prime Montreal Location**: Work from our vibrant Little Italy HQ with a cafeteria allowance, full gym access, and a rooftop terrace complete with a seasonal basketball/pickleball court \& hockey rink.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health \& dental coverage, RRSP matching, fully paid STM pass', and regular team socials, events, and retreats.
* **Flexibility That Works:** Flexible schedules, work\-from\-anywhere opportunities, year\-end shutdown, and flex days.


*(Stay22 is an equal\-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration. If you have a disability or particular need that requires accommodation, please contact us at* *careers@stay22\.com**)*



Your application will be reviewed by **Nayo**, our internal recruiter\- even if you don't meet every requirement but you're excited, let's talk.

  


***\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_***  


  

**À propos de Stay22**
  

Basée à Montréal, Stay22 aide les créateurs ambitieux et les plateformes numériques à forte intention à transformer leur trafic existant en revenus additionnels, grâce à une technologie qui fonctionne discrètement en arrière\-plan.
  

Aujourd'hui, plus de 6 500 créateurs et plateformes font confiance à Stay22, avec plus d'un milliard de dollars en transactions annuelles transitant par la plateforme. Initialement conçue pour le secteur du voyage, l'entreprise accompagne désormais des partenaires dans les domaines du commerce de détail, du lifestyle, de l'édition, des événements et du transport, alors qu'elle poursuit l'expansion de son infrastructure de monétisation pour l'économie moderne des créateurs.
  

**À propos du poste**
  

Chez Stay22, les intégrations avec des fournisseurs de voyages externes sont au cœur de notre produit. L'équipe Intégrations s'assure que les données tierces sont fiables, bien structurées et exploitables à grande échelle.
  

Nous recherchons un·e **développeur·se Fullstack**, avec une forte dominante backend, pour concevoir et faire évoluer nos intégrations fournisseurs et nos pipelines de données. Vous travaillerez étroitement avec le chef de produit dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution, en mettant à profit votre expertise en **Node.js et TypeScript** pour garantir performance, fiabilité et croissance.
  

**Responsabilités principales**  

* Contribuer, développer et déployer les intégrations fournisseurs et pipelines de données.
* Construire et maintenir des API et services d'intégration robustes (Node.js, TypeScript).

Nous offrons à nos clients des solutions juridiques personnalisées et innovantes en droit des affaires, en droit du travail et de l’emploi, en litige et en règlement des différends, en propriété intellectuelle et en droit public et administratif.

Plus d’un siècle de conseils juridiques donne à notre organisation une âme que l’on ne retrouve nulle part ailleurs. L’authenticité et la poursuite des plus hauts standards de la profession cohabitent avec nos valeurs d’excellence, de collaboration, d’audace et d’entrepreneuriat, qui guident nos actions chaque jour.

**Sommaire du poste**

Lavery cherche à agrandir son équipe interne pour développer des outils numériques qui soutiennent directement la pratique du droit (transcription sécurisée, assistants d’IA, automatisation de tâches juridiques, etc.).

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(se) plateforme \& DevOps pour concevoir et faire évoluer notre plateforme technique, qui s’appuie à la fois sur des infrastructures cloud (dont Azure) et sur une infrastructure privée (« on premise »), automatiser les déploiements, assurer la sécurité et le monitoring, et contribuer aux fondations techniques nécessaires aux outils d’IA.

Cette personne jouera également un rôle clé de responsable de la plateforme et de la mise en production, avec un pouvoir formel de « go / no go » sur les déploiements au regard des exigences de sécurité, fiabilité et maintenabilité.

Ce rôle relèvera directement du directeur principal de l’innovation et de la transformation numérique.

**Description du poste**

* Concevoir, mettre en place et maintenir l’infrastructure nécessaire (cloud et « on premise », incluant Azure) pour les applications internes.
* Mettre en œuvre et faire évoluer des pipelines de CI/CD (p. ex. GitHub Actions) pour le « build », les tests et le déploiement.
* Gérer l’infrastructure « as code » (p. ex. Terraform) pour décrire et versionner les ressources.
* Conteneuriser les applications avec Docker et gérer les environnements (développement, test, production).
* Mettre en place le monitoring et l’observabilité (logs, métriques, alertes) pour les services déployés.
* Développer des scripts et petits services backend (en particulier avec Python) pour automatiser les opérations, l’ingestion de données et certaines tâches récurrentes.
* Assurer l’intégration de solutions tierces (plugiciels, connecteurs, API, MCP, etc.) avec les systèmes internes et les produits développés à l’interne.
* Collaborer avec l’équipe TI pour la sécurité, la gestion des accès et l’intégration au système d’information existant.
* Contribuer au socle technique des futurs outils d’IA (pipelines de données, indexation, suivi des performances et des coûts).

**Rôle de responsable plateforme / mise en production**

* Définir, documenter et faire évoluer les critères d’acceptation pour la mise en production (sécurité, performance minimale, monitoring, alertes, sauvegardes, capacité de rollback, etc.).
* Vérifier que ces critères sont respectés avant tout déploiement en production.
* Agir comme référent(e) pour la sécurité, la fiabilité et la maintenabilité des systèmes en production, en collaboration avec l’équipe TI.
* Exercer, au besoin, un droit de blocage (« go / no go ») sur un déploiement lorsque les critères de sécurité ou de stabilité ne sont pas remplis, et proposer les actions nécessaires pour y remédier.
* Travailler avec la référence technique (Développeur(se) Full Stack \& IA) et le/la propriétaire de produit « PO » (profil Frontend UX) pour concilier les enjeux de délai de mise sur le marché (« time to market ») avec les exigences de robustesse et de conformité.

Exigences

* B. Sc Informatique, B. Eng Informatique / Logiciel, ou formation équivalente
* 3 ans et plus d’expérience en développement logiciel et/ou en rôle DevOps / plateforme.
* Solides bases en développement backend avec au moins un langage parmi C\#, Java ou Node.js, avec bonnes pratiques (tests unitaires, revue de code, gestion des dépendances).
* À l’aise avec Python pour des scripts, outils internes et automatisations.
* À l’aise avec les environnements Linux, Windows et macOS et les outils de ligne de commande.
* Bonne maîtrise de Git et des workflows de développement collaboratif.
* Expérience avec au moins une base de données SQL (p. ex. SQL Server, PostgreSQL) et idéalement une base NoSQL comme MongoDB.
* Compréhension des principes de CI/CD, d’infrastructure as code et de déploiement automatisé.
* Sens aigu de la sécurité, de la confidentialité et de la fiabilité des systèmes.
* Intérêt marqué pour les données et l’IA appliquée (même si une expertise avancée n’est pas exigée).

**Environnement technique (à titre indicatif)**

La maîtrise de l’ensemble des technologies ci\-dessous n’est pas exigée; une expérience significative avec une partie de cet environnement constitue néanmoins un atout important :

* Systèmes / environnements : Linux, Windows, macOS
* Cloud / infra : Azure, infrastructure privée (on premise)
* Langages : C\#, Java, Node.js, Python
* Bases de données : SQL (T SQL ou équivalent), MongoDB
* Infra as Code : Terraform (ou équivalent)
* Conteneurisation : Docker
* Contrôle de version : Git
* CI/CD : GitHub Actions (ou outils similaires)
* Tests : tests unitaires et intégration des tests dans les pipelines CI/CD

La Commission de la construction du Québec (CCQ) joue un rôle crucial au sein de l’industrie de la construction au Québec. Travailler à la Commission de la construction du Québec, c'est donc contribuer à l'essor d'une industrie stimulante au cœur du paysage québécois. Vous y retrouverez une atmosphère de travail conviviale et stimulante.

  


**Les avantages de vous joindre à nous :**

  

* Programme de rémunération compétitif

* + - Modules/composants:
* + - * FI, CO, MM, GL, BL, AA, AP, Gestion de la paye
* + - Méthodologies:
* + - * Agile, kanban et DevOps

* + Élabore ou participe à la rédaction de différents types de documents et rapports.

* + Apprend de façon autodidacte via des outils de perfectionnement (Ex : livre, site internet, vidéo en ligne, etc.) et/ou participe à des activités de formation et/ou de transfert de connaissances sur les technologies et méthodologies requises pour l’exécution de ses tâches, en fonction des choix et des orientations qui sont prises par l’équipe, la gestion ou l’organisation.

* + Maintien des communications régulières et adéquates auprès de tous les intervenants.

* + Diagnostique et résout les problèmes rencontrés dans ses livrables et ceux de son équipe et/ou des autres directions lorsque nécessaire.

C\#

Le poste concerne un développeur C\#/.NET qui rejoindra l’équipe de trading électronique Fixed Income. jobs.description:
**About CAMP Systems:**  

At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting\-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600\+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.


**Our Mission \& Vision:**  

We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.


**Our Values \& Excellence Mindset:**  

We are customer obsessed, trust\-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

  


**What You Will Experience in This Role:**



CAMP is seeking a Quality Assurance Manager who is excited to join a role that balances aviation industry compliance, analyst service, and software delivery quality. The QA Manager will lead and continuously improve our Quality Management System (QMS), ensure compliance with aviation industry standards, and drive software release quality across CAMP's SaaS platforms. The successful candidate will combine a deep background in aviation quality assurance with the analytical and technical fluency required in a modern, data\-driven software organization.


**Responsibilities:**


* Lead the QA team to achieve quality objectives and ensure the delivery of high\-quality products and services to our clients across both aviation compliance and software platforms.
* Develop and maintain the QMS in compliance with aviation industry standards, including ISO 9001 and AS9100\.
* Oversee internal and external audits, ensuring that all procedures and services meet stringent quality requirements.
* Drive quality escape resolution forward including root cause analysis, corrective action, and follow\-up in accordance with corresponding SLAs.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on data\-driven analysis, root cause investigation, and industry best practices.
* Manage and mentor QA team members, fostering an environment of continual professional growth and expertise in quality assurance.
* Work cross\-functionally with operations, product, engineering, customer support, and other departments to integrate quality assurance methodologies throughout the organization.
* Leverage AI\-assisted quality tooling and BI dashboards (e.g., Power BI) to surface trends, monitor KPIs, and present data\-driven insights to senior leadership.
* Report directly to senior leadership with regular updates on QMS performance, audit outcomes, and quality metrics.


**You have:**


* Bachelor’s degree in quality management, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Masters preferred.
* Minimum of 7 years' experience in a QA management role, specifically within the aviation, aerospace, or aviation SaaS sector.
* Certifications such as Certified Quality Manager (CQM), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or equivalent is highly desirable.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation industry regulatory requirements and quality management systems (ISO 9001, AS9100\).
* Experience with QMS software platforms and quality tracking tools; proficiency with BI/analytics tools such as Power BI.
* Exceptional leadership skills with a record of developing effective QA teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement and implement strategic quality plans spanning compliance and software delivery contexts.
* Superb communication, organizational, and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and responsibilities simultaneously.

  


**Why Work at CAMP?**



Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.



CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer – vets/disabled

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

The Data Quality Analyst is responsible for ensuring that all data products delivered on the Microsoft Fabric platform are accurate, reliable, and fully aligned with business objectives defined through the Goal–Question–Metrics (GQM) model. This role validates data quality across the Medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold) by applying CAE’s Data Platform Coding Framework to perform end\-to\-end testing of data acquisition flows. It also ensures that data products comply with governance standards through Microsoft Purview, including the evaluation of metadata, lineage, and data security controls.


Acting as a key bridge between business and technical teams, the Data Quality Analyst manages defects, verifies performance and data integrity, and drives continuous improvement to ensure that analytics outputs are trusted, auditable, and enable effective data\-driven decision\-making.


**Responsibilities:**

* Ensure data products align with business goals (GQM) and are fully traceable from source to Power BI.
* Validate data quality across bronze, silver, and gold layers, and confirm Fabric data products are complete, reliable, and production ready.
* Test Power BI reports end\-to\-end to ensure accurate visuals and metrics.
* Enforce governance standards using Purview, including metadata, lineage and quality scoring.

jobs.title: DevOps Analyst, CI/CD Pipelines
jobs.description:
**Venture outside the ordinary \- TMX Careers**

The TMX group of companies includes leading global exchanges such as the Toronto Stock Exchange, Montreal Exchange, and numerous innovative organizations enhancing capital markets. United as a global team, we’re connecting cross\-functionally, traversing industries and geographies, moving opportunity into action, advancing global economic growth, and propelling progress. Through a rich exchange of ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a nimble operating model, we're powering some of the nation's most critical systems, fueling capital formation and innovation, bringing increased opportunity to business visionaries, product ingenuity to consumers, and career exploration to our team.


**Ready to be part of the action?**

Global Technology Services (GTS) is a foundational division of TMX Group that empowers internal business lines through technology, operations, and digital innovation. As a client\-centric organization, GTS builds capabilities, delivers technology initiatives, and enables effective financial and resource management across the enterprise.


We are seeking a highly motivated **DevOps Analyst, CI/CD Pipelines** to join our team. Reporting to the DevOps Lead, Tools, this role acts as the primary pipeline specialist for development squads—helping them build, standardize, and troubleshoot efficient build/test/deploy workflows across GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline, and Jenkins.


* **Reports to:** DevOps Lead, Tools
* **Job Location:** This role is hybrid (2\-3 days/week in the office) \- based in Montreal, QC

**Key Accountabilities**

* **CI/CD Pipeline Design \& Support:** Design, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines across GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline, and Jenkins to enable reliable, secure, and automated delivery.
* **Standardization \& Documentation:** Build reusable pipeline artifacts (GitHub reusable workflows, GitLab templates, Jenkins shared libraries) as "golden path" standards; create clear runbooks, how\-to guides, and self\-serve documentation.
* **DevOps Best Practices \& Guardrails:** Drive enterprise adoption of DevOps practices, establish lightweight policy\-as\-code guardrails (branch protection, pipeline approval gates), and monitor pipeline flow metrics to identify optimization opportunities.
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& Cloud Management:** Utilize Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible to provision and manage cloud infrastructure (runners, EC2, EKS, RDS) and automate disposable, ephemeral pipeline environments.
* **Containerization \& Orchestration:** Support the building, management, and deployment of containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, and ArgoCD within pipeline workflows.
* **Monitoring \& Observability:** Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions (Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) to analyze pipeline health, diagnose failures, and perform root\-cause analysis.
* **Squad Enablement \& Collaboration:** Partner with cross\-functional development, QA, and operations teams to share knowledge, train squads on self\-service pipeline tools, and drive standard adoption without formal authority.

**Must Have(s)**

* Hands\-on experience designing and supporting CI/CD pipelines across **GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline, and Jenkins** (all required).
* Strong experience building reusable pipeline components (shared libraries, composite actions, CI templates) for cross\-team adoption.
* Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and deep experience with version control systems (Git, GitHub, GitLab).
* Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), OS (Linux/Windows), and networking fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, ArgoCD).
* Experience with pipeline logging and monitoring tools (Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* Strong troubleshooting skills with a proven track record of diagnosing issues directly from logs and metrics.
* Excellent documentation skills and the ability to influence and drive DevOps standard adoption across squads.

**Nice to Have(s)**

* Experience establishing policy\-as\-code guardrails and automated compliance checks within CI/CD workflows.
* Familiarity with tracking and analyzing DORA / flow metrics to optimize pipeline performance.
* **Language Proficiency:** Fluency in French and English (spoken and written) is an asset for this position, as it involves producing documentation for external and internal stakeholders who communicate in both languages.

**In the market for…**

**Excitement** \- Explore emerging technology and innovation, as well as ventures and digital finance that shape the future of global markets! Experience the movement of the market while grounded in the stability of close to 200 years of success.


**Connection** \- With site hubs in some of the world’s most multicultural cities, we leverage our size and structure to create rich connections and belonging while experiencing powerful global impact through our work.


**Impact** \- More than a platform, we use our talents to power mission\-critical systems that drive global economic advancement, innovation, and growth. As well, our employee\-led *Team Impact* spreads social good via our giving strategy.


**Wellness** \- From empathetic leadership to a culture of flexibility and balance, we believe wellness at work creates the maximum yield and a stronger “we”. Plus, with a cloud\-first and hybrid workstyle, as well as generous time\-off and leaves, we support a life well lived!


**Growth** \- From a growth mindset in our work, to expansion in our business, TMX is home to action\-takers energized by the achievement of ambitious growth.


**Ready to enrich your career with impactful work, leaders who truly care, and the flexibility and programs to help

We offer a comprehensive ecosystem of scalable solutions that help our customers meet all the challenges brought about by this era of digital transformation, thanks to our business needs\-driven approach, industry knowledge, cutting\-edge technologies and experts. With its business\-driven approach, in\-depth industry knowledge, cutting\-edge technologies and multicultural team of experts based in North America, the Caribbean, Latin America, Europe, Africa, Asia and Australia, Equisoft helps its customers meet the challenges of this era of digital transformation.  



**Why Choose Equisoft?** With 950\+ employees, we are a stable organization that offers career advancement opportunities and fosters a stimulant environment. If that’s not enough, then check out these other perks below:


* Hiring Location: Canada (Montreal)
* You are working hybrid in a collaborative workspace
* Internal position title: Developer
* Full\-time Permanent Role
* Benefits available day 1: Medical, Dental, Retirement Plan, Telemedicine Program, Employee Assistance Program, etc.
* Flexible hours
* Number of hours per week: 40
* Educational Support (LinkedIn Learning, LOMA Courses and Equisoft University)

**Role:** The Full\-Stack Application Developer (Kotlin\-Java/React), reports to the Director, Product Development, you will be working with a team of 13 members that include developers, QA, business analyst, PO and functional developer. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing various features and components of a web\-based product application built in Kotlin. If you would like to be part of a creative technical team focused on the best practices, innovation and collaboration as well as working in an agile and constantly evolving environment.


Below, is a brief description of the expected product the candidate will be working on


Equisoft/Carbon is a cloud\-native Policy Administration System (PAS) built for insurance carriers. The platform supports the full policy lifecycle, from underwriting and issuance to billing, claims, and commissions, across life, whole life, and annuity products for carriers around the world.
  

Carbon is a product in active growth, with new insurance lines and AI\-powered capabilities on the near\-term roadmap. Joining the team means building something that matters, in one of the most complex and transformation\-driven industries in financial services.


**Your Day with Equisoft:**

* Collaborate in an Agile environment with a dynamic team of software developers, product owners and quality assurance specialists
* Write robust, efficient, and secure code in accordance with functional analyses
* Participate in the analysis of features that meet both business and technology solutions need
* Innovate, challenge and refine requirements based on technical assessment
* Actively participate in peer\-review process and provide constructive feedback
* Participate in and collaborate to functional tests and documentation of actual and future features
* Ensure overall software quality and its evolution in the mid to long\-term
* Ensure quality control through scenario testing to validate systems and programs developed comply with the technical specifications
* Write reliable code based on SOLID software engineering practices
* Fix bugs in a timely manner while working of solving more complex issues
* Collaborate with different teams to solve customer issues.

**Requirements**

**Technical**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or information technology or Equivalent College Degree
* 5 to 7 years of experience in a similar role
* Excellent knowledge and experience with programming language like Kotlin, Java or .Net
* Excellent knowledge with SQL
* Excellent knowledge of microservice architecture
* Good Knowledge and experience with with React or Angular and JavaScript/TypeScript
* Knowledge of GraphQL and REST APIs
* Good knowledge of SOLID principles and OOP
* Knowledge of Agile and Kanban methodologies
* Knowledge in DevOps Azure Pipeline
* Knowledge of security challenges with web\-based applications
* Experience in solving complex software engineering problems

**Soft skill**

* Strong sense of organization and prioritizing
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to communicate, write and synthesize information
* Ability to multi\-task in a rapid\-paced environment
* Team spirit, tact, diplomacy, autonomy, rigor, and discipline

**Nice to haves:**

* Knowledge of Micronaut Framework
* Knowledge in Oauth2, OpenID

**JOIN OUR TEAM!**

**At Couche\-Tard/Circle K, our mission is simple: to make our customer’s lives a little easier everyday.** You may have already stopped for coffee, refueling your car, or eating something on the go. Then, you know what Couche\-Tard/Circle K is. We have grown into a successful global company with over 17,000 stores in 29 countries, serving almost 9 million customers every day. In total, approximately 149,000 people work in our stores and offices. We make journeys easier by offering fast and friendly service. We care about our people and our communities, and we look for ways to uplift people first. Wherever your journey’s going, we can help you get there. Are you ready to grow your career? Let's grow together!

**Business Analyst, Retail Systems**
====================================

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Department:** Global Tech – Retail Systems

**Location:** On site, Laval, QC (4204 boulevard Industriel, H7L 0E3\)

**Type of employment:** Temporary – Maternity Leave Replacement, Full Time (40 hours)

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**THE ROLE**


Reporting the Manager of Retail Systems based in Laval, QC, the position requires extensive operational and business knowledge of Store Systems for convenience stores and fuel operations along with a very good working knowledge of corporate Systems (Merchandising, Fuel, Accounting, Marketing). The responsibilities involve coordination of requests for enhancements from Stakeholders and compiling them into a release for the required systems. The position also involves documentation for various activities regarding new version releases including: Analyzing proposed enhancements from vendors; Collaboration with QA on the drafting of QA \& UAT test plans including test cases; and drafting of communication plans for end users. The candidate will also be an intricate resource and be the lead liaison for the Retails Systems Team regarding demands from the operations and fuel teams.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**


Want to start your career with us? Here's an overview of the main responsibilities of this position:

* Works as a lead member of the Retail systems team with functional and operational knowledge of the NCR Radiant system and the Bulloch system
* Defining development, testing and documentation of business requirements and deliverables on a project\-by\-project basis in collaboration with internal users and departments.
* Participates in defining the development and project plans, including scoping, scheduling, and implementation.
* Leads the definition of the business requirements that are related to the Retail Systems. (i.e. C\-stores and Fuel)
* Plan, facilitate and lead workgroups with internal and external stakeholders to gather, define, analyze and validate business, process, functional, and data requirements and business rules for selected systems.
* Provides support to the user community: training, error solving, system enhancement recommendation, expert office automation advice, query building, etc.
* Responsible for developing and maintaining user manuals to represent current and future systems.
* Creates risk assessment analysis representing a complete and realistic course of probable events.
* Responsible for ensuring system testing, QA \& UAT are properly executed and documented according to the department policies.
* Train end users to operate new and existing store systems technology.

Deuxième plus important réseau de transport collectif dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, exo exploite les services de train, d’autobus et de transport adapté des couronnes nord et sud de Montréal.


Chez exo vous retrouverez une organisation à dimension humaine, tournée vers l’avenir et l’innovation, au service des communautés. Un milieu de travail où, selon la nature de l’emploi, la flexibilité des horaires et le télétravail en mode hybride sont favorisés, facilitant la conciliation travail\-vie personnelle.


Travailler chez exo c’est aussi bénéficier d’une foule d’avantages, tels que : **carte Opus gratuite, assurances collectives, régime de retraite, vacances généreuses, congés fériés, congés maladie et personnels, programme d’aide aux employés, service gratuit de télémédecine pour vous et votre famille et un club social des plus dynamiques. Faites le saut chez exo!**

  

Sous la responsabilité du Chef \- Services de solutions de mobilité, le développeur fait évoluer les applications afin d’ajouter un maximum de valeur aux produits et services d’exo et ainsi satisfaire les clients et l’ensemble des parties prenantes. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec les différents groupes de livraison et il est membre d’une équipe dynamique dédiée à la conception, au développement et à la maintenance des applications sous la gouverne de celle\-ci.

**Responsabilités principales**
-------------------------------

* Concevoir, développer et documenter de nouvelles fonctionnalités selon le cadre standard de développement d’applications établi par exo, selon les meilleures pratiques SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) ;
* Réaliser les tests nécessaires pour livrer une solution fonctionnelle, performante et conforme aux spécifications ;
* Estimer les efforts de développement dans un cadre collaboratif ;
* Influencer la conception des solutions définies par les analystes fonctionnels afin de répondre aux besoins clients ;
* Supporter l’amélioration continue du produit ;
* Contribuer à l’auto\-organisation de l’équipe en partageant les idées et en utilisant les méthodes et outils de collaboration ;
* Intervenir sur le Back End et le Front End des applications ;
* Participer activement aux communautés de pratique en partageant idées et solutions, et contribuer à l'élaboration et l'application des meilleures pratiques et standards définis par l'organisation.


La liste des responsabilités et tâches énumérées précédemment est sommaire et indicative. Il ne s’agit pas d’une liste complète et détaillée des responsabilités et tâches susceptibles d’être effectuées par le titulaire du poste.

**Exigences normales du poste**
-------------------------------

**Scolarité**

* Diplôme d’études collégiales en techniques de l’informatique ou l’équivalent.

**Expérience**

* Minimum de cinq (5\) années d’expérience pertinente ;
* Une expérience ou connaissance du secteur des transports constitue un atout.

**Compétences et aptitudes**

* Possède d’excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles, est un joueur d’équipe et est capable d’enrichir cette dernière avec des idées et connaissances ;
* Autonome, méthodique, structuré dans ses démarches, axée vers les résultats et soucieux des performances algorithmiques ;
* Promouvoir la qualité en mettant l’accent sur l’automatisation des tests, l’amélioration et la livraison continue ;
* Capable d’aborder les enjeux de façon critique et analytique et fait preuve d’une bonne capacité de synthèse et de vulgarisation ;
* Gestion efficace du stress et des priorités ;
* Bonnes connaissances des principes de développement d’applications web ;
* Connaissances de DevOps et de la méthodologie Agile constituent un atout.

**Compétences et aptitudes**

* **Langages de programmation**
	+ C\#
	+ NET Core / .NET Framework
	+ Application Web (Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, MVC)

En travaillant avec nous, vous bénéficierez également d’avantages sociaux attrayants, dont des assurances collectives, 4 semaines de vacances par année ainsi que 13 journées fériées, un régime de retraite à prestations déterminées, des vendredis sans réunion, un Programme de soutien à l’activité physique et plus encore!


Pour connaître tous les avantages que la fonction publique québécoise offre, consultez Quebec.ca.

jobs.description:
**Sommaire de la fonction**

Sous la responsabilité du Chef Développement logiciel, l’Analyste qualité (AQ) veille à ce que les produits du CAIJ répondent aux normes de qualité et aux attentes des clients en examinant, testant et analysant leur fonctionnement avant leur mise sur le marché. En tant qu’Analyste qualité (AQ) au CAIJ, vos responsabilités incluent la conception et l’exécution de scénarios de tests, la détection de défauts ou de bugs, et la collaboration avec l’équipe de produit et TI pour améliorer continuellement nos produits et services.

**Tâches et responsabilités principales**

* Concevoir, écrire et exécuter différents types de tests (manuels, automatisés, fonctionnels, unitaires) pour garantir la qualité des produits.
* Identifier, documenter et assurer le suivi des anomalies, bugs et faiblesses, jusqu’à leur résolution définitive.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les développeurs, gestionnaires de produit et autres équipes interfonctionnelles pour résoudre les problèmes détectés.
* Comprendre les portées (récits, releases, sprints, projets, tests) et élaborer les tests requis pour assurer une couverture adéquate, tant manuelle qu’automatisée.
* Rédiger, maintenir et réutiliser la documentation liée aux tests (plans, scénarios, cas de test, prérequis) et interpréter les résultats d’exécution.
* Cibler les risques liés au déploiement des tests et proposer des plans d’atténuation appropriés;
* Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus, outils et pratiques de qualité logicielle, ainsi qu’à l’élaboration des processus de validation et de vérification.
* Communiquer clairement des concepts techniques et des conclusions à des parties prenantes non techniques.
* Se tenir à jour des meilleures pratiques et avancées en assurance qualité (automatisation, DevOps, intelligence artificielle).
* Proposer et mettre en œuvre des solutions innovantes pour améliorer les processus et systèmes existants.
* Réaliser toute autre tâche connexe selon les besoins de l’organisation.

**Qualifications et compétences**

* Diplôme d’études universitaires en informatique ou expérience équivalente solide en informatique;
* Minimum de 5 ans d’expérience en assurance qualité logicielle sur des applications web (ex. : Python, React, JavaScript, .NET, etc.);
* Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en intégration de tests AQ dans les pipelines CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Bitbucket pipelines);
* Excellente maîtrise des frameworks de tests automatisés (ex. : Playwright, Selenium, JUnit, xUnit, Jest, etc);
* Solide expérience en conception et exécution de tests manuels et automatisés (unitaires, fonctionnels, intégration, système, régression);
* Expérience prouvée dans le test de services web (API REST);
* Connaissances pratiques avérées en SQL/MySQL pour valider l’intégrité des données;
* Connaissance des outils de performance (ex. : JMeter, Locust, Gatling) et notions de tests de sécurité (OWASP Top 10\);
* Familiarité avec Agile/Scrum et le travail en sprints (atout);
* Expérience avec les systèmes de suivi des anomalies (Jira) et les outils de gestion des tests (ex. : TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, etc.);
* Excellentes aptitudes en communication en français écrit et oral;
* Capacité à collaborer et à vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes pour différents publics;
* Fortes habiletés analytiques et sens aigu de la résolution de problèmes;
* Grande attention aux détails et souci de la qualité.

**Particularités**

* 35 heures par semaine (Temps plein)
* Travail en mode hybride (2 journées par semaine en présentiel)
* Disponibilité à l’extérieur des plages de travail normales pour la livraison de projets, les déploiements et les travaux d’entretien et de mise\-à\-jour.

Type d'emploi : Temps plein, Permanent

Avantages :

* Assurance Invalidité
* Assurance Maladie Complémentaire
* Assurance Vie
* Heures d'arrivée et de départ flexibles
* Programme d'Aide aux Employés

* Travail à domicile

jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un Analyste en assurance qualité (QA) qui agira comme référent auprès de l’équipe de développement afin de structurer et de faire évoluer les pratiques de tests.  

  

Dans ce rôle, vous accompagnerez les développeurs, qui réalisent actuellement les tests, dans la mise en place de processus rigoureux et de meilleures pratiques en matière de tests manuels. Vous agirez comme partenaire et coach afin de les guider dans la conception, la structuration et l’amélioration de leurs scénarios de test.  

  

Dans un second temps, vous piloterez une transition progressive vers l’automatisation des tests en adoptant une approche pragmatique. L’objectif sera d’identifier les possibilités d’automatisation offrant la plus grande valeur ajoutée pour l’équipe et le produit.

**Fonctions et responsabilités**


Agir comme référent QA auprès de l’équipe de développement.  

Accompagner et conseiller les développeurs dans l’application des bonnes pratiques de tests.  

Structurer et améliorer les processus de tests manuels existants.  

Accompagner les développeurs dans la création, la révision et l’optimisation des scénarios et cas de test.  

Challenger de manière constructive la couverture, la pertinence et la qualité des tests.  

Assurer une gestion structurée des anomalies et contribuer à l’amélioration de leur suivi.  

Promouvoir des pratiques QA rigoureuses et adaptées à un environnement Agile.  

Optimiser l’utilisation d’Azure DevOps et d’Azure Test Plans dans le cadre des activités de tests.  

Identifier les scénarios pour lesquels l’automatisation présente une réelle valeur ajoutée.  

Piloter progressivement la transition vers une approche d’automatisation des tests intelligente et pragmatique.

**Qualités requises pour réussir dans ce rôle**


Exigences  

  

Minimum de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en assurance qualité (QA).  

Expérience démontrée dans l’accompagnement, le coaching ou le mentorat d’équipes de développement.  

Excellente connaissance des processus et méthodologies de tests logiciels.  

Bonne maîtrise des pratiques ISTQB ou d’une méthodologie équivalente.  

Solide connaissance de la gestion et du suivi des anomalies.  

Expérience de travail dans un environnement Agile.  

Maîtrise avancée de la suite Azure DevOps, particulièrement Azure Test Plans.  

Capacité à structurer et à challenger des scénarios de tests manuels.  

Capacité à identifier les possibilités d’automatisation en fonction de leur valeur ajoutée.  

  

Atouts  

Certification ISTQB.  

Expérience dans la mise en place ou l’évolution d’une stratégie d’automatisation des tests.  

Connaissance d’outils ou de frameworks d’automatisation des tests.

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst - Digital Integrations
jobs.description:
Imperial Brady is a leading distributor of foodservice packaging, facilities maintenance supplies, printing papers, and equipment across North America. With a strong and growing presence in Canada, we proudly serve Canadian businesses and communities with the highest standards of quality, reliability, and service.
  
  

A Deep Canadian Legacy
  
Imperial Brady Canada is deeply rooted in the country, with over 135 years of Canadian history and a workforce of 1,500 Canadian employees. Our operations span 35 locations from coast to coast, including Saint John, Newfoundland and Vancouver, British Columbia—ensuring efficient service and local support nationwide. We are incorporated in Canada, and our 100% Canadian leadership team ensures that decisions for Canada are made in Canada.
  
  

Trusted by Canadian Businesses
  
We are a key distributor partner to many Canadian manufacturers, supporting long\-standing relationships and ensuring the timely availability of high\-quality products. Our Canadian customer service team understands the unique needs of Canadian businesses and delivers tailored solutions with a local touch.
  
  

Imperial Brady Canada, leading national distributor, has a job open in Saint\-Laurent, QC. The IT Business Analyst \- Digital Integrations serves as a critical link between business stakeholders, customers, vendors, and technical teams to drive successful digital transformation and integration initiatives. This role is responsible for supporting and delivering customer and vendor integration projects, documenting business processes and system requirements, managing production support activities, developing operational reporting and performance metrics, and identifying opportunities for process improvements and future technology enhancements.
  
The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis skills with technical aptitude, enabling them to translate business needs into scalable digital solutions while ensuring operational stability and continuous improvement.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Digital Integration Management
  
* Lead and support digital integration projects involving customers, vendors, third\-party partners, and internal systems.
* Gather, analyze, and document business, technical, and data requirements for integrations.
* Facilitate communication between business stakeholders, trading partners, vendors, and development teams.
* Support implementation of APIs, EDI transactions, web services, data exchanges, and other digital connectivity solutions.
* Coordinate project timelines, testing activities, issue resolution, and go\-live readiness.
* Monitor integration performance and proactively address issues impacting business operations.
* Manage onboarding of new digital customers and vendors through established integration processes.
* Collaborate with internal and external partners to improve data accuracy, efficiency, and automation.


Business Analysis \& Requirements Management
  
* Elicit, analyze, validate, and document business requirements for system enhancements, integrations, and operational initiatives.
* Create functional specifications, business requirements documents (BRDs), process flows, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and discovery sessions to identify business needs.
* Translate complex business requirements into actionable technical requirements for development teams.
* Ensure solutions align with business objectives and enterprise technology standards.
* Support change management and user adoption initiatives related to new technology implementations.


Process Documentation \& Optimization
  
* Develop and maintain comprehensive process documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), workflows, and system documentation.
* Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for increased automation and efficiency.
* Create current\-state and future\-state process maps.
* Define, document, and standardize operational procedures across teams and departments.
* Ensure documentation remains accurate and current following system changes or process updates.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort and enhance operational effectiveness.


Reporting \& Team Metrics
  
* Design, develop, and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Analyze business and operational data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for integrations, production support, project delivery, and team effectiveness.
* Prepare recurring management reports and executive summaries.
* Monitor integration volumes, processing performance, service levels, and exception management metrics.
* Support data\-driven decision making across business and IT teams.


Production Support \& System Maintenance
  
* Serve as a primary business resource supporting production applications and integration platforms.
* Investigate and troubleshoot production incidents, data exceptions, and system issues.
* Coordinate issue resolution across business teams, vendors, and technical support organizations.
* Monitor system health and integration processing to ensure operational stability.
* Support release management, application upgrades, system patches, and maintenance activities.
* Document root cause analyses and corrective action plans.
* Ensure production support activities are tracked, communicated, and resolved according to service expectations.


Enhancement Identification \& Strategic Planning
  
* Evaluate enhancement requests and recommend solutions based on business value and operational impact.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize future digital initiatives.
* Develop business cases supporting system improvements and automation opportunities.
* Identify technology gaps and recommend solutions that improve scalability, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
*

**Who We Are:**



Quadbridge is a fast\-growing North American IT solutions provider, empowering businesses to navigate complex challenges daily, through strong partnerships with leading technology providers and close collaboration with our team and customers. With locations in Kitchener, Montreal and Vancouver, we strive to create an energetic, fun workplace where ambitious, like\-minded teammates collaborate, innovate, and thrive as we continue to grow our national footprint.



We are Quadbridge. See how we're building tomorrow's solutions, together.

  


**Role Overview:**



The AI Business Analyst is the bridge between Quadbridge's business stakeholders and the AI Center of Excellence's solution implementation team. You will work directly with stakeholders across the business to understand their challenges and translate them into clear, actionable AI and automation requirements, then stay engaged through delivery as part of the implementation team — working alongside AI Architects, AI Application Developers, and Data Engineers to make sure what gets built actually solves the business problem.

* Partner with business stakeholders and AI Champions to gather, clarify, and document AI and automation requirements.

jobs.description:
**Position Title:**

Lead Information Security Analyst, Data Protection Specialist (T \& I) (Telework/Hybrid)
**Status of Employment:**


Permanent
**Position Language Requirement:**


English, French
**Language Skills:**


English (Reading \- C \- Advanced), English (Speaking \- C \- Advanced), English (Writing \- B \- Intermediate), French (Reading \- C \- Advanced), French (Speaking \- C \- Advanced), French (Writing \- B \- Intermediate)
**Work at CBC/Radio\-Canada**


At CBC/Radio\-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.
  

  

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever\-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.


**Unposting Date:**

2026\-09\-29 11:59 PM
**Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next\-generation public service media organization.**


Technology \& Infrastructure (T\&I) is the backbone and the future\-forward arm of CBC/Radio\-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.


A place with purpose. CBC/Radio\-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.


**This is a hybrid role with a mix of in\-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.**


**Your Role**

  

  

CBC/Radio\-Canada is seeking a Lead Analyst, Data Protection Specialist, to design, lead and evolve the Corporation’s data security program.


In this role, you will provide technical and operational leadership to safeguard sensitive data and personal information throughout the data life cycle (collection, processing, storage, transmission, archiving and destruction). You will collaborate closely with Legal Services, privacy officers, enterprise architects and IT Operations to align data security with regulatory requirements and industry standards.


**This position can be based in Montreal or Toronto.**


**What’s in It for You**


Challenges. We spend our days solving problems of all kinds. Media files are highly nuanced and incredibly complicated; updating, installing and supporting technologies that are organization\-wide and that impact broadcasting content is a time\-sensitive, complex technical feat. And that’s just the beginning. You’ll be working with leading\-edge data management, cloud, IP broadcasting, AI, security and reliability technologies.


**As Lead Analyst, you will:**


* Define data security strategy: Develop and refine the road map for the Corporation’s data protection program.
* Implement data classification: Establish and deploy data classification policies and frameworks.
* Administer data protection technologies: Select, deploy and optimize data loss prevention (DLP) tools.
* Protect cloud and hybrid environments: Design security controls tailored to cloud\-hosted data and hybrid architectures.
* Partner on compliance and policy frameworks: Work closely with the policy, compliance and legal affairs lead to align security controls with statutory requirements.
* Manage the data security risk register: Document, maintain and map risks related to confidentiality, potential data breaches and approved exceptions.
* Adjudicate and govern exception requests: Evaluate, document and follow up on exception requests when standard security controls cannot be immediately applied, ensuring appropriate compensating controls are established.
* Lead data breach response: Actively participate in investigations of suspected or confirmed data breaches in co\-ordination with the Information Security, Legal Services and Incident Response teams.
* Develop metrics and dashboards: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to monitor program effectiveness.
* Assess program maturity: Plan and conduct periodic evaluations, performance reviews and audits of data protection controls to identify gaps, measure maturity progress and formulate recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Maintain industry expertise: Stay current on information security best practices and industry trends.

**What You Bring**


* University degree in computer science, IT or information security.
* Minimum five years’ experience in data protection, privacy security, DLP or data governance, including at least three years in an information security role.
* Proven track record of implementing and evaluating technical data protection programs within large, complex organizations.
* Deep technical expertise in data protection, including cryptography (encryption at rest and in transit, PKI), DLP tools (network, endpoint, cloud), CASB technologies and SQL/NoSQL databases.
* Extensive knowledge of security technology and risk assessment methodologies, policies and processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical decision\-makers (e.g., governance committees, business units, legal teams).
* Excellent analytical, evaluative and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience with compliance programs as well as their technical and security requirements.
* Technical expertise across key domains:
	+ Standards and Frameworks: Strong command of industry standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, 2700

jobs.description:
**HIRING: Role: Cloud Governance Business Analyst**


**Location: Montreal, Canada**


**Work Arrangement:** **100% Onsite 5 Days/Week**


**Working Hours:** **8:00 AM 5:00 PM**


We are looking for a strong **Business Analyst** with experience in **Cloud Governance, Governance Process Definition, Process Modelling, Requirements Analysis, and Documentation** to support a **Cloud First Program**.


The Cloud First Business Analyst will serve as the **Governance Analyst and Documentation Lead**, working under the direction of the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead.


TOP 3 REQUIRED SKILLS


**Business Analysis**


**Designing Governance Processes \& Definitions**


**Basic Azure Cloud Knowledge**


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


The Cloud First Business Analyst serves as the governance analyst and documentation lead for the Cloud First Program. Working under the direction of the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead, the role documents governance entities defines inputs and outputs, models governance processes, and develops the artefacts required to operationalize the Cloud First governance framework.


Purpose of the Role


The role identifies information requirements, analyses governance needs, documents agreed outcomes, develops governance artefacts, and models end\-to\-end processes. Stakeholder engagement, workshop coordination, meeting management, communications, approval follow\-up, and final governance decisions remain with the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead.


Key Responsibilities


1\. Governance Operating Model


Support the Program Management Team and Program Technical Lead in finalizing the definition of all Cloud First governance entities.


Document the purpose, scope, responsibilities, authority, decision rights, membership, and cadence of each governance entity.


Maintain the governance catalogue and operating model.


2\. Inputs and Outputs Definition


Define and document the inputs required by each governance entity.


Define outputs, decisions, approvals, actions, and artefacts produced by each governance entity.


Produce governance interaction models that show information flows between governance bodies.


3\. Governance Process Definition


Work with the Program Technical Lead to define the processes executed within each governance entity.


Document process objectives, triggers, activities, approvals, decision points, and outcomes.


Apply consistent documentation standards across the programme.


4\. Process Modelling and Repository Management


Develop clear process maps and flowcharts for governance processes.


Document workflow dependencies, approvals, escalations, and hand\-offs.


Maintain the governance process repository and supporting artefacts.


Responsibility Boundaries


The Business Analyst supports analysis and documentation, but is not accountable for:


Arranging workshops or meetings


Managing stakeholder communications


Scheduling sessions or maintaining calendars


Chasing stakeholders for feedback


Securing approvals


Owning governance decisions


These activities remain the responsibility of the Cloud First Program Management Team, with support and direction from the Program Technical Lead.


Required Skills and Competencies


Strong business analysis, requirements analysis, and structured documentation skills.


Experience documenting governance operating models, decision rights, RACI matrices, and escalation frameworks.


Proficiency in process mapping, workflow analysis, and modelling dependencies, approvals, and hand\-offs.


Ability to translate complex governance discussions into clear, consistent, and usable artefacts.


Strong written communication, attention to detail, version control, and repository management.


Ability to collaborate effectively with programme management, technical leads, and governance stakeholders.


Preferred Experience and Tools


Experience supporting cloud transformation, cloud adoption, technology governance, or enterprise change programmes.


Working knowledge of common process\-modelling methods and tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, or equivalent.


Experience with Microsoft 365 collaboration and documentation tools, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.


Understanding of governance controls, approval workflows, decision logs, and document lifecycle management.


Education and Experience


Bachelor's degree in business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.


Business analysis or process\-modelling certification is advantageous.


Relevant experience level to be aligned with the organization's role\-grading and project requirements.


Success Measures


Governance artefacts are complete, accurate, consistent, traceable, and ready for review and approval.


Process models clearly show triggers, activities, decision points, approvals, escalations, dependencies, and outcomes.


Governance repositories remain current, controlled, and easy for stakeholders to navigate.


Deliverables are completed in line with agreed programme priorities and documentation standards

jobs.title: Security Analyst (Fluent French)
jobs.description:
**YesWeHack – Hack the Good Way, Save the World (One Bug at a Time)**


At **YesWeHack**, we’re not just another cyber company, we’re a full\-blown movement. Our mission? **Stop cyber attacks in their tracks** with the power of our global Ethical Hackers Network (yep, that’s **135,000\+ badass hackers** and counting ).


Born in 2015 with a spark of rebellion and a whole lot of passion, we’ve grown into the **\#1 Bug Bounty platform in the EU**. From **Paris to Singapore**, we’re helping companies protect their digital stuff by unleashing the skills of real\-world hackers for good.


We’re flipping traditional cybersecurity on its head, using **Bug Bounty programs** to help organizations secure their exposed assets *fast*, *agile*, and with way more style than your average pentest report.


 Ethical Hackers.  

 Real\-World Impact.  

 No suits, just skills.

**Job description**
-------------------

**Security Analyst (Fluent French) – Join Our Hacktastic Team in Montréal!**


Hey there, curious minds and cyber guardians!  

YesWeHack is growing in North America, and we’re looking for a passionate **Security Analyst** to join our mission in **Montréal**. You'll be joining a tight\-knit crew of two (soon to be three!) who live and breathe security, love collaboration, and never back down from a good challenge.


This isn’t your average job ad, because we’re not your average team.


You may have to **work partially on weekends** as we have a follow the Sun strategy with team members worldwide (but your will recup your hours **during the week** too!)


 What You’ll Be Up To:


You’ll dive headfirst into the heart of our bug bounty platform, working hand\-in\-hand with our global community of ethical hackers. You'll assess and qualify vulnerability reports, help clients understand risks and solutions, and even build tools to make the hacker experience even more awesome.

**Your missions (should you choose to accept):**


* Reproduce \& document PoCs (Proof of Concepts) like a cyber Sherlock
* Assess the severity of vulnerabilities (using context, not just checklists)
* Chat with clients and help translate complex risks into human language
* Be the bridge between our ethical hackers and our clients
* Keep the vulnerability workflow running smoothly and efficiently


 Your Superpowers:

* Solid grasp of **security basics** (hello OWASP Top 10 )
* You wield **CVSS scoring** like a pro
* You’re fluent in **Burp Suite** and other security tools
* You’re fluent in **French \& English** (parce qu’on est à Montréal, bien sûr )

**Even better if you also bring:**


Python dev skills* Contributions to Open Source projects
* CTF or platform experience (TryHackMe, HackTheBox, Rootme, etc.)
* A nose for the latest CVEs, exploits, and cyber trends

Offensive Security Web Expertise (OSWE)
**Profile**
-----------


 Who You Are:


You're **naturally curious**, a **lifelong learner**, and love to dig into how systems tick (and how they can break ).  

You’ve probably spent a few nights falling down rabbit holes on a Bug Bounty platform, reading CVE writeups, or trying to exploit a CTF challenge “just one more time” at 2 a.m.


You’re **team\-oriented**, friendly, and love sharing your knowledge as much as learning from others. You respect the craft, and you bring that energy to your team.


 Why Join YesWeHack?


We’re a group of passionate people who love what we do, and it shows. You’ll get to work on meaningful projects, collaborate with a global hacker community, and make the internet a safer place while having a great time doing it.


✅ Friendly, fun, tech\-savvy team  

✅ Real impact and ownership  

✅ Work\-life balance
  

✅ Opportunities to grow in a fast\-moving, global company


**We can't wait to meet you!**


If this sounds like your kind of gig, drop us your CV or reach out to say hi. Even if you’re not 100% sure you check every box, apply anyway. We care more about your mindset and passion than perfect credentials.


 Let’s hack the Planet together!!

* Develop remediation plans: Recommend targeted corrective measures — such as patch management, system reconfigurations, temporary workarounds or WAF/firewall rules — for internal teams.
* Lead zero\-day response: Provide technical leadership during critical zero\-day vulnerabilities and incidents (e.g., Log4j, major OS/hardware flaws), co\-ordinating rapid detection and mitigation.
* Evaluate and adjudicate security exemptions: Conduct in\-depth technical reviews of exemption requests when prescribed patching or remediation timelines cannot be met. Assess residual risk based on exploitability and asset criticality, requiring robust compensating controls where necessary.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
MANNARINO Systems \& Software Inc. is a leader in providing safety\-critical systems, software, hardware and certification engineering services to the aerospace, defense, space, simulation \& power generation industries.


Our customer base is very large, covering traditional aerospace companies as well as new and exciting markets, including electric propulsion, Urban Air Mobility, Unmanned Aerial Vehicle and autonomous flight.


The MANNARINO culture is focused on high quality, hard work, professionalism and teamwork within a highly respectful, motivating atmosphere geared towards long\-term business growth.


As a member of our team, you will benefit from:

* a comprehensive group insurance and RRSP plan
* a flextime policy with paid overtime
* discretionary bonuses
* a fitness reimbursement program
* other office perks such as catered weekly lunches and free hot beverages (espresso, coffee, hot chocolate and tea)
* regular company outings

**Career Opportunity and Primary Roles / Responsibilities**


We are seeking an **Applied AI Engineer** to help implement secure, reliable AI\-assisted workflows for engineering and business activities. The successful candidate will report to the person leading the company's applied AI implementation program and will collaborate with engineering, IT and business stakeholders.


The role focuses on delivering practical AI\-enabled software solutions using commercial and open\-weight AI models. It does not involve foundation model research or developing new LLM architectures.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Work with IT to deploy and operate open\-weight LLMs on internal GPU infrastructure, including model serving, quantization, performance optimization and application reliability
* Build and maintain retrieval systems over company documentation and codebases, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search and reranking
* Package and deploy AI applications using sound software engineering and containerization practices
* Integrate AI\-enabled tools with internal systems, including Atlassian products, requirements\-management and configuration\-management platforms, using MCP and standard APIs
* Develop AI\-assisted workflows supporting engineering and business activities, such as drafting engineering artifacts, triaging problem reports, automating reports and performing business development research
* Implement prompt and model configuration, context management, structured outputs, validation rules, logging, error handling and access controls
* Design internal user interfaces that support practical day\-to\-day usage
* Implement provenance logging and traceability mechanisms for AI\-generated outputs
* Build evaluation frameworks and automated testing for accuracy, groundedness, consistency, safety, latency and regression detection
* Identify weaknesses in AI workflows and implement continuous improvements

**Required Competencies**

* Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience developing maintainable applications, services or automation tools
* Experience with Linux, Docker and Git
* Experience working with APIs and integrating data across systems
* Hands\-on experience developing LLM\-enabled applications using commercial, local or open\-weight models
* Experience building AI\-assisted workflows that combine model outputs with contextual or retrieved information
* Ability to evaluate AI outputs, identify inaccuracies or ungrounded responses and improve reliability through testing and validation
* Demonstrated experience building and maintaining software solutions beyond tutorials or proof\-of\-concept exercises
* Strong attention to detail, documentation and traceability

**Asset Qualifications**

* Experience with local or open\-weight models such as vLLM, Ollama or llama.cpp
* Knowledge of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), embedding models, vector databases and rerankers
* Experience with agent frameworks, tool calling or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs or GraphRAG
* Experience developing internal web applications and user interfaces
* Knowledge of automated testing, observability and secure application development
* Experience handling public, proprietary, confidential and controlled information appropriately

**Miscellaneous Requirements**

* Work can be done remotely.
* For employees based in Montreal, the work model is hybrid (at least one day at the office).
* The position may require occasional travel within North America.
* This position is open only to Canadian citizens and permanent residents currently residing in Canada.

**Why this Role is Worth Your Time**

* **Real hardware.** You will work with dedicated high\-memory GPU infrastructure, not only a metered API key. Running models on hardware the organization controls \- and dealing with what that actually involves \- is a valuable skill that many engineers do not get to develop
* **Scope.** Small team, broad remit and direct access to the people making decisions. What you build is intended for real use, and feedback will be direct
* **A hard domain.** Safety\-critical aerospace imposes constraints most AI work never encounters: traceability, reproducibility and evidence that may need to stand up to scrutiny years later. Learning to build AI systems within those constraints is genuinely differentiating
* **An opportunity to help shape the direction.** The architecture and implementation approach are still being developed

**How to Apply**


Send your CV and a short note \- a few paragraphs is plenty \- telling us about **something you built and ran yourself**: what it did, what broke and what you would do differently. We are more interested in that than in a list of technologies.


If you have a repository, demo or anything else we can review, include it. Please do not share confid

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Développeur(se) Graphique pour se joindre à l’équipe Web Graphics de Unity. Notre équipe permet d’offrir de magnifiques graphiques 3D en temps réel dans les navigateurs Web grâce à WebGL et à WebGPU.
